(a) have at least 3 years’ working experience in an appropriate trade;
(b) be able to communicate in Cantonese/Chinese and simple English; read simple Chinese and simple English; and write simple Chinese or simple English; and
(c) have a pass result in the Basic Law and National Security Law Test (Note 2).

(b) Inspection and Quarantine Branch : (i) performing farm work which requires special skills in livestock farming; (ii) assisting in the overall feed processing work for livestock and maintenance of the feed store or crop experimental work conducted in fields; (iii) caring, feeding, handling, restraining wild and other animals; (iv) designing, constructing and repairing Animal Management Centre facilities and equipment; (v) investigation of animal related cases and conducting animal capture operation; and (vi) assisting in law enforcement and inspection of animals, birds, plants and their products.

(d) Fisheries and Marine Conservation Branch :
(I) Fisheries Division : (i) constructing, maintaining and repairing fishing and fish farming gear and equipment; (ii) performing fish farming work, including overseeing the preparation of fish feed and feeding of fish; (iii) operating, maintaining and repairing fish farming machinery and equipment; (iv) conducting fisheries surveys, including sampling of water, fish and other organisms for scientific measurements and observations; (v) performing fishing duties and miscellaneous duties on board a vessel; and carrying out inspections of commercial fishing vessels and testing of their gear and equipment; (vi) assisting in law enforcement and patrol activities; and (vii) operating and maintaining departmental vessels.
(II) Marine Parks Division : (i) constructing, maintaining and repairing marine park/marine reserve facilities; (ii) operating and maintaining departmental vessels; (iii) performing duties related to monitoring of cleaning services and maintaining cleanliness for marine parks/marine reserve; (iv) performing fishing and survey duties; (v) assisting in law enforcement and patrol activities; and (vi) assisting in general visitor services for promoting marine conservation.

full_jd:
About the role

We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Marketing Assistant/Executive to join our dynamic team at Vithal Trading (H.K.) Limited in Hung Hom, Kowloon City District. In this full-time role, you will be responsible for supporting the marketing efforts and contributing to the overall growth and success of our business.

What you'll be doing

1.     Based on Local & Worldwide Jewelry exhibitions, work with team on preparation, planning, administration, logistics, marketing, on-site serving, evaluation and coordinating each exhibition

2.     Assist with preparation of communication and public relation materials such as brochures, flyers, invitation, press and newsletters

3.     Management and promotion of social media (FB, IG, Wechat, etc.) & Online store

4.     Simple photography & editing

5.     Communicate via telephone and email with clients to promote upcoming events and exhibitions

6.     Handle client enquiries and request with grace and manner

7.     Assist for Application for SME Export Marketing Fund

What we're looking for

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team

Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to multitask and prioritize tasks

Proficient in using various marketing tools and software, such as social media platforms, CRM systems, and Microsoft Office suite

Keen eye for detail and a passion for creating visually appealing and engaging content

Proactive and self-motivated, with a willingness to learn and take on new challenges

Experience is not necessary. (Experienced candidates in marketing, advertising, or a related field is may be considered for senior positions)

Fresh graduate is welcomed

What we offer

full_jd:
About Yunxi Art Management Consulting

Headquartered in Hong Kong, Yunxi Art Management Consulting is a premier global firm specializing in art asset management, commercial and boutique real estate, hospitality, and art residency programs. With a robust international presence across Japan, France, Portugal, the United States (SoHo), Germany, and Dubai, we bridge the gap between world-class art and premium lifestyle assets.

The Role

We are seeking an exceptionally organized, adaptable, and culturally refined Global Private Assistant to support our Founder/CEO. This is not a traditional desk job; it is a highly dynamic, globe-trotting role tailored for an individual who thrives in international environments and possesses a genuine passion for the arts.

You will act as the right hand to the executive, managing complex global itineraries while accompanying them to premier art exhibitions, contemporary dance performances, classical concerts, and high-profile cultural events around the world.

Key Responsibilities

Global Itinerary Management: Design, coordinate, and execute complex, multi-destination travel arrangements across varying time zones, ensuring seamless transitions between our global offices (e.g., from an art residency in Germany to a commercial property viewing in Dubai).

On-the-Ground Support: Accompany the CEO on international business trips, providing real-time logistical support, handling spontaneous schedule adjustments, and ensuring absolute efficiency.

Cultural Engagement: Attend VIP art exhibitions, gallery openings, dance performances, and concerts alongside the CEO. Assist in documenting insights, networking with artists and stakeholders, and managing post-event follow-ups.

Cross-Border Coordination: Act as a central liaison between the CEO and our global regional heads (e.g., hospitality teams in Portugal, retail partners in the US, or property managers in Japan and France).

Confidentiality & Administration: Handle highly sensitive personal and corporate information with the utmost discretion. Manage daily administrative tasks, expense reporting, and visa applications.

Qualifications & Requirements

Experience: Proven track record (3-5 years minimum) as a Personal Assistant, Executive Assistant, or Lifestyle Manager supporting C-level executives or high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs).

Global Mobility: Unrestricted ability to travel internationally on short notice. Must hold a passport with broad visa-free access or possess valid multi-entry visas for major regions (US, Schengen, UK, Japan). Up to 70% travel is required.

Cultural Affinity: A demonstrated appreciation for and understanding of fine arts, music, and performing arts. A background in Art History, Arts Management, or Humanities is highly advantageous.

Language Skills: Native or bilingual proficiency in English is required. Fluency in Mandarin/Cantonese is essential. Additional languages (French, Japanese, German) are a significant plus.

Professional Traits: High emotional intelligence (EQ), impeccable etiquette, cultural sensitivity, and the ability to remain calm and resourceful under pressure.

What We Offer

Unparalleled opportunities to travel the world and experience elite cultural and artistic events firsthand.

Immersion in a sophisticated, cross-cultural corporate environment with a focus on premium art and real estate assets.

Strictly follow the company’s business and procurement processes to ensure all activities are compliant and traceable.

Monitor risks related to delivery timelines, quality, pricing, and settlement; provide early warnings and coordinate solutions.

Help improve business/procurement management systems, forms, and operating procedures to enhance efficiency and standardization.

title: Lower Primary Educational Assistant (Art)
snippet: An Educational Assistant works under the direction and supervision of the classroom teacher(s) to assist in fostering access, participation and...
label: 助理
full_jd:
KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:

Instructional Support

Collaborate with teachers to provide instructional assistance to students on an individual, small group, or whole class basis.

Teach small group activities (e.g. art projects, math, language arts)

Confer with individual students to assist with ongoing assessment through observational notes (or other) in various areas (e.g. guided reading, writing, math groups) or with independent work (e.g. publishing stories).

Use technology to document student work and support teaching (e.g. videos) or communicating (e.g. updating web pages).

Motivate and encourage students in and out of the classroom.

Assist students on technology devices (e.g. computer, iPad) for a variety of activities (e.g. internet access, reading).

Supervision and Safety of Students

Ensure the safety of students by providing appropriate supervision of students during recess, lunch, on the playground, in the library, during transitions (e.g. to/from the bus, up/down stairs, to/from nurse’s or principal’s offices, hallways), school gatherings (e.g. assemblies, chapels), on field trips and at other times as may be required.

Ensure the orderly entry and exit of students during arrival and departure (e.g. exiting classrooms, getting on and off the bus, going up/down stairs, in the hallways).

Follow up on special student needs including medications.

Clerical and Administration

Assist teachers with the preparation of classroom materials (e.g. photocopying, filing, classroom decoration, art supplies, materials for units of study) and teaching resources (e.g. stationery).

Prepare other ancillary documents/items as necessary (e.g. labels, bus tags, student folders, Student Information Packets, student portfolios).

Communicate with parents as necessary.

Document student work, support teaching, and communications through the use of technology (e.g. video cameras, updating web pages).

Report attendance through the Student Information System.

Prepare and manage calendars for parent volunteers.

Label, maintain and update files (e.g. student progress files, student work.)

Prepare class lists with emergency contact name(s), telephone number(s), and health issues; create a class emergency phone list and others as required.

Collect and distribute student data forms. Prepare and update other lists as required (e.g. homeroom class, after school activities). 

Other duties as required (e.g. deliver/collect internal mail, photocopying, laminating, book binding, answering the phone, responding to queries, clean up after art projects & parties, distribute, collect and compile lists for After School Activities, book orders).

Activities and Events

Collaborate with teachers in planning, organizing and arranging logistics for field trips (e.g. book locations, transportation arrangements, collection of permission slips from parents).

Collaborate with teachers in planning special celebration activities and other events as required.

Other

Substitute for the teacher for short periods of time when the teacher is absent or otherwise occupied with other school duties (e.g. meetings). Substituting for the teacher for 3 hours or the day is part of the normal job responsibilities; i.e. no additional compensation will be due.

Substitute for the teacher an entire day on occasion when no appropriate substitute teacher is available; this is compensated separately.

Participate in meetings as required (e.g. faculty, team, grade level) with teachers, colleagues, and administrators as required to support students and the school.

Participate in in-house Professional Development opportunities.

Undertake other duties and functions as required that will impact and strengthen the contributions of the department and overall operations of the school.

Minimum requirements and qualifications:

Education:

Form 6 and related post-secondary education (e.g. “Educational Assistant” Certificate, other course work related to early childhood education).

Teaching certificate or enrollment in a teaching certification program preferred.

First Aid certification/training.

Experience:

2 years as an Educational Assistant preferred

Successful experience working in the classroom with students in the assigned grade level preferred or hands-on experience working with lower primary aged children.

Required skills:

Strong written and verbal English skills, Cantonese or Mandarin a plus.

Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.

Ability to work independently and take initiative to support a classroom and team.

Proficiency with technology (Word, Excel); SIS a plus.

Passionate about young children.

Interested in, respects, and has an appreciation for diverse cultures, languages, and religions.

Actively supports the HKIS Mission and Student Learning Results.

Child Protection Statement:

At HKIS, each child’s welfare is paramount. We act to ensure that our students enjoy the right to be protected from harm and exploitation and have their welfare safeguarded.

Role Purpose

As a Payment Operations Specialist, you will be the engine room of our transaction flow. You will manage the daily movement of funds across traditional banking rails and digital asset networks. This is not a "data entry" role; we are looking for an agile professional who actively uses AI tools and automation to eliminate manual bottlenecks, handles complex exceptions, and supports the broader Finance team in reporting and audit functions.

Core Responsibilities

1. Transaction Management & Exception Handling

Manual Returns & Investigations: Manage and resolve failed or rejected payments (fiat wires and digital transfers). Identify root causes and coordinate with banks or Liquidity Providers (LPs) to ensure fund recovery.
Payment Proofs: Generate and verify official payment confirmations for high-value clients and institutional partners.
Exceptional Handling: Address "edge case" scenarios in payment routing, such as Sanction/AML hits, mismatched beneficiary details, or network congestion in digital assets.

2. Reconciliation & Audit Support

Dual-Rail Reconciliation: Perform daily "match-and-clear" reconciliations between internal ledgers, bank statements (fiat), and wallet/LP reports (digital).
Audit Confirmation: Serve as the primary point of contact for client audit requests, providing accurate transaction history and balance confirmations.
Finance Integration: Assist the Finance department with month-end closing tasks, including fee calculations and refund processing (e.g., coordinating with on monthly fee differences) and fiat / digital settlement.

3. Digital Asset & OTC Operations

OTC Support: Assist the desk in executing and settling Over-the-Counter (OTC) trades, ensuring fiat is confirmed before digital assets are released.
On/Off-Ramp Coordination: Monitor stablecoin acquiring flows and ensure smooth routing to Hashkey or other LPs for small and large ticket off-ramping.

4. Process Innovation (The "AI-First" Mandate)

Task Automation: Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, or specialized NetSuite scripts) to automate repetitive manual tasks such as data extraction from bank PDF statements or generating standardized client responses.
SOP Evolution: Continuously update and refine Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to reflect faster, leaner workflows.

Requirements & Skills

Agile Mindset: Ability to pivot quickly between traditional banking tasks (SWIFT/ACH) and digital asset tasks (On-chain txn/Stablecoin spreads).
AI Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to use Generative AI tools to draft communications, summarize complex logs, or write simple formulas/scripts to speed up manual work.
Finance Fundamentals: Strong understanding of double-entry bookkeeping, treasury management, and the Delegation of Authority (DoA) protocols.
Experience: 2+ years in Payment Operations, preferably at a fintech, crypto exchange, or payment gateway.

title: 升學及行政專員 Admissions & Administrative Officer
snippet: Join our fast-growing education group! Seeking an organized Admissions & Admin Officer to handle school apps and parent communications.
label: 行政
full_jd:
關於我們 About Us Diligent Academic Group Limited（弘得國際教育）is an EDB-registered, fast-growing education group in Hong Kong. Guided by our philosophy of "Perseverance and Joyful Learning"（弘毅樂學）, we provide quality education services including DSE preparation, school placement advisory, and overseas school application support. 弘得國際教育是香港持牌教育機構，業務涵蓋DSE備試課程、插班選校諮詢及升學行政支援服務。

職位簡介 The Role 我們正在尋找一位做事有條理、主動且注重細節的升學及行政專員加入我們不斷壯大的團隊。您將在確保教育服務順暢運作方面發揮關鍵作用，成為家長、學生、顧問和教學團隊之間的重要樞紐。如果您喜歡在快節奏的環境中工作，能夠獨當一面承擔責任，同時又享受團隊合作，這將是您的理想職位。

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Admissions & Administrative Officer to join our growing team. You will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth delivery of our educational services, acting as the vital link between parents, students, consultants, and our teaching staff. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy taking ownership of your tasks while working collaboratively, this is the perfect role for you.

工作職責 Key Responsibilities

升學及申請行政 Admissions & Application Administration: 高效管理學生入學及填表手續，準確處理申請進度，並能流暢閱讀及處理與本地及海外學校的英文郵件往來。 Efficiently manage student enrollment procedures, accurately process application forms, and handle English email correspondence with local and overseas schools.

教學營運支援 Academic Operations Support: 協助日常教學及選校行政工作，包括協助整理及標準化學生評估報告、面試準備材料等。 Assist in academic operations, including school selection administration, standardizing student assessment reports and organizing interview preparation materials.

客戶服務與溝通 Client Communication & Service: 作為專業親切的第一聯絡人接待家長，解答查詢，並及時、清晰地向家長匯報學生的申請及學習進度。 Serve as a friendly and professional first point of contact. Greet parents, handle inquiries, and provide timely, reassuring updates on their children’s application and learning progress.

團隊協作與進度管理 Team Collaboration & Workflow Management: 與前線銷售、教學團隊及營運部門保持緊密溝通，善用企業通訊及協作軟件（如 WeCom）追蹤進度，確保跨部門工作高效對接，各項任務如期完成。 Maintain efficient workflows and seamless communication across the sales, teaching, and operations teams utilizing enterprise communication tools (e.g., WeCom) to ensure all projects are on track.

一般行政 General Administration: 為中心日常營運提供全方位的行政支援。 Provide all-round administrative support to daily operations.

職位要求 Requirements

持大專、高級文憑或學士學位（歡迎任何學科，教育或工商管理背景優先）。 Degree or Higher Diploma in any discipline (Business Administration or Education preferred).

具備流暢的中英文口語及書寫能力（精通廣東話、流利普通話及英語）；必須具備良好的英文閱讀能力以處理學校信件。 Fluent command of spoken and written English, Cantonese, and Mandarin. Strong English reading comprehension is a MUST.

能獨當一面，於限期內獨立完成工作；同時具備優秀的溝通技巧及團隊合作精神。 Proven ability to work independently to meet deadlines, while also being an excellent team player with strong communication skills.

熟練操作 MS Office (Word, Excel) 等文書軟件，並能快速學習適應內部通訊及管理系統。 High proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel) and comfortable adapting to internal communication and management systems.

具備強烈責任感、做事快速準確且細心嚴謹。 A strong sense of responsibility, highly efficient, and meticulous attention to detail.

具備教育行業或行政工作經驗者將獲優先考慮；同時歡迎具備優秀執行及組織能力的應屆畢業生申請。 Candidates with prior experience in the education sector or administrative roles are highly preferred, but fresh graduates with exceptional organizational skills are also welcome to apply.

員工福利 What We Offer

具競爭力的月薪：HKD 16,000 - 22,000（視乎經驗而定）

績效獎金 / 酌情花紅 (如有) / Performance bonus / Discretionary bonus

充滿支持、透明且扁平化管理的團隊氛圍 / A supportive, transparent, and collaborative working culture

快速發展的教育集團內提供明確的晉升機會 / Clear opportunities for career advancement

強積金及有薪年假 / Mandatory Provident Fund (MPF) & Paid Annual Leave

Job Description: Sales Coordinator

Department: Sales Operations / Commercial Support

Reports To: Marketing Manager / Operations Manager

Role Purpose

The Sales Coordinator is responsible for the seamless execution of the sales cycle, from initial tender preparation to final sales order processing. This role ensures operational efficiency by maintaining accurate SKU data in the ERP system, managing complex pricing structures, and providing high-level administrative support to the sales team to ensure business targets are met.

Key Result Areas (KRAs)

1. Tender & Quotation Management

Tender Coordination: Lead the end-to-end preparation of tender documents, ensuring all technical and commercial requirements are met. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to gather necessary certifications and compliance data.

Pricing Administration: Maintain the master price list and ensure all customer quotations reflect the latest approved margins. Handle special pricing requests and volume-based discount tracking.

RFQ Response: Manage the Request for Quotation (RFQ) process, ensuring timely and accurate responses to client inquiries.

2. ERP Maintenance & SKU Management

SKU Creation: Act as the primary owner for the lifecycle of products in the ERP system (Oracle NetSuite). Create and configure new SKUs with accurate descriptions, unit measures, and categorization.

Data Integrity: Perform regular audits of ERP data to ensure item records, supplier details, and pricing levels are up to date.

System Support: Troubleshoot basic ERP data entry issues and suggest workflows to improve data accuracy and processing speed.

3. Sales Order Processing & Fulfillment

Sales Order Preparation: Convert approved quotations and customer purchase orders (POs) into formal Sales Orders within the ERP system.

Order Validation: Verify that all orders align with existing contracts, principal agreements, and credit terms before processing.

Liaison with Operations: Work closely with the warehouse and logistics teams to track order status and provide customers with accurate delivery updates.

4. Sales Intelligence & Reporting

full_jd:
About the Role

We're looking for a sharp, hands-on Digital Marketing & Communications Specialist to join our team - someone who lives and breathes campaigns, knows how to turn an idea into a polished piece of content, and can run a great event from brief to post-mortem.

This is an executional, working-level role for a marketer who likes to do, not just plan. You'll own campaigns end-to-end: shaping the concept, writing the copy, pushing it live across our digital and social channels, and reporting on what worked (and what didn't). You'll also play a key role in the events that bring our brand to life.

If you have strong marketing instincts, a writer's eye for detail, and the energy to juggle multiple deliverables at once - we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Marketing Campaigns

Develop creative campaign concepts aligned with business and brand objectives

Execute campaigns across digital, social, and offline touchpoints - from kickoff to delivery

Track performance, run post-campaign analysis, and translate data into clear, actionable insights

Continuously test, learn, and optimise

Copywriting & Content

Write engaging, on-brand copy for social media, EDMs, website, official communications, and event collateral

Adapt tone and format across platforms (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, 小紅書, etc.)

Collaborate with designers, video editors, and external partners to bring content to life

Events

Support end-to-end event planning and execution: logistics, vendor coordination, on-site management, attendee experience

Prepare event marketing materials, run-of-show documents, and promotional assets

Lead post-event reporting and analysis - attendance, engagement, ROI, learnings

Analytics & Reporting

Monitor social, web, and campaign metrics; build clear reports for internal stakeholders

Spot trends and surface insights that shape the next campaign

What We're Looking For

Must-haves

2–4 years of hands-on marketing experience (agency or in-house)

Strong marketing sense: you understand campaigns, funnels, audiences, and what makes content perform

Solid grasp of digital and social media - both organic and paid

Excellent copywriting skills in both English and Chinese (Traditional Chinese essential; Simplified a plus)

Comfortable with performance analytics (Meta Ads Manager, GA4, social insights tools, etc.)

Highly organised, proactive, and able to manage multiple projects at once

Nice-to-haves

Experience planning and running events (corporate, education, lifestyle, or B2C)

Journalism, editorial, or media background

Familiarity with design tools (Canva, Adobe Suite) or video editing basics

Experience in marketing within the education, lifestyle, or premium services sector

Why Join Us

A varied role with real ownership - your campaigns and content will be seen, not buried

A collaborative team that values ideas, craft, and execution in equal measure

Exposure to the full marketing mix: digital, brand, events, content, and analytics

Opportunities to grow into broader marketing leadership

How to Apply

Send your CV along with 2–3 samples of your copywriting or campaign work (links or PDFs welcome). Tell us briefly which campaign you're most proud of - and why.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to submit a portfolio of work they have personally created before proceeding to interview. This step is mandatory — interviews will not be scheduled until a portfolio has been reviewed. We want to see the real work you have done, not just what you have managed or planned.

title: Social Media Manager – LinkedIn
snippet: Own and scale a high-impact LinkedIn presence—creating thoughtful content that drives growth, builds influence, and converts audience into customers.
label: 内容
full_jd:
We’re looking for an awesome creative, fun person to join our full-time in-person Hong Kong team to level-up our LinkedIn presence and help create inspiring, educational content that changes lives.

If you love writing, thinking in systems, and using content to change how people work and live, this is your playground.

Type: Full-time

Location: Hong Kong

Salary: $35k-$50k+ HKD per month depending on experience. Looking for the best person for the job, and willing to pay whatever it takes if you’re good.

Deadline: There’s no deadline. This ad was posted on 13th April 2026. We’ll close this job description as soon as we find the right person. So if you’re reading this, the role’s still open, and you should apply

Who We Are

I’m Ali – doctor turned entrepreneur, YouTuber and author of the New York Times bestseller Feel-Good Productivity. I’ve been making content online since 2017, starting with helping students get into medical school, then branching into productivity, personal development and, more recently, building online businesses. Our main platform is YouTube, where we’ve built an audience of 6.5M+ and hundreds of millions of views over the last nine years.

The company behind all of this is Sparkle Studios. Our mission is simple: create inspiring, educational content and products that genuinely change people’s lives – especially around productivity, personal development, and building online, lifestyle-first businesses.

We currently have three main arms:

Personal brands: my content, plus my wife’s Izzy Sealey’s channels and related projects.

Lifestyle Business Academy: our online business school where we’re building what we hope becomes the world’s best alternative to a traditional MBA.

Software: a growing suite of apps around productivity, personal development, and the creator economy.

You’d be joining a small, ambitious team in our Hong Kong office – lots of whiteboards, post-its everywhere, in-person collaboration, and a shared obsession with making internet things that actually help people.

Why This Role Exists

We’ve taken YouTube very seriously for years. We’ve also invested heavily into Instagram. LinkedIn, on the other hand, has been something we’ve dabbled with, but never gone all-in on.

That’s what this role is about.

LinkedIn has become noisy – a lot of AI-generated “slop”, shallow takes and copy-paste threads. We want to build something different: signal, not noise. Thoughtful, useful, practical content that helps people:

Work and live more productively

Build online businesses that give them freedom

Think more clearly about their careers and life design

We already have nine years of content, hundreds of videos, newsletters, and podcast episodes that can be repurposed, remixed and expanded into platform-native LinkedIn content. We just need the right person to turn that raw material into a coherent, consistent, high-performing presence.

That’s where you come in.

What You’ll Own

This is not a “post a couple of clips and watch the follower count” role. You’ll be building and running a LinkedIn machine that drives both brand and business outcomes.

1. LinkedIn Strategy & Growth

Design and own the end-to-end strategy for Ali’s LinkedIn presence.

Set clear goals for impressions, reach, followers, and lead quality — then build the content and systems to hit them.

Experiment with formats (posts, carousels, documents, stories, thought-leadership threads) and engagement tactics to find what works, then scale it.

Study the landscape: do competitor and industry research to spot opportunities early and keep us ahead of the curve.

2. Content Production & Editorial

Turn ideas, YouTube videos, podcast episodes, newsletter snippets and in-person conversations into compelling LinkedIn-native posts.

Write clear, engaging, professional posts that sound like Ali, not a generic “content bot”.

Create and oversee carousels, infographics and document posts that make complex ideas feel simple and actionable.

Manage a proactive content calendar so that we show up consistently and strategically, not just when inspiration hits.

Provide direction and feedback to our content executive (and any future collaborators) to maintain quality and tone.

3. Analytics, Experiments & Insights

Live inside the data: monitor and interpret LinkedIn analytics so you understand what’s working and why.

Run structured experiments on hooks, formats, CTAs, and topics.

Translate performance into insight, then into action: “do more of this, less of that, here’s why”.

Produce concise monthly insight reports that inform our wider content and commercial strategy.

4. Turning Attention into Revenue

Design and optimize lead-generation flows from LinkedIn to the Lifestyle Business Academy and other products.

Use smart CTAs, comment-to-DM flows, and strategic value-first content to move people from “follower” to “student” or “customer”.

Work closely with the commercial team to align campaigns, promotions, and launches with what’s happening on the feed.

Track outcomes, not just vanity metrics, so we can see how LinkedIn contributes to revenue and long-term growth.

5. Systems, Ops & Collaboration

Build and refine the processes for content creation, approvals, and publishing so the whole thing runs smoothly.

Identify bottlenecks and fix them — whether that’s better templates, clearer briefs, or smarter use of AI.

Keep cross-team communication clear so everyone knows what’s going out, when, and why.

Create documentation and simple frameworks that make the LinkedIn engine scalable over the next 1–3 years.

Who This Is For

You’re a rare mix of strategist, writer, and operator. You care about both the craft and the outcomes.

You’ll probably resonate with most of these:

You’ve already grown and managed LinkedIn profiles or company pages, ideally for thought leaders, entrepreneurs, or personal brands in the education, productivity, or creator space.

You can write in a way that feels human, ground

About Us

We are a dynamic sports events company based in Hong Kong, dedicated to organizing premier athletic competitions, community races, and sports festivals. We combine a strong foundation in marketing principles with a modern approach to audience engagement. We are looking for an innovative Assistant Marketing Manager who understands fundamental marketing strategies and has the drive to execute them effectively.

The Role

As the Assistant Marketing Manager, you will play a pivotal role in driving the marketing strategy and execution for our portfolio of sports events. This role requires a balance of traditional marketing acumen—understanding target audiences, consumer behavior, and brand positioning—with the operational agility to drive event registrations and community loyalty. You will report to the Marketing Manager and work closely with operations, sponsorship, and creative teams.

 

Key Responsibilities

Traditional Marketing Strategy & Positioning

Targeting & Segmentation: Apply classic marketing frameworks (STP, 4 Ps) to segment the sports community and tailor specific messaging for each group.

Brand Governance: Maintain strict brand positioning and tone of voice guidelines across all physical event touchpoints and digital channels.

OOH & Offline Integration: Assist in managing traditional marketing channels, including event signage, sports expo booths, PR/media relations, and Out-Of-Home (OOH) print advertisements in Hong Kong.

 

Content & Channel Management

Multi-Platform Management: Manage and optimize content across social media channels maximize engagement and build community.

Copywriting: Draft high-converting, bilingual marketing copy, adapting the tone smoothly between professional PR materials and high-energy social captions.

Creative Coordination: Oversee the creation of visual assets and video content, ensuring all online graphics and live-event footage align seamlessly with our brand identity.

 

Funnel Optimization & Analytics

Marketing Funnel Optimization: Track the customer journey from initial event awareness to ticket purchase/registration, ensuring a friction-free conversion funnel.

Data Analysis: Monitor and report on marketing KPIs (ROI, CPA, conversion rates) to extract actionable insights from attendee registration data.

 

Qualifications & Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field. A strong academic or professional foundation in traditional marketing principles is essential.

Experience: 3–5 years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or event management. Experience in the sports, fitness, or mass-participation entertainment industry is highly preferred.

Core Marketing Skills: Solid understanding of brand strategy, consumer psychology, public relations, and multi-channel campaign planning.

Language Skills: Excellent written and spoken English and Cantonese. Knowledge of Mandarin is an advantage.

Personal Attributes: A genuine passion for sports, a structured strategic mind, and a proactive, organized approach to problem-solving.

AI Proficiency: Proven ability to enhance marketing workflows through the use of AI tools for content creation (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, CapCut), task automation (e.g., Zapier), and social media management.

 

What We Offer

Competitive salary and performance bonus.

Comprehensive medical and dental insurance.

Flexible working arrangements and a vibrant, energetic sports-centric office culture.

Complimentary entry to all company-organized sports events.

Continuous learning allowance to upgrade your marketing strategy and professional skillset.

location: Mong Kok ·  Yau Tsim Mong District
label: 编辑
full_jd:
招聘職位：營運經理 (中文部教材編輯)

【關於我們】

曜莘中文教育中心是中文專科教育，涵蓋幼兒認字班到小學課程。隨著品牌版圖不斷擴張，我們誠邀一位具備戰略思維、優秀營運能力及品牌觸覺的領軍人才加入，統一提升各分校的營運效能，並強化品牌市場影響力。

核心職責：

1. 品牌戰略與形象管理

負責曜莘中文教育中心的營運策劃、執行，管理各分校的員工及其他一切營運工作。

統籌品牌的視覺形象與品牌調性，確保各分校執行的一致性。

策劃並執行集團年度營運策略，提升品牌在教育市場的知名度與口碑。

2. 營運流程標準化 (SOP)

優化集團跨品牌的營運流程，包括招生轉化、客戶服務標準及行政自動化。

定期巡查各區分校，確保日常營運符合集團質量指標。

審查及監控教材及協助教材內容設計和製作進度。

管理教學質素，維持表現，確保各分校的營運進度

3. 數據驅動管理

監控各校區的 KPI（如新收生人數、營運成本），編製分析報告並向管理層提供優化建議。

管理集團中央數據系統，利用數據優化課堂編排與資源配置。

4. 團隊領導與跨部門協作

協調各分校中心經理和教師的工作，確保總部政策有效落地。

與課程開發團隊及市場部緊密合作，將教學成果轉化為品牌推廣動力。

協助培訓同支援老師及行政團隊，解答家長查詢、介紹課程、學生報名手續、課堂及評估安排程序。

協助教授中文課程及編制教材 (K.1 - P.6)，提供優質客戶服務和高水平的教學質素。

與各部門間的溝通及合作，維繫學生、員工和管理層之間的關係。

入職要求：

學歷與背景： 擁有市場營銷、商業管理經驗及具備教育學士學位，主修中文。

經驗要求： 具備教育中心教學經驗及 5 年以上營運管理經驗，其中至少 2 年涉及多店管理或教育品牌經驗。

核心能力：

性格開朗、有愛心和耐性、守時、細心認真、喜歡小朋友。

富有責任感，具備良好抗壓能力與團隊協作精神。

良好態度、溝通技巧、組織及能獨立處理大量工作的能力。

極佳的統籌能力，能同時處理多間分校的複雜事務。

對數據敏感，能從報表中發現潛在的營運問題。

具備品牌建設經驗能指導市場推廣方向。

具有教授中文課程經驗，對中文必須有專業的知識。

DSE中文5等優先考慮。

語文能力：

出色的中文撰寫及口頭表達能力。

能操流利廣東話。

性格特質：

具備領導魅力、強大的抗壓性、以及在快速變化的環境中解決問題的彈性。

為什麼選擇我們？

決策影響力： 您將直接參與集團品牌擴張與課程發展的重大決策。

競爭力待遇： 優厚基本薪金 + 員工子女教育優惠。

穩定平台： 品牌在市場已具備堅實基礎，提供長期發展保障。

適合對象

✔ 具備連鎖補習社、大型教育機構或加盟連鎖管理經驗者。

✔ 希望從單店管理提升至集團戰略管理層的資深經理。

✔擅長將「教學質素」轉化為「品牌價值」的營運專才。

title: Long-Form Video Editor – Izzy Sealey
snippet: Edit high-retention YouTube videos in Hong Kong, helping inspire millions of people through impactful personal development content.
label: 编辑
full_jd:
Hi, I’m Izzy. I’m looking for an incredible Long-Form Video Editor to work in-person with me and my team in Hong Kong on creating long-form YouTube videos.

You’ll be in-person, in the room with us most days, helping us turn raw footage into YouTube videos that hook from the first second, hold viewers until the very end, and feel unmistakably on-brand.

The mission of the channel is to help 10 million women to fulfil their potential and create a life that they love. We do this through evidence-based, heart-led personal development content designed to create lasting change.

You’ll own long-form editing for the channel (YouTube, 870k+ subs). Your real job is retention: knowing how to structure pacing, build narrative momentum, and keep people watching, all while looking polished and on-brand, and generally being organised and awesome to work with.

This role is editing-centric: ~90–95% editing, ~5–10% light videography (mainly grabbing B-roll when needed). We’re likely hiring a dedicated videographer for the bigger shoots, so your week lives in the edit bay.

Our Mission at Sparkle Studios

You’ll be joining our team at Sparkle Studios, a company that I cofounded with my husband Ali.

Our mission is to create inspiring, educational content and products that change people’s lives.

We do that across three strands:

Content — Izzy’s personal brand (1M total following, this is where this role lives), and Ali’s personal brand (8M total following).

Education — Lifestyle Business Academy, our online business school helping beginners build their first $100K online business.

Software — Voicepal (AI ghostwriter in your pocket), SuperFocus (productivity), and CreatorGrid (creator growth + monetisation).

Your role is leading the editing for Izzy’s YouTube channel. You’ll be dedicated to my content and brand style, not spread across the wider business.

Hours, Location & Setup

Location: Hong Kong, in-person. Either you’re already based in Hong Kong, or are willing to relocate to Hong Kong for the role. We’re in the office Monday–Friday and you’ll be in the room with us most days.

Hours: Full-time.

Salary: Competitive, negotiable depending on experience.

Travel: Annual/Biannual team offsites at fun locations around the world (e.g. Thailand, Sri Lanka), and maybe the occasional shoot or event abroad.

Start date: As soon as we find the right person

What You’ll Actually Be Doing
Long-form YouTube editing (your main beat)

Transforming raw footage into long-form YouTube videos that hook viewers in the first few seconds and hold their attention the whole way through. You think about watch time as much as you think about aesthetics, and you know how to structure pacing, build narrative momentum, and earn the next minute of attention.

Brand-consistent editing

Following our style guide so every video reinforces the channel’s branding, in terms of colour palette, typography, pacing, transitions, and the visual language that builds trust with the audience over time.

Motion graphics & visual effects

Creating dynamic text animations, lower thirds, transitions, and motion graphics that elevate production quality and keep the viewing experience fresh. Comfortable in After Effects (or equivalent) and happy to push the look forward over time.

Light videography (~5–10%)

Occasionally picking up a camera to grab B-roll, set up a lav mic, or adjust filming settings. Not your main job, but useful.

Tight organisation

Backed-up footage, sensible naming, versioned project files. No lost clips, no mystery versions.

What We’re Looking For

Proven long-form YouTube experience. You’ve edited long-form YouTube content (ideally for personal-brand channels) with demonstrable success. You understand what makes people click and, more importantly, what makes them stay.

Retention & engagement expertise. You know how to hook viewers in the first few seconds, maintain pacing, and structure content for maximum watch time.

Technical proficiency & motion graphics. Expert-level skills in Premiere Pro (or Final Cut Pro) + After Effects. Polished text animations, transitions, and visual effects that feel professional and on-brand.

Attention to detail. Every frame matters. Sharp eye for colour grading, audio levels, pacing, and the small details that separate good edits from great ones.

Fast revision turnaround. You thrive under deadlines and can turn changes around fast without compromising quality.

AI-forward. Already using AI tools where they make the work better or faster. Curious about what’s next and constantly levelling up with AI tools.

Creative problem-solving. You can take unpolished footage and transform it into compelling content, even when the source material is challenging.

Calm, reliable, systematic. Footage backed up, deadlines met, versioned project files.

What We Offer

Impact — your work will be seen by millions and have a direct role in changing the lives of hundreds of thousands of loyal subscribers. You will shape the next era of the brand and help to build one of the biggest women personal development channels in the world.

Creative ownership — you’ll take ownership and shape the look and feel of videos, not just execute someone else’s brief.

Travel — vibey team offsites in fun locations around the world a couple times per year (Thailand, Sri Lanka, and wherever the year takes us).

In-person Hong Kong team energy — we’re building out an epic media team in-person in Hong Kong, where creative energy compounds and we learn from each other and grow together every day.

Relocation support and visa sponsorship for the right person.

snippet: 全面負責曜莘中文各分校營運及品牌策劃，透過SOP標準化及數據管理提升績效。領導團隊落實總部政策，監管K1-P6教材與教學質素，並親自參與授課與培訓。確保品牌形象一致，維繫優質家長關係，將教學質素轉化為品牌影響力。適合具中文教學背景及多店管理經驗的領導人才。
location: Mong Kok ·  Yau Tsim Mong District
label: 编辑
full_jd:
招聘職位：營運經理 (中文部教材編輯)

【關於我們】

我們是一家快速成長的教育集團，旗下擁有多個知名教育品牌，其中曜莘中文教育中心是中文專科教育，涵蓋幼兒認字班到小學課程。隨著品牌版圖不斷擴張，我們誠邀一位具備戰略思維、優秀營運能力及品牌觸覺的領軍人才加入，統一提升各分校的營運效能，並強化品牌市場影響力。

核心職責：

1. 品牌戰略與形象管理

負責曜莘中文教育中心的營運策劃、執行，管理各分校的員工及其他一切營運工作。

統籌品牌的視覺形象與品牌調性，確保各分校執行的一致性。

策劃並執行集團年度營運策略，提升品牌在教育市場的知名度與口碑。

2. 營運流程標準化 (SOP)

優化集團跨品牌的營運流程，包括招生轉化、客戶服務標準及行政自動化。

定期巡查各區分校，確保日常營運符合集團質量指標。

審查及監控教材及協助教材內容設計和製作進度。

管理教學質素，維持表現，確保各分校的營運進度

3. 數據驅動管理

監控各校區的 KPI（如新收生人數、營運成本），編製分析報告並向管理層提供優化建議。

管理集團中央數據系統，利用數據優化課堂編排與資源配置。

4. 團隊領導與跨部門協作

協調各分校中心經理和教師的工作，確保總部政策有效落地。

與課程開發團隊及市場部緊密合作，將教學成果轉化為品牌推廣動力。

協助培訓同支援老師及行政團隊，解答家長查詢、介紹課程、學生報名手續、課堂及評估安排程序。

協助教授中文課程及編制教材 (K.1 - P.6)，提供優質客戶服務和高水平的教學質素。

與各部門間的溝通及合作，維繫學生、員工和管理層之間的關係。

入職要求：

學歷與背景： 擁有市場營銷、商業管理經驗及具備教育學士學位，主修中文。

經驗要求： 具備教育中心教學經驗及 5 年以上營運管理經驗，其中至少 2 年涉及多店管理或集團教育品牌經驗。

核心能力：

性格開朗、有愛心和耐性、守時、細心認真、喜歡小朋友。

富有責任感，具備良好抗壓能力與團隊協作精神。

良好態度、溝通技巧、組織及能獨立處理大量工作的能力。

極佳的統籌能力，能同時處理多間分校的複雜事務。

對數據敏感，能從報表中發現潛在的營運問題。

具備品牌建設經驗能指導市場推廣方向。

具有教授中文課程經驗，對中文必須有專業的知識。

DSE中文5等優先考慮。

語文能力：

出色的中文撰寫及口頭表達能力。

能操流利廣東話。

性格特質：

具備領導魅力、強大的抗壓性、以及在快速變化的環境中解決問題的彈性。

為什麼選擇我們？

決策影響力： 您將直接參與集團品牌擴張與課程發展的重大決策。

競爭力待遇： 優厚基本薪金 + 員工子女教育優惠。

穩定平台： 品牌在市場已具備堅實基礎，提供長期發展保障。

適合對象

✔ 具備連鎖補習社、大型教育機構或加盟連鎖管理經驗者。

✔ 希望從單店管理提升至集團戰略管理層的資深經理。

✔擅長將「教學質素」轉化為「品牌價值」的營運專才。

對財經數字極度敏感，能迅速從報表或數據中抓出新聞亮點。

title: Assistant Editor / Editor (Secondary ELT Editorial)
snippet: Producing English language teaching materials, either in book, audio-visual, electronic form, stand alone or package, for the target market

full_jd:
Job description:

About the Role

We are looking for a talented Assistant Editor / Editor to join our Secondary ELT Editorial Team who will be responsible for producing English language teaching materials, either in book, audio-visual, electronic form, stand alone or package, for the target market that are accurate, attractive, achieve a market schedule and are appropriate for that market, in order to achieve high levels of profit for the company, while maintaining the highest possible publishing standards.

Key responsibilities:

Product knowledge - Clear understanding of market requirements is demonstrated. Education Bureau/Examination Authority syllabi are understood. Product knowledge is in-depth and accurately disseminated to sales and marketing personnel.
Desk editing - Straightforward editorial tasks are handled responsibly and independently. Work carried out meets the requirements specified by supervisors. Reduced supervisor correction and guidance is required. Responsibility for frequent, ongoing liaison and communication with Assistant Editors and team, managers, ELT SMT, Design, EM, and Production ensures smooth progress of own projects. Appropriate ELT materials are produced to the highest standard possible, on schedule and on budget.
Organization and management - Clear, accurate project and task records are maintained and easily accessed by supervisors and managers. Pre-determined publication dates are realized.
Maintenance of market share - Ongoing collaboration and communication with EM. Market reaction to established products in the backlist is studied. Awareness of the need for a generation of new editions is demonstrated to supervisors and managers. Highest possible market share is maintained and expanded.
Accuracy and relevance of market research - Contribution to the formulation of market research plans. Active participation in school visits. Teacher network is developed and maintained. Understanding of competitors' materials is demonstrated. Market research is analyzed and disseminated.
Knowledge and skills' acquisition and sharing - Active involvement in training workshops and sharing sessions in line with managers' instructions. Responsibility for own learning and development is taken.
Flexibility, willingness and efficiency - Active involvement in training workshops and sharing sessions in line with managers' instructions. Responsibility for own learning and development is taken.
Increase brand awareness and respect for the brand. - Promote Oxford University Press and its product lines both during and outside office hours at, e.g. seminars, book exhibitions, conferences, schools, professional associations, Spring dinners, author's parties, etc.

About You

Essential:

Excellent interpersonal skills, team player, adaptable, flexible
Excellent organizational and prioritization skills
High level of literacy in written and spoken English
Meticulous eye for detail
Analytical skills
Presentation and public speaking skills
Ability to work under pressure
Competitive, with winning attitude
ELT-related qualifications

location: Lai Chi Kok ·  Sham Shui Po District
label: 编辑
full_jd:
【關於這份工作】 隨著 PressLogic 正式將香港最大親子討論平台 Baby Kingdom 納入集團版圖，我們正在積極擴編！這不是一份傳統的編輯工作，我們需要你兼具「Social 編輯的敏銳度」與「廣告策劃的商業頭腦」，在日常流量內容 (Traffic Content) 與品牌合作項目 (Commercial Projects) 中自由切換，創造具備影響力與高轉化率的親子內容。

🎯 我們要找的是這樣的你：

1. 你是「自帶流量故事」的發掘家: 你對 Baby Kingdom 親子王國及教育王國等高互動性的平台內容有超強觸覺。你不僅瀏覽內容，更能像偵探一樣深入論壇熱話中，挖掘那些最具爭議性、最感動或最「寫實」的父母真實故事。

2. 你是「品牌與讀者」的超強橋樑: 你明白如何將生硬的「品牌廣告」轉化為父母愛看的故事！擅長將客戶的商業訴求與產品賣點，包裝成貼地、具高度代入感且具備高轉化率 (Conversion) 的贊助帖文 (Advertorial) 或短片 Script，完美平衡客戶需求與讀者口味。

3. 你是「共鳴感」的創造師: 你知道 「爆文」的密碼，擅長將知識資訊、育兒或升學的日常煩惱，「翻譯」成貼地、具高度代入感的故事 或短片腳本，讓讀者忍不住留言：「說出我的心聲！」，確保內容能被大量分享和討論。

4. 你對「升學教育與家庭生活」有研究熱情: 無論是本地學校的叩門心得、國際學校的課程優勢，還是育兒路上的理念爭議，你都充滿熱情和見解。你能將複雜的資訊，用清晰、有趣且具備情感連結的方式傳遞給目標家長群 (Target Audience)。

5. 你是個擁抱 AI 科技的實幹型創作人 : 懂 Social 玩法、懂得與設計、Sales 及拍攝團隊協作。不怕問、不怕改，積極擁抱 AI (AIGC) 和各種數碼內容上的變化，願意嘗試以新角度、新工具優化產出效率。

📌 工作職責：

內容策劃與製作

論壇故事挖掘與轉化： 深入 Baby Kingdom、教育王國 等社群平台，主導挖掘高共鳴度的用戶故事、熱話及教育資訊，並策劃、改寫成 社交媒體爆文。

教育主題聚焦： 撰寫並製作不同形式的內容（文章／影片／圖文／短片等），確保內容能提供具價值的 本地及國際學校升學、育兒心態、兒童健康等教育主題資訊。

平台策略： 深入理解平台和目標受眾的定位，量身設計符合平台語氣與讀者口味的主題和敘事方式，特別注重 內容的情感轉化力。

執行與優化

主導或參與拍攝企劃（劇本、訪問、拍攝方向）並能獨立完成基本影像或短片編輯，為社交媒體發布做好準備。

結合 MediaLens 數據工具、AIGC 技術等，為內容方向作出定期回顧和調整，確保內容策略能精準命中受眾痛點。

🌟 我們想見到的你：

有 3 年以上 數位媒體／市場營銷文案經驗，熟悉數碼內容產製流程。（有更資深經驗的申請者將被考慮為 Senior Digital Editor）

擅長撰寫具有生活感與轉換力的文字，能夠靈活轉換語氣風格，特別是 第一身故事敘述。

對 育兒教育、升學資訊或家庭生活內容有深入了解及熱情，擁有相關社群內容或 論壇／社群管理經驗 優先。

熟悉拍攝流程與社群內容美學，具備自製能力尤佳。

樂於學習數據驅動內容策略，勇於嘗試新型態內容手法（如 AIGC、互動式內容等）。

✨ 為什麼選擇 PressLogic？

Mar-tech 體系學習之路： 你將學會如何用數據驅動內容、用科技推動成效。

主導內容方向： 參與從想法到執行的完整創作流程，主導內容方向：我們信任專業，只要你有想法，我們提供資源讓它實現。

多元合作機會： 從權威教育機構、國際品牌到本地活動策劃，你會有機會參與眾多頂尖合作專案。

關於 PressLogic | 透過社交媒體、AI 與數據，為品牌創造更大可能

PressLogic 2016 年於香港成立，是一家新世代廣告科技生態系統集團 － 我們專注於整合內容創作、數據分析、AI 技術與全流程行銷策略，透過科技與數據精準驅動內容價值與商業轉化，為品牌提供一站式解決方案。

我們的業務橫跨亞洲7大市場，遍及新加坡、馬來西亞、台灣、韓國、印度及深圳，團隊由超過 200 位營銷及科技專業人才組成，並已建立完整的製作、科技與分析能力體系。我們的內容矩陣涵蓋 9 個垂類媒體品牌，累積超過 1,700 萬粉絲，每月內容觸及量突破 5 億次，並持續快速擴展中。我們的媒體品牌橫跨多個生活領域，包括：

健康生活（UrbanLife Health）

韓流潮流（Kdaily）

我們於 2023 年榮獲 Deloitte 香港高成長企業大獎（AI 軟件類別）殊榮，並成功入選香港科學園「精英培育計劃」（資訊與通訊科技領域），這些成就正好印證我們對科技、內容與成效之間的深度整合與創新實力。

MediaLens | 用 AI 和數據，為內容賦能

我們的旗艦產品 MediaLens 是一款結合 AI、社群洞察與行銷分析的工具，支援用戶掌握品牌聲量、KOL 效益、社群熱度與市場趨勢，並自動生成洞察報告。無論是內容創意發想，還是 KPI 追蹤與再行銷部署，MediaLens 為品牌提供策略與效率兼備的支援。

除了MediaLens及內容團隊，PressLogic 亦擁有一系列支援品牌轉化與業務成長的工具與服務，包括：

ChatBooster｜營銷角度設計的聊天商務工具，整合多個平台對話框，實現對話式行銷與自動化 CRM。

EchoMaker｜AI 驅動的 KOL 行銷，結合數據與創意策劃，讓品牌與內容達成聲量最大化。

EventVibe｜線上線下活動策劃與執行專家，專注打造品牌體驗與社群參度。

TapNow｜一站式電商平台，讓品牌輕鬆開展數位零售，串聯內容推廣與購物體驗。

AIGC 能力｜內建技術團隊支援活動與內容專案，讓生成式 AI 成為創意與執行力的延伸。

我們的優勢，不只在內容，而在於內容的價值能被放大!

我們相信真正有效的內容，來自於策略切入、科技支援與用戶共鳴。PressLogic 所提供的，不僅是單一服務，而是一整套能為品牌帶來成效的內容技術解決方案。

Job Purpose​ and principal accountability

The purpose of this role is to mobilize Hong Kong society - public, media, institutions and communities in active support of MSF’s humanitarian medical mission, protecting MSF’s reputation and enabling engagement that converts into sustained fundraising performance across channels and donor types. The role operates at the meta level: ensuring the engagement ecosystem (Fundraising, Communications, Outreach/Events and Digital) functions as a single integrated system with shared priorities, consistent narrative, aligned KPIs, and disciplined governance.

The role is accountable for MSF Hong Kong-based public positioning, brand and narrative, income-generation performance, and data-led engagement across Hong Kong and Singapore mass-market channels. It is also the Local Spokesperson and leads crisis communications and reputation stewardship in Hong Kong. The Director leads through department heads setting direction, approving strategies, arbitrating trade-offs, and holding leaders accountable for delivery rather than directly executing campaigns or operational programmes.

1. Communications

Set and approve MSF Hong Kong’s overarching narrative and positioning ensure coherence with MSF Identity and Positioning Framework across all engagement functions

Ensure communications are designed with Fundraising and Digital to move audiences through the supporter funnel from awareness to retention

Govern brand standards, executive tone and reputational risk, acting as final approver for sensitive or high risk positioning

Define public affairs positioning and media escalation rules, act as spokesperson when needed, and ensure media strategy effectively supports agreed mobilisation outcomes

Build trust and credibility by using thought leadership and flagship content to strengthen brand affinity and drive public mobilisation

Define and govern KPIs that link communications effectiveness to mobilisation and fundraising outcomes, ensuring disciplined performance management and continuous improvement.

Lead crisis communications governance for Hong Kong, ensuring clear decision rights, fast approvals, and effective execution under Executive Director oversight

2. Fundraising & Development (Income Generation)

Review, challenge and approve the Fundraising Strategy to ensure alignment with MSF principles, section wide priorities and the overall engagement strategy

Endorse income targets, investment assumptions and KPIs, and remain accountable for fundraising performance through clear governance with the Head of Fundraising

Ensure Fundraising, Communications, Digital and Outreach operate as one end to end supporter system with clear handoffs across the funnel

Make portfolio level investment and prioritisation decisions to maximise ROI, sustainability and organisational coherence

Ensure fundraising growth complies with legal, ethical and reputational standards, escalating material risks to protect trust and independence

Own engagement wide data governance, standards and decision frameworks, while delegating fundraising system optimisation to the Head of Fundraising

3. Digital Strategy, Transformation & Oversight 

Define and lead a single, coherent digital strategy across all channels and distributed owners

Set and govern digital KPIs to drive acquisition, engagement, retention, ROI and brand outcomes ensuring measurement reliability, performance cadence, and escalation routines

Consolidate and steer digital investment across teams ensuring shared platform strategy, consistent optimization principles, and avoidance of fragmented channel tactics

Ensure an integrated digital campaign operating system is in place (audience priorities, funnel design, testing roadmap, measurement standards), with delivery owned by functional leads in Fundraising/Communications/Outreach and embedded digital specialists

Translate digital performance insights into clear strategic decisions for senior leadership

Sponsor experimentation and new channel development while upholding ethical, legal and reputational safeguards

4. Financial Management & Governance

Develop, consolidate and oversee annual budgets covering fundraising, communications, digital and outreach/events ensuring alignment with the section-wide plan and strategic priorities

Identify trade-offs and reallocate resources across the portfolio to maximise efficiency and impact within approved authority

Ensure accurate forecasting and scenario planning through disciplined assumptions and escalation

Ensure legal, financial and procurement compliance across fundraising and communications

Contribute to risk management processes and ensure audit actions are completed and closed  

Provide decision oriented financial and KPI reporting to governance stakeholders for scale/stop/shift decisions

5. People Leadership & Culture

Model Management Team values and behaviors that reinforce a culture of Agility, Collaboration, Collaboration, Solidarity, Integrity 

Promote MSF’s humanitarian medical identity and consistently connect day-to-day work to the social mission, strengthening purpose, integrity, and pride in impact

Foster a culture of cross-team collaboration, learning, and shared accountability across Fundraising, Communications, Outreach and distributed digital capability  

Enable experimentation within clear guardrails (ethics, brand, compliance), and institutionalise learning loops so evidence drives improvements (scale/stop/shift)

Lead organisational change with clarity, stable priorities and sustained delivery through improved ways of working

Coach and develop high-performing leaders; build a strong leadership bench and ensure consistent leadership standards across the engagement portfolio

Own the engagement portfolio’s performance cadence, ensuring goals, feedback and development align with MSF values and strategic priorities

6. Coordination, Escalation & Delivery Governance (Office-wide Enablement)

full_jd:

Summary of Responsibilities:

Site management responsibility for clinical studies according to Fortrea’s Standard Operating Procedures, ICH GCP Guidelines, applicable project plans and Sponsor requirements, including verification of study training records.

Conducts site monitoring responsibilities for clinical trials according to Fortrea’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ICH guidelines and GCP; including Pre-study, Site Initiation, Process Monitoring, Routine Monitoring, and Close-out Visits.

Prepares and implements project plans related to Clinical Monitoring responsibilities.

Ensures the protection of subjects by verifying that informed consent procedures and protocol requirements are adhered to alongside applicable regulatory requirements.

Safeguards data integrity by careful source document review, source document verification, query generation, and resolution against established data review guidelines on Fortrea or client data management systems.

Confirms Site Regulatory documents and applicable eTMF/Sponsor Documents are complete and current throughout the duration of the trial.

Guarantees that the study Investigational Product inventory and accountability is accurate and that study materials are stored securely and per protocol requirements.

Ensures adherence to global quality control and CRA performance metrics.

Ensures audit readiness at site level.

Acts in the project role of a Lead CRA as assigned.

General On-Site Monitoring Responsibilities:

Ensure the study staff who will conduct the protocol have received the proper materials and instructions to safely enter subjects/patients into the study. Ensure the protection of study subjects or patients by performing eligibility review, verifying that screening, informed consent procedures and protocol requirements are adhered to according to the applicable regulatory requirements.

Ensure the integrity of the source data reported by careful source document review. Monitor data for missing or implausible data.

Ensure study data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and compliance; identify deficiencies, deviations and discrepancies, and initiate corrective action as required.

Ensure the resources of the Sponsor and Fortrea are spent wisely by performing the required monitoring tasks in an efficient manner, according to SOPs and established guidelines, including managing travel expenses in an economical fashion according to Fortrea travel policy.

Travel, including air travel, may be required and is an essential function of the job.

Prepare and submit accurate and timely trip reports.

Independently perform eCRF review, 100% source data verification, query generation and resolution against established data review guideline with or without direct supervision, on Fortrea or client data management systems, as assigned by management.

Assist with the administration of clinical research projects, recruiting investigators (if applicable), collecting investigator documentation and site management.

Update, navigate, and maintain Fortrea or study/Sponsor-specific trial management tools/eClinical systems.

Track IP shipments and supplies, as needed.

Track and follow-up on serious adverse events as assigned.

Work closely with the study team, align monitoring to critical study timelines ensuring study deliverables are met.

Prepare and implement study-specific monitoring plans and site Initiation slides, as assigned.

Attend investigators’ meetings (if applicable), project team meetings and teleconferences, and others as needed.

Present training content for site initiation.

Assist with training of new employees (e.g., co-monitoring).

All other duties as needed or assigned.
 

Experience & Qualifications (Minimum Required):

University or college degree, or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriately accredited institution (e.g., nursing licensure). AND

A minimum of 1 years of Clinical Monitoring experience.

Thorough understanding of ICH GCP Guidelines and understanding of local regulatory requirements.

Thorough knowledge of monitoring procedures.

Basic understanding of the clinical trial process.

Fluent in local office language（Cantonese/Mandarin) and in English, both written and verbal.

Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.

Job Overview: 

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Manager of Clinical Research to lead and execute our clinical study programs. This role is pivotal in designing, managing, and delivering high-quality clinical evidence to achieve regulatory approvals (PMDA,CE,FDA), support product commercialization, and contribute to scientific publications. The ideal candidate is a proactive leader with a deep understanding of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), medical device regulations, has worked with CRO in clinical trials execution and has experience in managing clinical trials from concept to closure.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Strategy & Study Design

Contribute to the development of the global clinical evidence strategy for new and existing products.

Lead the design and development of clinical study protocols, case report forms (CRFs), statistical analysis plans (SAP), and other key study documents.

Conduct feasibility assessments for new clinical programs.

Study Execution & Management

Manage the end-to-end execution of multiple clinical studies, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with all regulatory requirements and company SOPs.

Select, manage, and oversee Contract Research Organizations (CROs), central labs, and other vendors to ensure high-quality performance.

Serve as the primary point of contact for clinical investigators and site staff.

Regulatory Compliance & Documentation

Ensure all studies are conducted in accordance with ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, and all applicable global regulations.

Manage the preparation and submission of essential documents to IRBs/ECs and regulatory authorities.

Manage regulatory agency and notified body inspections on clinical studies

Data Management & Analysis

Oversee clinical data management activities to ensure data integrity and quality.

Collaborate with biostatistics to analyze and interpret clinical data.

Author, review, and finalize clinical study reports (CSRs).

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Provide leadership, mentorship, and direction to junior clinical team members.

Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders including Corporate Affairs, Investor Relations, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Medical Affairs.

Manage the clinical study budget and resources effectively.

Present clinical strategy and study updates to senior management.

 

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in a Life Science, Nursing, Engineering, or related field. Advanced degree (MS, PhD, MD) highly preferred.

Minimum of 5+ years of direct experience in clinical research within the medical device industry (experience with Class II/III devices is essential).

Proven experience leading and managing all phases of clinical studies (feasibility, start-up, execution, close-out).

Demonstrated success in contributing to regulatory submissions (PMA, 510(k), IDE, EU MDR) and interacting with regulatory agencies (FDA, notified bodies).

Deep knowledge of ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, FDA 21 CFR Parts 812, 50, 54, 56, and EU MDR regulations.

Strong experience in vendor and CRO management.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience authoring protocols, reports

Valid GCP certificate

2026 Management Trainee 

 

RD Technologies - a dynamic fintech company based in the heart of Hong Kong. With a vision to revolutionize cross-border payments and digital finance, we are on a mission to make financial transactions seamless, affordable, and inclusive for businesses everywhere. We are actively driving the adoption of AI to enhance payment efficiency, strengthen compliance, and deliver smarter financial solutions to our clients. 

RD is backed by a strong group of investors, including ZA Global, HongShan (HSG), China Harbour, Hash Global, and Bright Venture. To date, we have successfully raised approximately US$47.8 million to accelerate the development of our stablecoin infrastructure and B2B payment solutions. 

We are here to bridge Web 2 and Web 3. If you are passionate about Web 3, fintech, and AI, and have an entrepreneurial spirit, we invite you to join our 2026 Management Trainee Programme – our second MT cohort. 

 

Targeted start date: 2 July 2026 

Programme duration: 2 years 

Rotation: 4 departments 

 

What you will learn and gain: 

 

Department Rotation – Actively rotate across four departments over two years (six months each), gaining hands-on exposure to how each function operates both independently and as part of an integrated fintech ecosystem- Business & Partnership, Product, Technology, Risk & Compliance, Operations, Legal, and more.  
AI-Informed Projects: Actively participate in departmental projects and initiatives with an AI/automation focus (e.g., AI-enabled research, workflow optimization, and supporting AI-ready product/operations). 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve strategic goals, including AI-related use cases and data-driven improvements. 
Data & AI Analysis: Analyze data and provide insights to support decision-making; contribute to basic AI/ML exploration where relevant (e.g., prompting, experimentation, and evaluation of AI outputs). 
Training & Workshops: Attend training sessions and workshops to enhance professional skills. 
Rotation Deliverables: Present findings and recommendations to management after each rotation, including AI-driven opportunities, learnings, and recommendations. 

Who you are: 

Bachelor’s degree (fresh graduate) in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Business, Legal, or related fields.  
Interest in AI (including LLMs and automation), Web3.0, Blockchain technology, Fintech, RWA and the digital payments industry. 
Strong analytical and research skills, with attention to detail. 
Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working in a startup environment. 
Excellent command of English and Chinese (both written and spoken). 
Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills. 

 

Brownie points:  

If you have done AI projects or you consider yourself an AI enthusiast. 
Related background and interest in Web 3. 
A team player who is curious about everything.  

 

RD Culture and Benefits: 

 

Competitive renumeration. 
Opportunities to work in a prestigious company within the Fintech industry and be a part of a winning team to bridge Web 2 and Web 3. 
Access to a structured training & development program and mentorship from management and industry veterans. 
Opportunities for professional development and potential pathways to permanent roles within the company. 
Exciting and collaborative startup environment. 
Excellent company culture: give your best while having fun, personal growth and career development.  
A flat structure: your ideas will be heard by the right people very quickly. 
Casual dress code. 
Free coffee, tea, drinks, fruits, and snacks daily. 
In-house gym facilities. 
Regular and fun company activities. 

  

By submitting your application, you have agreed that RD can process your application with an Applicant Tracking System, and you are agreeing that AI can:  

 

Read your resume and cover letter for keywords, skills, and experience. 
Rate your application against job requirements to determine if you move forward. 
Store and transfer your data within their systems, potentially using third-party AI vendors. 
Create summaries of your profile or infer characteristics about your suitability 

Interested parties, please submit your update resume asap.

full_jd:
GENERATION HONG KONG: THE NEW EDUCATION TO EMPLOYMENT NON-PROFIT PLATFORM

ARE YOU OUR MATCH?

Generation Hong Kong is not the typical non-profit organization (NGOs) that you could imagine. Instead, we’re a fast-growing non-profit start-up that doesn’t only solve problems but also drive system changes in the education to employment space. We are a team of passionate individuals coming from different backgrounds and professions, from commercial to education and non-profit sectors. "Better our Best" is our value that brings us all together. If you are open-minded, agile and want to drive changes at a deeper systemic level, this is the place that feels like home.

WHO WE ARE

Generation is an independent nonprofit founded in 2014 by McKinsey & Company to help bridge the education to employment gap - at speed and scale. We have trained and graduated 140,000+ people into careers across 17 countries with diverse social, economic, and labor-market contexts. Lingnan University is one of the eight publicly funded institutions in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) of the People’s Republic of China (PRC) and has the longest established tradition among the local institutions of higher education. Lingnan University offers undergraduate, taught postgraduate, and research postgraduate programmes in the Faculties of Arts, Business, Social Sciences, and the Schools of Data Science, Graduate Studies and Interdisciplinary Studies. title: Marketing & Product Development Manager/Assistant Manager (Knitwear)
snippet: Join us if you are an experienced Design/Marketing & Product Development Manager (Knitwear) with a passion for fashion and desire to strive higher!
label: 市场
full_jd:
Are you an experienced Design/Marketing & Product Development Manager or Assistant Manager with a passion for fashion and a deep understanding of Knitwear? Do you thrive on developing new business opportunities, driving effective communication between teams, and formulating marketing strategies that achieve business objectives? If so, we want you to join our team!

About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Knitwear Design Manager / Assistant Manager to lead and drive innovation in our knitwear product strategy and seasonal development. This role will work closely with our in-house knitwear factory and technical team, guiding product development from yarn development and swatches through knitting, stitching, and full garment design. The objective is to strengthen our sweater development capability, improve factory execution, and expand business opportunities through market-led trend and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

1) Product Strategy Identification

Understand and analyze knitwear requirements across diverse markets including US, EU, Asia, and China domestic.

Identify knitwear product strategies aligned with corporate direction and commercial goals.

Build a holistic product development map and maintain a structured project pipeline.

2) Design & Development

Translate the project pipeline into:

Seasonal yarn collections

Swatch books

Seasonal knitwear collections

Develop precise tech packs and CADs to support merchandising, sampling, and execution with accuracy.

Ensure garment design feasibility by integrating technical considerations early (yarn, gauge, stitch structure, finishing, and construction methods).

3) Cross-Functional Collaboration (Factory + Tech + Sales)

Collaborate closely with factory merchandisers and the technical team to deliver innovative knitwear on time.

Work with the sales team to ensure designs are responsive to customer needs while still meeting quality and margin targets.

4) Bridge Role Between Sales and Merchandising

Act as a key liaison by translating customer and sales feedback into actionable design direction for merchandising and product development teams.

Support development of customer-requested styles while protecting product integrity, feasibility, and price architecture.

5) Corporate Promotion & Market Support

Support corporate promotional initiatives such as trade shows and digital marketing campaigns.

Provide expertise to support customers with their brand requests.

Requirements

Knitwear Design Manager

Bachelor’s degree in Fashion Design, Textiles, Knitwear, or related field.

Minimum 8 years design experience, including knitwear.

Strong technical knowledge of:

yarn counts

gauges

stitches / knit structures

knitting construction and garment finishing

Proficient with design tools including:

Illustrator / Photoshop

AI design tools

Assistant Manager (if less experience)

Relevant degree preferred.

At least 5 experience in knitwear design (or equivalent).

Demonstrated technical capability in yarn/gauge/stitch knowledge and ability to support tech packs and swatches.

Software proficiency in Illustrator/Photoshop/AI and willingness to develop CAD capability.

Location: Hong Kong based, frequent travel to Hangzhou

Competencies (Preferred)

Strong product and trend insight with market-oriented mindset.

Ability to lead development planning and pipeline management.

Excellent communication and cross-team collaboration.

Hands-on technical problem solving.

High Fashion Group values its employees and provides a competitive salary package, comprehensive benefits, and a supportive work environment. In this role, you will have the opportunity to plan and implement proactive promotional activities for the assigned target audience to create market demand and need for specific features or products. You will be mainly accountable for:

Supporting the team for the technical submission, product application, technical query handling.

Implementing proactive promotional activities, including technical presentations, demonstrations, seminars, educational material, and technical development of projects and solutions for the customer target group.

Support for the product quality & related record & reporting issue, troubleshooting & provide the advice/solution for customer to fixing the product application related issue.

Establishing and maintaining effective long-term relationships with target group customers to understand their needs and to ensure they are well-informed of the ABB product, systems, services offering, features, and benefits.

Ensuring efficient marketing activities and strong value proposition to customers by using effective promotional techniques.

Qualifications for the role

You are highly skilled in Low Voltage Electrical distribution & protection product & solution .

Working as Engineer/other related Technical role with 5 years’ experience in Electrical distribution & protection solution / industry

Degree or relevant cert/diploma with rich experience in electrical, building service are preferrable.

Familiar with the HK & Macau Local electrical market & work practice,

You are passionate about problem solving and make it works.

Possess an enhanced knowledge of electrical knowledge, MS office, CRM, AutoCAD.

Holder of Registered Electrical Worker (Grade A or above) is an advantage.

You are at ease communicating in English, Cantonese & Mandarin.

More about us
ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and
manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Cultural sensitivity and openness

Training and structured feedback sessions throughout the programme (no experience or teaching certificate required)

Opportunity to receive a scholarship for pursuing professional educator qualifications

Career mentorship, professional development workshops, and networking events

Opportunities to work on a number of community projects outside of school

Two-year contract, and guaranteed salary progression

An active social community

Welfare and emergency support

Duties: Tenable from September 2026, the appointees will deliver quality teaching to students in the following subject(s) of English related courses:

Academic English

Communications

Linguistics/Applied Linguistics

English Literature

Vocational English

They will assist in curriculum design and development of course materials, programme and course management, organise co-curricular activities, support College promotion and admission activities as well as to perform other academic and administrative duties.

Requirements:  Candidates should have a postgraduate degree in a relevant discipline (a doctorate would be an added advantage) with 2 years’ teaching experience preferably at tertiary level and experience in course development/administration.  In possession of teaching-related qualifications (e.g. TEFL/ TESOL) is essential for the subject of Academic English.  Preference will be given to candidates who possess demonstrated experience in course leadership, curriculum design and development of test papers and course/teaching materials.  Experience and skills in the use of AI tools and applications will be an advantage.

 

Candidates with less experience will be considered for the grade of College Assistant Lecturer.

Terms of Appointment: Salary placement will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.  The contract will normally be for 2 years with the possibility of renewal subject to review.  A contract-end gratuity (taxable) will be payable upon satisfactory completion of the contract.  Medical and dental benefits, 18 days’ annual leave and the use of library facilities will be provided where applicable.  The School also provides staff development opportunities.

 

Applications:  Please send application quoting the reference number to the Human Resources Unit, HKU SPACE, Suites A & B, 12/F, United Centre, 95 Queensway, Admiralty, Hong Kong.  You may apply online or download an application form at http://hkuspace.hku.hk/jobs or request one by fax (85•) •••• •271.

Closing Date for Applications: 18 May 2026

The information provided in an application will only be used for the purpose of consideration for appointment by HKU SPACE.  Applicants not contacted within 8 weeks from the closing date may assume that their applications are unsuccessful.  Unsuccessful applications will be kept for a maximum period of 24 months.
