WHO ARE WE?
At the Hong Kong Tourism Board, we are passionate about showcasing our city as a must-visit destination. Renowned for its iconic skyline, culinary wonders, and rich cultural tapestry where East meets West, Hong Kong is a bustling metropolis that offers extraordinary experiences to a diverse array of travelers. As we seize new opportunities to enhance our city's global appeal, we remain committed to promoting Hong Kong's unique charm and vibrancy, reinforcing its reputation as a world-class destination. We invite passionate talents to join our dynamic and fun team in achieving this vision.
  
HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE AND LEARN?

Plan and implement new cross-industry collaborative approaches and programs that generate business opportunities, including both funding and non-funding support for travel trade partners in promoting Hong Kong

Establish and maintain strong partnerships with travel trade stakeholders to secure their support for HKTB initiatives, tactical activities or events, while facilitating their promotional efforts

Collect market intelligence, identify potential issues and sentiment, and analyze feedback from travel trade and markets on promotional programs to derive insights and provide strategic recommendations for program enhancements

Leverage resources and experience to monitor progress and conduct timely analytical evaluations of trade development programs, ensuring the most effective promotions are delivered

Provide thought leadership across Head Office and overseas teams in formulating impactful consumer and trade development programs in Hong Kong and overseas, such as travel missions, trade shows, and familiarisation programs, to convert visitor interest into business in line with strategic directions

Support the planning, organization, and execution of ad-hoc marketing activities as assigned by the Senior Manager

Supervise, coach, and develop team members in the execution of their duties, assist in their career development, and ensure succession planning is in place

Manage the marketing budget, oversee reporting, and contribute to the formulation of the Business Plan

Undertake any other duties and assignments as directed by the Senior Manager

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

University degree holder with at least 8 years of marketing, sales, or business development experience in the tourism industry preferred, including at least 2 years at the managerial level

Strong knowledge of the travel industry and tourism products in Hong Kong

Analytical, with strong problem-solving and project management skills

Mature, able to multi-task, work independently, and perform well under pressure

Excellent interpersonal skills; self-motivated, proactive, and capable of building strong relationships and negotiating effectively with both internal teams and external stakeholders

Highly proficient in MS Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

title: Operations Management – Collateral Management – Team Head
snippet: Team Management: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 6 FTEs, managing day-to-day margin payments and receipts under ISDA/CSA, GMRA, GMSLA, and CCP...
label: 运营
full_jd:
About Us:
Huatai International Financial Holdings Company Limited (“Huatai International” or “the Company”), is the only overseas wholly-owned or controlled subsidiary of Huatai Securities. Huatai International is the Huatai Group’s international arm which plays as a crucial role in the group's internationalization strategy by:
a) not only providing offshore capital market services (and a global business platform) but also provides onshore clients with valuable cross-border capital market services (aligned with the mainland China government’s policies and commercial intentions);
b) actively making use of Huatai Securities’ leading position, distribution network and customer base in mainland China;
c) integrating on a global basis across many jurisdictions and regions, a successful and fully integrated international financial platform with innovative financial services solutions.

Huatai International operates as a holding company for consolidating all of the group’s cross-border businesses and companies under one umbrella, offering a truly unified and international business platform. In recognition of such international strength, the renowned international rating agency Standard and Poor’s has assigned Huatai International a “BBB+” rating (for long term) and “A-2” (for short-term).

Job Description:

Operational Leadership & Trade Management:

Team Management: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 6 FTEs, managing day-to-day margin payments and receipts under ISDA/CSA, GMRA, GMSLA, and CCP rulebooks, ensuring adherence to SLAs and regulatory timelines.
Margin Lifecycle: Oversee the timely issuance and response to margin calls (Initial & Variation), proactively escalating and following up on outstanding calls to minimize credit exposure.
Settlement Integrity: Instruct collateral movements and confirm receipt/release with external counterparties and global custodians (e.g., Clearstream, Euroclear), ensuring accurate settlement of cash and non-cash assets.
Reconciliation: Drive the daily reconciliation of collateral positions and trade populations, ensuring all breaks are investigated and cleared prior to market open.
Strategic & Change Management:

New Product Approval (NPA): Act as the primary Collateral Management representative in internal NPA meeting. Assess the impact of new products/markets on margin frameworks, ensuring robust and controlled workflows are integrated prior to rollout.
Technology & UAT: Supervise team members or directly participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for margin models, workflow queues, and reporting templates; provide final sign-off before go-live.
Process Optimization: Identify manual touch-points and inefficiencies (e.g., high-touch EUC tools). Lead strategic initiatives to optimize the End-to-End (E2E) collateral management processing, leveraging automation and data visualization tools.
Risk & Control:

Exposure Monitoring: Continuously monitor uncollateralized exposures, failed delivery counts, and segregation breaches. Escalate potential risk incidents to senior management immediately.
Regulatory Reporting: Compile and review regulatory returns pertaining to collateral quality, concentration limits, and rehypothecation rights, ensuring compliance with global standards (e.g., Uncleared Margin Rules).
Management Information (MI): Prepare and present daily MI packs to senior management, highlighting key metrics, risk indicators (KPIs/KRIs), and operational performance.

Qualifications:

Minimum 15 years’ experience in Banking Operations, with a minimum of 5 years dedicated specifically to Collateral Management (including management or supervisory experience).

WHO ARE WE?

At the Hong Kong Tourism Board, we are passionate about showcasing our city as a must-visit destination. Renowned for its iconic skyline, culinary wonders, and rich cultural tapestry where East meets West, Hong Kong is a bustling metropolis that offers extraordinary experiences to a diverse array of travelers. As we seize new opportunities to enhance our city's global appeal, we remain committed to promoting Hong Kong's unique charm and vibrancy, reinforcing its reputation as a world-class destination. We invite passionate talents to join our dynamic and fun team in achieving this vision.

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE AND LEARN?

Develop and optimise global content strategy informed by consumer and media data, and by applying best practices and continuously testing tools, formats, and distribution channels.

Lead social media content planning and publishing, and to develop and manage an integrated content calendar. 

Track and monitor performance against set objectives, particularly in awareness and engagement; analyse user behaviour and refine content marketing and advertising plans accordingly. 

Establish benchmarks to measure performance, effectiveness, and return on investment. 

Collaborate with internal teams and external parties to develop and execute high quality campaigns and co-created content programmes. 

Keep abreast with industry, cultural, and social trends to ensure timely, relevant, and effective communications. 

Create, edit, review content and provide guidance and editorial oversight to maintain high‑quality standards and ensure alignment, reflect a consistent brand voice and personality across all content. 

Develop special content campaigns for mega and targeted sectors.

Serve as the subject matter expert in content creation and social/digital storytelling, providing guidance, training, and best‑practice sharing. 

Introduce and implement new tools, technologies, and processes to enhance content creation, distribution, and performance measurement. 

Manage and control the content development budget, prepare annual marketing plan, budget submissions, and regular tracking and reporting required by government bodies and internal stakeholders. 

Undertake other duties or special assignments as required.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

University degree, preferably in Journalism, Marketing, Communications, or a related discipline. 

At least 12 years of relevant experience, with a minimum of 5 years in a managerial role within creative environments such as advertising/digital agencies, content creation, publishing, or related fields. 

In house experience and a proven track record in leading and managing creative teams (e.g. videographers, graphic designers, copywriters) is an advantage. 

Strong storytelling capability, with the ability to distil complex ideas into clear, compelling, and relatable narratives. 

Solid knowledge of best practices across social platforms, emerging technologies, and industry trends in video production and digital storytelling. 

Strong organisational skills with a proactive, problem solving mindset. 

Excellent communication skills, with fluency in written and spoken English and Chinese.

This project examines how macroprudential toolkit—such as LTV/DTI caps, countercyclical buffers, and sectoral capital requirements—shapes financial development and real-economy outcomes. We will build a structured policy database, merge it with market- and macro-level datasets, and estimate causal effects using modern econometric techniques.

We are now looking for a suitable person to fill the following position in the Lee Shau Kee School of Business and Administration:

Part-time Research Associate / Assistant I/II / Technical Assistant (Project No: R2088) (B&A) (Ref.: 26000PU)

Major Duties and Responsibilities

The appointee will be responsible mainly for the following:

Conducting systematic literature reviews on macroprudential policy, financial development, and growth (academic and policy sources);

Collecting, cleaning, and merging time-series/panel data (bank-level, credit, housing, firm outcomes, and macro indicators);

Implementing empirical analyses (e.g., event studies, DiD, panel regressions, SVAR/time-series models);

Building reproducible code and documentation (version control, data dictionaries, replication files); and

Draftinfing concise memos, figures, and tables for working papers and presentations.

Candidates

Candidates should possess the following qualifications, experience and competence:

A current Master’s/PhD student (or strong final-year undergraduate) in economics, finance, public policy, data science, or related field;

Solid econometrics skills and experience with Stata, R, or Python (pandas/statsmodels);

Proven data cleaning/merging skills and attention to detail;

Strong research writing ability in English;

Coursework or prior work on macroprudential policy, banking, or housing markets;

Familiarity with Hong Kong’s financial system and HKMA publications;

Experience with time-series econometrics (VAR/SVAR, ARDL, unit root/cointegration tests); and

Ability to read Chinese-language policy documents.

Terms and Conditions for Appointment

Successful candidate will be appointed on a temporary part-time contract. Benefits will be provided in accordance with the statutory provisions.

title: Senior UX Writer & Content Designer - Global Bank - J12825
snippet: You will be embedded directly into agile product squads, ensuring that every touchpoint across the bank's digital channels speaks the user's language.
label: 内容
full_jd:
About the Client: We are representing a premier global technology consulting powerhouse partnering exclusively with one of the world’s most prestigious international banks. As part of a massive, multi-year digital transformation initiative, this banking client is entirely overhauling its customer-facing mobile and web applications to deliver a frictionless, world-class digital experience. You will be joining an elite, heavily invested digital hub where design and user experience are treated as the ultimate competitive advantage.

The Role & Landscape: As a crucial member of the Digital Experience team, you will not just be writing copy; you will be designing with words. You will be embedded directly into agile product squads, ensuring that every touchpoint across the bank's digital channels speaks the user's language.

Journey Mapping & Content Design: Craft clear, concise, and customer-centric microcopy, error messages, onboarding flows, and transactional content across web and mobile.

Translation of Complexity: Act as the ultimate translator, taking highly complex financial concepts, regulatory requirements, and technical jargon and turning them into intuitive, user-friendly language.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with UI/UX Designers, Product Managers, and Software Engineers to embed content seamlessly into end-to-end user experiences.

Strategy & Standardization: Contribute significantly to the overall design system, defining content standards, tone of voice guidelines, and scalable UX writing practices.

Data-Driven Iteration: Support and leverage user research, A/B testing, and usability insights to continuously optimize content effectiveness and drive engagement.

What We Are Looking For:

Experience: 4 to 8 years of dedicated experience in UX Writing, Content Design, or Digital Copywriting, ideally within complex digital product environments (FinTech, Banking, or Enterprise E-commerce).

Language: Complete professional fluency in written and spoken Chinese (mandatory) and English.

Technical Literacy: Familiarity with modern design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma) and experience working within Agile/Scrum delivery models.

Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating your ability to solve complex UX problems through content, with clear examples of before-and-after journey improvements.

Mindset: A passionate user advocate who relies on data and user testing to validate content decisions, rather than just intuition.

Why Apply To This Role: This is an incredibly rare opportunity to leave your fingerprint on a digital banking platform used by millions on a daily basis. If you are frustrated by red tape and want to work in an environment where UX writing is given a seat at the table alongside product and engineering, this is the platform for you. You will enjoy excellent corporate backing, a modern tech stack, and a highly collaborative, forward-thinking team culture.

If this outstanding opportunity sounds like your next career move, please submit through "Apply Now" or send your resume in Word format to Danny Kwan at res•••@pinpointasia.com and put Senior UX Writer & Content Designer - Global Bank - J12825 in the subject header.

Let Your Career Begin With UPS

UPS - the world's largest package delivery company and a global leader in supply chain services, offering an extensive range of options for synchronizing the movement of goods, information and funds. Headquartered in Atlanta, UPS serves more than 200 countries and territories worldwide.

Assistant Manager, Buildings and Systems Engineering

Job Summary:

The Project Engineering Supervisor is a member of the UPS Building and Systems Engineering (BaSE) department.  This position directly manages construction projects of low to moderate complexity and risk (i.e., conveyor installations and facility modifications) or assists the Project Engineering Manager in highly complex projects.  Projects may involve building construction, package sortation equipment or both. He/She ensures adherence to contract documentation, scheduled timelines, and cost control parameters.  This position may develop project documentation (e.g., Request for Appropriation project scope of work, estimates, drawings, etc.).  This person will work at the project site.

Responsibilities:

Completes the bid package process (e.g., bid creation, bid evaluation, background check, bid award, etc.) to select the most competitive bid and competent vendor for contracts (e.g., soils, survey, conveyor, conveyor electrical, etc.).
Requests and evaluates bids and proposals according to competitive bid, background check, and competence of identified vendors to recommend the awarding of contracts.
Develops project schedules to ensure adherence to deadlines.
Investigates mechanical breakdown problems (e.g., conveyor system failures, operator errors, system design flaws, etc.) to prevent a decrease in productivity and efficiency.
Identifies areas for construction process improvement and design solutions to achieve optimal package flow efficiency.
Evaluates budget performance, analyzes sources of surplus, and negotiates with vendors to prevent future changes to project scope.
Maintains cost log and project management checklist, processes invoices, and releases funds to contractors to facilitate and document project completion.
Conducts construction inspections of materials and installations to ensure performance meets UPS standards, repairs are completed within scheduled deadlines, and quality materials are utilized.  

Requirements:

Bachelor’s Degree or International equivalent in Engineering or related field with minimum 5 years relevant experience
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both English and native language of project site if different than English
Experience evaluating bid proposals
Previous experience assisting with managing building construction or large industrial installations. - Preferred
Experience with designing solutions for process improvement
Proficient in 2D AutoCAD
Flexibility to work weekends
Ability to travel

Term Assistant Lecturer

Shine Skills Centre (Tuen Mun)

Major Duties:
(a)  To perform teaching duties for Office and Library Practice and other related activities, including supervision of students’ projects, fieldwork placement and outreach training;
(b)  To organise extra-curricular activities for students with Special Educational Needs (SEN) and undertake teaching-related administrative duties, including the preparation of training materials, student assessment, and maintaining training-related records;

(a)  A recognised degree or a professional qualification in Business Administration, Library Management, Education, Special Educational Needs (SEN) Education or related discipline preferably with a post-graduate qualification;
(b)  Good presentation, teaching and facilitation skills in both English and Chinese;
(c)  A good team player with the ability to work independently under pressure;
(d)  Preferably with some relevant teaching and / or field experience in conducting vocational skills training and / or developing new training programmes for students with SEN; leading discipline projects and student services, and / or experience in academic programme administration; and
(e)  Knowledge and experience in working with students with SEN will be an advantage.

Company Overview: 

TradingKey is a one-stop financial markets platform that is dedicated to helping provides investors and traders with the right tools and insights. Our purpose is to make smarter and more informed decisions. 

TradingKey provides education, news and analysis to customers and users targeting at the global market. The websites offer comprehensive financial education, real-time market analysis, and simulated trading tools across various markets. It will also provide interactive learning courses to enhance users' trading skills and knowledge. 

We’re looking for an Audience Engagement Editor to be part of a team of writers and editors that produce content targeting an international audience, focusing on US stocks, commodities and cryptocurrencies.

This is a role for someone who can own their output, move with shifting priorities, and hold a clear editorial standard across everything they do. You’ll work closely with our editorial team in Shenzhen and freelance writers all over the world, helping to grow a more engaged and connected readership.

Job Responsibilities 

Produce, write and edit content for Tradingkey’s site with search engine optimization (SEO) principles.

Coordinate with editorial team to distribute TradingKey content across social media channels such as Reddit.

Identify opportunities to experiment with other social platforms to better reach and engage relevant audiences.

Engage with TradingKey’s communities on social media outlets and drive discussions in financial markets.

Evaluate pitches and content from freelance writers and manage their output.

Manage publication schedule of all Tradingkey content.   

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills 

At least three years of experience in financial content writing and editing.

A degree in communications, media studies, English, or marketing is preferred, however, those with relevant experience will also be considered for the role.

Excellent English language writing and verbal skills, some proficiency in the Chinese language and other foreign languages would be advantageous

Strong knowledge of analytics tools such as Google Analytics, AI tools such NotebookLM and Perplexity and must be open to learn new tools in content production.

Strong understanding of SEO best practices, and experience with relevant tools.

Track record of engaging and growing diverse audiences, with an emphasis on financial content that resonates with different cultural and geographic groups.

Active on social media and deeply embedded in internet culture, with an understanding of how to leverage trends and digital communities to grow audiences.

Familiarity with emerging digital platforms and trends in media, with a strong desire to experiment and innovate in how content is shared and consumed.

Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively in both remote and in-person team environments, fostering collaboration across departments.

A team player, able to work collaboratively and is open to feedback to materialize the ideas that the organisation wants to communicate

A proactive contributor who takes initiative and ownership of projects and able to work on multiple projects concurrently

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. All personal data collected will be treated in strict confidence and be used solely for recruitment purpose.

full_jd:
About Hong Kong Genome Institute

The Hong Kong Genome Institute (HKGI), established and wholly owned by the Hong Kong SAR Government, commenced full operations in 2021.  With the vision “to avail genomic medicine to all for better health and well-being” and supported by the Health Bureau, HKGI works in close collaboration with the Department of Health, Hospital Authority, medical schools of local universities and other stakeholders to accelerate the development of genomic medicine in Hong Kong along four strategic foci: integrate genomics into medicine, advance research, nurture talents and enhance public genomic literacy.

As the first step towards achieving its vision, HKGI launched the Hong Kong Genome Project (HKGP) in 2021. As the city’s first large-scale genome sequencing project, HKGP serves as a catalyst to benefit patients and their families with more precise diagnosis and personalised treatment through whole genome sequencing. It also aims to establish genome database of the local population, testing infrastructure and talent pool to address the healthcare needs of Hong Kong in the long run. 

For more information, please visit www.hkgp.org.

Research Assistant (Laboratory)

Report to Single-Cell Sequencing and Multi-omics Scientists, the incumbent will assume the following responsibilities:

Key Responsibilities:

Perform molecular biology techniques under supervision and guidance to support research projects, including protein detection/validation and mammalian cell culturing

Participate in the end-to-end specimen workflow, including registration, processing, storage, retrieval, and preparation for downstream studies

Support daily laboratory operations, including equipment maintenance, inventory management, procurement of reagents, and quality assurance  

Maintain accurate and organised laboratory records, ensuring timely data entry, document management, and upholding data integrity in accordance with established laboratory policies

Support laboratory logistics, including the receipt of specimens from collaborators and providing clerical support for specimen collection

Perform any other duties assigned by senior officers

Requirements:

We are seeking a high-calibre candidate for the post of Junior Research Assistant (Laboratory) who possesses:

A bachelor’s degree or above in Biomedical Sciences, Genetic Sciences, Health Sciences, Biological Sciences or a relevant life science field

Up to 2 years of hands-on lab experience (fresh graduates are also welcome)

Essential knowledge in molecular biology techniques, including:

Nucleic acid extraction and quantification

Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) and product analysis

Real-time quantitative PCR (qPCR)

Western blotting (WB)

Mammalian cell culturing

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

Good command of written Chinese and English, and fluency in spoken Cantonese

A proactive mindset, keen attention to detail, and the ability to execute tasks precisely after instruction

A team-oriented mindset and a commitment to continuous learning within a dynamic research setting

Office Location:

Hong Kong Science Park, Shatin

Remuneration:

Successful candidate will be offered attractive remuneration and be appointed on an initial two-year contract (subject to mutual agreement for contract renewal).

Application:

Interested parties should send full resume enclosing current and expected remuneration together with availability to HKGI on or before 22 May 2026. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Established in 1974, Computime has grown from a maker of electronic timing devices into a leading global technology, brand, and manufacturing company focused on smart and sustainable living. Headquartered in Hong Kong, the Group operates 20 offices and manufacturing sites across Greater China, Southeast Asia, the EU, the UK, and North America.

Computime serves global brands through two core segments: Control Solutions and Branded Business. The Control Solutions segment provides end‑to‑end engineering and manufacturing services across industries such as HVAC, appliances, water and air management, industrial controls, and medical devices. With strong R&D and proprietary IP, Computime helps partners accelerate time‑to‑market and develop industry‑leading connected products.

The Branded Business segment offers integrated products and ecosystems in HVAC, smart home, EV charging, security, and energy management. Its solutions are marketed worldwide under the SALUS and Braeburn brands, while its consumer division—Computime Brands—features the ntve home brand for smart home and security products. The C Plus J platform further enhances the Group’s capabilities in AV systems, EV charging infrastructure, robotics, and smart building IoT applications.

Management Trainee Program – 3 Streams

Habib Bank Zurich (Hong Kong) Limited, a Restricted Licence Bank

HBZHK is a subsidiary of Habib Bank AG Zurich, a Swiss-headquartered, global banking group with a presence in 11 countries. Since its incorporation in Hong Kong in 1979, the Bank specialises in providing customized trade finance solutions, with a diverse range of products and services.

Rooted in Swiss precision and excellence, and enriched by Hong Kong's vibrant diversity and innovation, we embody a global perspective and high standards. Our commitment to providing our clients with the highest quality of service is reflected in our work. Our team is composed of forward-thinking individuals who drive our rapidly evolving business to new heights.

We strive to make our colleagues feel accepted, fostering a naturally diverse team made up of an eclectic mix of experienced experts and fresh thinkers that thrives on varied perspectives and innovative thinking. We provide a comprehensive benefits package, competitive compensation, and continuous learning opportunities to support your personal and professional growth.

We invite applications from high caliber, dynamic professionals to be part of its team as:
 

Title: Management Trainee (2026 Programme)
Position Reports to: Relevant Head of Department 
Location: Hong Kong 
Duration: 24-months rotational based Programme 

Currently Recruiting for : Branches (Client Services), Transactional Banking Services (Operations) and Finance

Position Summary: 
As a Management Trainee, you will be part of our 24 months rotation-based programme, which offers a comprehensive and dynamic learning experience across various departments within the bank. This program aims to provide you with a deep understanding of our operations, products, and services while developing your leadership and management skills. Successful completion of the program will open up career advancement opportunities within the bank.

Key Responsibilities:
• Rotate across different functions, including, Branches (Relationship Management, Client Services), Compliance, Credit Risk Management, Finance, Financial Institutions, Treasury and Transactional Banking Services whilst maximum time in your home department to gain exposure of various operations of the bank.
• Collaborate with department teams to actively participate in day-to-day activities and projects, allowing you to gain hands-on experience in different areas.
• Assist in conducting market research and analysis to identify emerging trends and opportunities in the banking industry, contributing to the development of innovative strategies and initiatives.
• Work closely with cross-functional teams to and propose operational and process improvements to drive operational excellence.
• Participate in training and development programs to enhance your knowledge of banking products, services, and industry best practices. 
• Undertake ECF and professional certifications like GTC, UCP 600, CTFP and others relevant.
• Actively engage in networking opportunities to build relationships with colleagues, mentors, and industry professionals, fostering professional growth and development.
• Stay updated with industry trends, regulatory changes, and market developments to contribute to the bank's strategic decision-making process.

Knowledge and Skills:

• Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as Business Administration, Risk Management, Operations/Information Management, Finance, Economics or related disciplines.
• CFA/CPA candidates is an added advantage 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically.
• Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
• Demonstrated interest in the banking industry and eagerness to learn.
• Attention to detail and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
• Flexibility and adaptability to work in different teams and departments.
• Prior internship or work experience in a related field is a definite advantage.
• Candidates with maximum 2 years of work experience are eligible to apply. 
• Permanent residents of Hong Kong or holding a valid Hong Kong work visa.

Interested parties are invited to apply by sending your resume with full details of education, work experience, current & expected salary, contact telephone number and earliest available date to email. Habib Bank Zurich reserves the right not to make appointment for the post(s) advertised.

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. title: Game Story Writer & Chinese Curriculum Designer (Fresh Grad welcome)
snippet: Creative writer & curriculum designer to build an RPG-based Chinese learning world through storytelling, lore, and character design.
label: 翻译
full_jd:
About the Project

We are not building a flashcard app. We are building a genre-defining RPG that disguises a comprehensive Chinese dictionary as a game mechanism that helps Chinese Diaspora kids to learn Chinese reading and writing.

The Role

We are looking for a visionary Game Story Writer & Chinese Curriculum Designer to act as the Loremaster of our universe. You will be responsible for mapping out the precise pedagogical sequence of our vocabulary while simultaneously writing the epic lore that makes the kids care about learning it. You will bridge the gap between rigorous academic curriculum and AAA-quality fantasy storytelling.

Core Responsibilities

Curriculum Sequencing: Review and structure our core database of 1,500 Chinese characters and their associated word corpus (compounds and idioms). You will map out the ultimate learning sequence, ensuring a logical progression of radicals, stroke difficulty, and conceptual grouping.

Lore & Worldbuilding: Write the overarching narrative of the game.

Character Design: Give personality, backstory, and thematic identity to the heroes, linking their in-game lore directly to the etymology and meaning of their assigned Chinese characters.

Required Qualifications

Academic Foundation: Degree in Chinese Language, Chinese Literature, Linguistics, or a closely related field.

Storytelling Chops: Proven experience in creative writing, whether that is writing novels, short stories, screenplays, or game lore. You know how to craft a hook and build a compelling world.

Cultural Authority: A deep, intuitive understanding of Chinese culture, history, mythology, and literature.

Systems Thinker: You don't just write fluff; you can organize massive spreadsheets of vocabulary and map them logically.

Bonus Points (The "Unicorn" Skills)

GenAI Proficiency: You are highly skilled at using Generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney) to rapidly prototype dialogue, expand lore outlines, or generate concept art references.

Visual Arts / UI Sensibility: You have an eye for design, illustration, or UI/UX, and can collaborate seamlessly with our visual artists to ensure the text matches the aesthetic.

Gaming Literacy: You play RPGs, deck-builders, or gacha games and understand concepts like "Min-Maxing," "Buffs/Debuffs," and "Lore-Gameplay Integration."

Why Join Us?

You will not be writing dry sentences for a generic workbook. You will be building a world that helps thousands of diaspora children connect with their cultural heritage without the tears, the boredom, or the kitchen-table arguments.

Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute (ASTRI) is founded in 2000 by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. This role is strengthened through its merger with Nano and Advanced Materials Institute (NAMI).

Committed to bringing high‑impact research from lab to market, ASTRI advances interdisciplinary, market‑driven R&D that delivers practical innovations for industry and meaningful benefits for society.

Its technological strengths and capabilities enable AI‑powered, cross‑disciplinary ICT and advanced materials solutions across Smart City, Financial Technologies, Digital Health and Life Sciences, New Industrialisation and Intelligent Manufacturing, Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (ASIC) and Advanced Electronics, New Energy and Energy Storage, and Green and ESG Technologies.

Over the years, ASTRI has cultivated a strong pool of I&T talent and earned numerous international awards for its pioneering innovations and contributions to industry and the community. Following the merger with NAMI, ASTRI’s cumulative global patent portfolio has grown to over 1,500, with more than 2,200 technologies successfully transferred to industry.

With enhanced scale and capabilities, ASTRI is uniquely positioned to elevate Hong Kong’s innovation capacity, accelerate technology commercialisation, and drive societal and economic progress through world‑class applied research.

To support our constant endeavour to position Hong Kong as a world-class smart city and an international hub of innovation and technology, we are seeking qualified professionals to fill the following position(s):

• Promote, market and commercialize the technologies and products to be developed through the projects

• Master's degree or above in the Electronics Packaging, Materials Science & Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or related disciplines

• In-depth understanding of the technology development trend and the entire semiconductor and/or new energy product development cycle, from package design, materials selection, manufacturing process, system integration, to product qualification is a must

• Good written and communication skills in English

TSG owns the key controls within trade support operations, and acts as the coordinator for day-to-day booking & break resolution functions.

In the Operations division, we partner with business units across the Firm to support financial transactions, devise and implement effective controls and develop client relationships. This is an Associate level position within the Product Support & Services, which is responsible for providing transaction support and managing post execution processes.

Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

What you'll do in the role:
New product setups and trade capture within the Firm's upstream risk management systems and downstream sub-ledger for products issued by MS entities.

Lifecycle management & event notification for OTC & Structured Products, calculation of complex product payoffs.

Partner closely with Sales & Trading on desk and client queries or ad-hoc requests.

Liaise with external issuing and paying agents (IPAs) & clearing houses to process payments and settlements related to Structured Products.

Perform daily reconciliation and clearance of position, product & internal accounting breaks that ultimately affect the MS balance sheet.

Ensure identification, timely escalation & resolution of control related issues.

Develop and maintain detailed desktop procedures outlining the team's activities.

Generate & implement business process improvements including automation, capacity enhancements, control framework and new business initiatives.

Generate metrics and KRI/KPI reporting for global operations senior management.

What you'll bring to the role:

Previous experience in Trade Support function is highly preferred.

Understanding in equity derivative products and their lifecycle.

Strong organizational, analytical, communication skills.

Ability to meet strict deadlines in a fast-paced environment and deliver results under stress.

Ability to understand complex problems and grasp new concepts quickly.

Ability to think laterally and recognize opportunities for system/process improvement.

At least 4 years' relevant experience would generally be expected to find the skills required for this role

full_jd:
營銷經理 Marketing Manager（家族辦公室 / 金融服務）

主要職責

內容策略與品牌建設

● 制定並執行公司整體內容營銷策略，圍繞家族辦公室核心業務構建具有專業深度與品牌調性的內容矩陣

● 策劃及製作高品質的品牌宣傳材料（包括但不限於短視頻、圖文資訊、案例分享、行業觀點等），確保內容精準傳遞公司專業形象與核心價值

● 建立並持續優化品牌視覺體系與內容標準化規範，確保所有對外傳播渠道的品牌一致性

社交媒體運營與IP孵化

● 統籌公司社交媒體平台的日常運營（包括但不限於小紅書、微信公眾號、抖音、Instagram、Facebook等），制定內容日曆與發布策略

● 主導公司品牌IP及核心團隊成員個人IP的孵化與運營，構建可複製的IP孵化方法論，持續放大品牌影響力

● 緊密結合業務場景，策劃具備行業洞察力的專題內容與系列選題

投流與數字營銷

● 負責社交媒體廣告投放策略的制定與執行，管理投放預算，實時監控投放效果並進行數據驅動的優化調整

● 打通內容策劃、生產、分發到投流轉化的完整鏈路，建立基於ROI的營銷效果評估體系

● 定期產出數據分析報告，深入分析內容表現、受眾畫像與轉化數據，為後續策略迭代提供數據支撐

AI工具應用與內容生態構建

● 主導AI自動化工具在內容生產與管理流程中的落地應用，提升團隊內容產出效率與質量

● 推動公司內容資產管理系統的建設，以模塊化思維管理與存儲各類數字內容資產，提升內容復用率

● 持續關注前沿AI技術與數字營銷工具，探索新技術在家族辦公室行業營銷中的創新應用

行業活動與市場推廣

● 策劃並執行線上線下品牌推廣活動（包括行業講座、客戶研討會、媒體發布會等），提升公司在香港家族辦公室及高淨值圈層中的品牌知名度與行業影響力

● 收集並分析市場趨勢、競爭對手動態及客戶需求變化，為公司營銷策略與業務決策提供市場情報支持

任職要求

1. 市場營銷、新聞傳播、影視製作、商業管理或相關專業本科及以上學歷

2. 5年以上內容營銷、品牌推廣或數字營銷相關工作經驗

3. 具備短視頻內容策劃、拍攝製作及社交媒體投流運營的實戰經驗，熟悉短視頻從選題策劃到後期製作及投放轉化的全鏈路管理

4. 具有金融服務、保險理財或高端服務行業的營銷經驗者優先

5. 精通各類社交媒體平台的運營規則與算法機制（包括小紅書、抖音、Instagram、Facebook等）

6. 熟練掌握主流AI內容創作工具（如AI輔助文案、剪輯、圖片生成等），具備將AI技術融入內容生產流程的實踐經驗

7. 具備扎實的數據分析能力，能熟練使用各平台數據分析工具，基於數據做出營銷決策

8. 具備優秀的文案撰寫能力及視覺審美能力，能準確把控品牌調性與高端客戶溝通風格

9. 對財富管理及家族辦公室行業有興趣，願意持續學習行業知識並轉化為高質量營銷內容

snippet:
To cope with the expansion of our company, we are looking for potential applicants to join us.

full_jd:
Overview:
To be an Office Assistant, you will be responsible in front desk operations in a professional manner with positive thinking mindset. Friendly, outgoing, and approachable, have strong communication and organizational skills. Also, would be patient, attentive, and able to handle multiple tasks and potentially stressful situations with a calm and composed demeanour. 

Key Responsibilities:

Handling front desk operations – answering calls, greeting visitors, and managing visitor records.

Managing meeting room bookings, beverage arrangements, and equipment setup.

Keeping meeting rooms, office areas clean and tidy.

Arranging courier services maintaining package records and handling outdoor delivery tasks.

Managing office supplies and consumables – ordering, inventory, basic equipment maintenance, filing, and data entry.

Maintaining accurate filing systems.

Performing additional ad-hoc tasks as assigned by management.

 Qualifications/Requirements

High school graduate or above

At least 1 year office assistant experience

Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Teams/SharePoint

Strong multitasking and prioritization skills

Self-motivated, responsible, independent, and a good problem-solver

Well-organized, open-minded, eager to learn, and a collaborative team player with a positive "Can-Do" attitude

Must be fluent in Cantonese and have fair Mandarin and English skills.

Immediate available is preferable

We offer attractive remuneration, double pay, discretionary performance bonus, group medical insurance to the right candidate. Interested parties please send your full resume with date of availability, present and expected salaries to us via JobsDB.  

概述： 

作為辦公室助理，您將以專業、正面思維負責前台日常運作。我們期望您為人親切、外向且易於接近，具備良好的溝通及組織能力，並能耐心細心，在繁瑣工作及壓力情況下保持冷靜應對。

 主要職責： 

負責前台工作，包括接聽電話、接待訪客及登記訪客資料 

負責會議室預約、茶水安排及設備設置

維持會議室及公司環境整潔 

安排速遞及戶外送遞，管理包裹紀錄 

辦公用品及消耗品管理、訂購、庫存、簡單設備維護、文件歸檔及數據輸入

妥善及準確儲存檔案系統

其他由管理層指派的臨時工作

任職要求： 

中學程度或以上 

至少一年相關辦公室助理經驗 

熟悉 MS Word、Excel、PowerPoint 及 Teams/SharePoint 

具備良好的緩急輕重及優先次序處理能力 

積極主動、負責、能獨立工作並善於解決問題 

有良好組織能力，願意學習，團隊合作精神及有積極正面態度 

你必須會說流利粵語，及備有基本普通話及英語溝通能力

可即時上班者優先考慮

title: Business Operation Officer (Retail & E-commerce)
snippet: Join the dynamic team at Point S Hong Kong, where innovation meets action! You’ll be at the forefront of e-commerce and automotive services.
label: 运营
full_jd:
Overview

We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented, and creative Business Operation Officer (Retail & E-commerce) to join our growing team at Point S Hong Kong. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in a startup environment, enjoys taking on challenges across departments and evolving the industry, and wants to gain hands-on experience in operations and digital commerce.

You’ll play a key role in ensuring smooth day-to-day operations in both online and offline channels — from online order fulfillment to participating the optimization of our customer experience in both channels. This position offers broad exposure across business functions, making it ideal for professionals looking to grow in both operations and retail within the automotive and e-commerce industries.

Key Responsibilities

Manage order processing, after-sales service, and ensure a smooth O2O shopping experience across retail and online channels.

Coordinate and communicate closely with warehouse, logistics, and retail departments to ensure smooth stock movement, promotions, and store operations.

Support the execution of promotional campaigns (online and offline), including Site updates, omni-channel promotional materials and events.

Assist in formulating operation policies and ensure a smooth and effective workflow between parties.

Conduct competitor research, market benchmarking, and contribute ideas to improve operation efficiency and customer experience.

Participate in cross-department projects to streamline workflows and implement process improvements.

Be part of a dynamic startup culture where continuous learning, flexibility, and new ideas are encouraged.

主要職責

負責訂單處理與售後服務，確保線上線下（O2O）購物體驗順暢完善。

積極協調與倉庫、物流及零售團隊，確保庫存運轉、促銷活動及店舖營運順利進行。

支援線上及線下的市場推廣活動，包括網站內容更新、全渠道促銷素材與活動執行。

協助制定營運政策與流程，提升各部門間的工作效率與協同效果。

進行市場與競爭分析，提出創新建議以改善營運效率及顧客體驗。

參與跨部門專案，持續推動流程優化與業務改善。

加入充滿活力的初創團隊，在靈活與創新的工作氛圍中不斷學習與成長。

Requirements

2–3 years of relevant experience preferred; candidates with both operations and e-commerce exposure are a plus.

Strong communication, coordination, and organizational skills.

Proficient in Excel; experience with Shopify, social media, or digital marketing tools is an advantage.

Detail-oriented, independent, and adaptable in a fast-paced, startup environment.

Good command of Cantonese and basic English.

Passion for the automotive industry and interest in cross channel growth will be highly valued.

職位要求

具 2–3 年相關工作經驗（具營運及電子商務經驗者優先）。

具良好溝通、協調及組織能力。

熟悉 Excel；了解電子商務平台或數碼推廣工具（熟悉 Shopify 更佳）。

細心、有責任感，能主動並適應快節奏創業環境。

良好的廣東話及基本英語能力。

對汽車行業及電子商務、推廣營銷有熱誠者優先考慮。

full_jd:
About Hong Kong Genome Institute

The Hong Kong Genome Institute (HKGI), established and wholly owned by the Hong Kong SAR Government, commenced full operations in 2021.  With the vision “to avail genomic medicine to all for better health and well-being” and supported by the Health Bureau, HKGI works in close collaboration with the Department of Health, Hospital Authority, medical schools of local universities and other stakeholders to accelerate the development of genomic medicine in Hong Kong along four strategic foci: integrate genomics into medicine, advance research, nurture talents and enhance public genomic literacy.

As the first step towards achieving its vision, HKGI launched the Hong Kong Genome Project (HKGP) in 2021. As the city’s first large-scale genome sequencing project, HKGP serves as a catalyst to benefit patients and their families with more precise diagnosis and personalised treatment through whole genome sequencing. It also aims to establish genome database of the local population, testing infrastructure and talent pool to address the healthcare needs of Hong Kong in the long run. 

For more information, please visit www.hkgp.org. 

Senior Research Assistant (Laboratory)

The Senior Research Assistant (Laboratory) will be responsible for supporting cutting-edge research projects, executing molecular biology workflows, and playing a key role in the optimisation and development of advanced protocols.  

Report to Single-Cell Sequencing and Multi-omics Scientists, the incumbent will assume the following responsibilities:

Key Responsibilities:

Perform and optimise molecular biology techniques to support research projects, ensuring high standards of experimental accuracy and robustness

Support the optimisation and development of advanced protocols to improve experimental efficiency and data quality

Assist in setting up new technology platforms (e.g. proteomic profiling system) and help standardise workflows for high-throughput analysis

Assist in managing the end-to-end specimen workflow, including registration, processing, storage, retrieval, and preparation for downstream studies   

Analyse experimental data, present findings, and communicate effectively with internal research teams

Maintain precise laboratory records and ensure data quality and integrity in accordance with established laboratory policies

Coordinate laboratory logistics, including the receipt of specimens from collaborators, and liaison for specimen collection

Perform any other duties assigned by senior officers

Requirements:

We are seeking a high-calibre candidate for the post of Senior Research Assistant (Laboratory) who possesses:

A master’s degree or above in Biomedical Science, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Immunology, or a relevant life science field

At least 3 years of hands-on experience in a research laboratory environment

Solid hands-on experience in core molecular and protein analysis techniques, including proficiency in:

Nucleic acid extraction and quantification

Genotyping and Isoform detection (e.g., by PCR)

Gene expression profiling by real-time quantitative PCR (qPCR)

Protein detection, quantification, and analysis by Western Blotting and ELISA

Demonstrated experience in at least one of the following areas:

Inducible pluripotent stem cells (iPSC) culture and maintenance.  Experience in differentiation, functional characterisation, or therapeutic discovery will be an advantage

High throughput proteomic profiling and data validation

Single-cell and spatial multi-omics technologies

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for data analysis and reporting

Good command of written Chinese and English, and fluency in spoken Cantonese

Experience contributing to manuscript preparation, research proposals, grant applications or IRB submissions is preferred

A proactive mindset, keen attention to detail, and strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a commitment to supporting multiple projects and research goals

Office Location:
Hong Kong Science Park, Shatin

Remuneration:

Successful candidate will be offered attractive remuneration and be appointed on an initial two-year contract (subject to mutual agreement for contract renewal).
 

Application:

Interested parties should send full resume enclosing current and expected remuneration together with availability to HKGI on or before 22 May 2026. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Data collected will be used for recruitment purpose only.

DETERMINANT creates engineered essentials for those who lead with intention. We create clothes that are thoughtfully designed, sustainably made, and built to simplify life without compromising on style or integrity. Every piece is engineered for clarity, versatility, and confidence - made to move with you, wherever you're headed.

Retail Trainee Program

Are you a recent graduate passionate about fashion and people, but unsure where to start your career? Our exclusive 18-month Retail Trainee Program is designed to fast-track your growth into a future retail leader. This is not just a job, it's an immersive journey into the heart of our dynamic business across two of Asia's most vibrant retail hubs: Hong Kong and Singapore.

You will gain hands-on, frontline experience in every aspect of modern retail operations, from customer service to data analytics, while developing the cross-cultural agility essential for today's global market. This program is your direct pathway to leadership, with high-performing trainees being promoted to Assistant Store Manager upon graduation.

What You Will Experience & Achieve:

This structured rotation is designed to build a holistic skill set:

Sales Leadership: Drive sales by converting foot traffic, mastering upselling techniques, and contributing to team targets. Gain exposure to shift coordination.

Data-Driven Retail: Learn to analyze sales reports and customer data to generate actionable insights for business improvement.

Local Market Mastery: Analyze and adapt strategies for different Hong Kong retail landscapes (tourist hubs vs. residential areas, malls vs. department stores).

Customer Service & Styling: Become an expert brand ambassador, providing exceptional service, personalized styling advice, and professionally handling customer feedback.

Store Operations: Master daily procedures, including opening/closing, cash handling, visual merchandising standards, and loss prevention.

Inventory & Supply Chain Insight: Work with the buying team to monitor stock levels, perform replenishment, and understand the cycle from warehouse to shop floor.

Market Adaptation: Deep-dive into Singaporean consumer behavior, exploring preferences, omnichannel shopping habits, and seasonal trends.

Cross-Cultural Retail Practice: Hone your ability to adapt communication and service styles for a diverse clientele. Act as a cultural bridge, sharing best practices between our HK and SG teams.

Who We Are Looking For:

High Diploma or above in any discipline; backgrounds in Business, Fashion, Hospitality, or Marketing are a plus).

Current frontline retail sales who are seeking to leverage their hands-on skills into a formal management and leadership role.

Individuals genuinely curious about fashion, retail dynamics, and career growth, even if their path isn't yet defined.

Good command of both spoken and written Cantonese, English and Mandarin

A customer-centric mindset with exceptional interpersonal and communication skills.

Resilience, adaptability, and a strong willingness to learn from the ground up.

Open to travelling to Singapore for business and training purposes.

Ready to Define Your Future in Retail?

If you are eager to learn, thrive in fast-paced environments, and want to build a meaningful career with a global perspective, we want to hear from you!

You may learn about DETERMINANT at https://detshirts.com

full_jd:
About Hong Kong Genome Institute

The Hong Kong Genome Institute (HKGI), established and wholly owned by the Hong Kong SAR Government, commenced full operations in 2021.  With the vision “to avail genomic medicine to all for better health and well-being” and supported by the Health Bureau, HKGI works in close collaboration with the Department of Health, Hospital Authority, medical schools of local universities and other stakeholders to accelerate the development of genomic medicine in Hong Kong along four strategic foci: integrate genomics into medicine, advance research, nurture talents and enhance public genomic literacy.

As the first step towards achieving its vision, HKGI launched the Hong Kong Genome Project (HKGP) in 2021. As the city’s first large-scale genome sequencing project, HKGP serves as a catalyst to benefit patients and their families with more precise diagnosis and personalised treatment through whole genome sequencing. It also aims to establish genome database of the local population, testing infrastructure and talent pool to address the healthcare needs of Hong Kong in the long run. 

For more information, please visit www.hkgp.org.

Summer Internship Programme 2026 (Corporate Communications) 

The HKGI Summer Internship Programme offers a unique opportunity for passionate and aspiring students to gain valuable experience and industry insights in genomics and related fields.  The programme offers students the opportunity to explore the operations of the Hong Kong Genome Project (HKGP), working with a team of highly professional and experienced professionals.

We are seeking passionate students eager to develop their careers in genomics and related fields.  Successful candidates will be assigned to the Corporate Communications team.

Key Responsibilities

Assist in the content development, design and production of HKGI corporate publications and multimedia content, including videos and social media materials such as the Annual Report and LinkedIn updates

Conduct industry research; draft and translate promotion materials to publicise HKGI’s work

Support the planning, logistics and coordination of stakeholder engagement initiatives

Support daily news and social media monitoring

Provide administrative support, including record management and general daily operations

Participate in specific projects as required

Undertake any other duties as assigned by mentors 

Requirements

Residents of the HKSAR and lawfully employable in the HKSAR

Keen to learn and work in genomics and related fields

University students majoring in Communications, Languages, Journalism, Public Relations, Marketing or related disciplines

Self-starter with positive attitude and a high sense of responsibility

Proficient in Microsoft Office and Chinese word processing; experience with graphic design and video production tools (e.g. Canva, Adobe Premiere) is an advantage

Proven academic excellence and performance

Good organisational, communication and interpersonal skills

Good command of written and spoken English and Chinese

Office location:

Hong Kong Science Park, Shatin

Programme Duration: 

Successful candidates will receive four to eight weeks of on-the-job training at the Hong Kong Genome Institute between June and August 2026, with a monthly allowance to be determined by the HKGI.  The internship period may be extended subject to HKGI operational requirements and candidates’ availability.

title: Assistant Logistics Manager

full_jd:
This logistics role oversees end‑to‑end logistics operations across JEB’s businesses, including import, export, re‑export, warehousing, customs compliance, multimodal transportation, and regulatory requirements.
This role ensures the cost‑effective, compliant, and timely movement of materials and finished goods from factories to final destinations. We are looking for a responsible, hands‑on individual with a strong passion for global logistics and distribution.
The ideal candidate is highly accountable, dependable under pressure, and willing to go the extra mile to ensure smooth shipment execution, compliance, and warehouse operations. This role requires discipline, resilience, proactive action, and a strong can‑do mindset.

Major Responsibilities
• Execute multimodal transportation, logistics, and distribution operations, including sea, air, land, and storage.

• Stay up to date on trade policies, tariffs, anti‑dumping measures, sanctions, and regulatory requirements based on different goods and HS codes.

• Optimize routing and shipment consolidation to balance cost, speed, and reliability, and provide logistics options to meet tight project timelines.

• Propose logistics solutions and alternatives to management and clients to mitigate delivery and delay risks.

• Manage shipments, inventory, and samples accurately and in a timely manner.

• Work closely with freight forwarders, truckers, factories, customs brokers, warehouses, and internal and external stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely execution.

• Experience with 3rd Party Logistics manage Oversee and manage 3PL (third-party logistics) providers to ensure service quality, cost efficiency, and compliance with company standards.

• Coordinate and supervise customs clearance processes, ensuring timely documentation, regulatory compliance, and smooth import/export operations.

Qualifications & Experience
• 6–10 years of progressive experience in regional logistics, supply chain, or manufacturing industries.

• Bachelor’s degree in Logistics/Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or related discipline.

• Proven hands‑on experience managing import, export, and re‑export operations, including regional and global customs compliance.

• Experience with metals, building materials, finished goods, or project‑based logistics is highly preferred.

• Practical experience working with factories, freight forwarders/3PLs, distribution centers, and customs brokers, particularly in China, Thailand, India, and other regions.

• Strong analytical, problem‑solving, and negotiation skills, with proficiency in Microsoft applications (e.g. Excel) and simple programming (e.g. Marco/VBA/Phylon).

• Team player with high attention to detail with a CAN-DO mindset.

• Ability to manage multiple stakeholders across countries and cultures.

• Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, project‑driven and industrial environment.

Linklaters Business Services (H.K.) Limited
Marketing & Events Senior Advisor, Hong Kong
Purpose

Your role will be to lead the execution of local marketing initiatives, including events, that align with Firm and client and sector strategies, as well as global/regional marketing priorities. You will play a key role in adapting and activating global and regional marketing activities for local impact, ensuring relevance and impact while collaborating with marketing colleagues in other countries to share best practice and improve efficiency.

Your key responsibilities

Deliver high-impact, high-quality local marketing activities across various channels to engage target audiences, strengthen brand awareness, and support the client and sector strategy.
Localise global and regional marketing initiatives, ensuring targeting, content, and execution resonate with the local market while maintaining strategic alignment.
Plan, organise, and execute local events to the highest standards, enhancing client engagement and positioning the Firm as a market leader.
Manage local sponsorships and partnerships, strengthening existing relationships and identifying new opportunities that align with the Firm's brand and strategy.
Analyse local market trends and client insights, using data to shape messaging, refine targeting, and optimise marketing effectiveness.
Adapt and help to manage local social media and digital content, ensuring alignment with local trends while upholding the Firm's brand identity and global standards.
Develop insightful reports and presentations, tracking key marketing performance metrics and identifying drivers of success.
Monitor and engage in digital conversations relevant to the Firm's brand, providing insights and recommendations to enhance reputation and engagement.
Identify and integrate emerging marketing trends, ensuring the local strategy remains innovative and competitive.
Work seamlessly with stakeholders across the Firm and across Business Teams to ensure the smooth execution of marketing activities and sharing of best practice.
Collaborate with regional and global marketing teams to access tools, templates, and expertise.

Your experience

Proven experience in marketing and events management, ideally in a professional services or corporate environment.
Strong track record of executing marketing activities that drive engagement and brand awareness.
Demonstrated ability to plan and deliver high-quality events, from conception to execution, with a focus on client engagement.
Experience managing sponsorships and partnerships, including evaluating opportunities and building strategic relationships.
Strong analytical skills with experience using data-driven insights to refine marketing strategies and measure effectiveness.
Hands-on experience managing social media and digital content, ensuring alignment with market trends and brand identity.
Proficiency in developing reports and presentations, with the ability to track key performance metrics and communicate insights effectively.
Experience in monitoring brand conversations and making recommendations for reputation management.
Knowledge of emerging marketing trends and ability to apply innovative approaches.
Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience working cross-functionally and collaborating with regional/global teams.

The Team

You will be welcomed into the BDM function as a key part of the team. BDM is a globally diverse group of specialists dedicated to driving revenue growth, nurturing our priority client relationships, and strengthening the firm's reputation.

In this role, you will be supported by and collaborate closely with the local team and the broader BDM function. Our team thrives on a collegiate atmosphere with a strong focus on teamwork and collaboration with colleagues.

Alongside our lawyers, the BDM function is committed to creating, developing, and executing business development and marketing initiatives that drive growth and align with the firm's strategic goals.

The role within BDM promises a diverse array of tasks and projects.

You will encounter significant opportunities for learning and growth within a nurturing and supportive environment. We look forward to expanding our team with individuals who share our drive, forward-thinking mindset, and enthusiasm.

The Hong Kong Jockey Club

Job description:

The Hong Kong Jockey Club

Founded in 1884, The Hong Kong Jockey Club ("the Club") is a world-class racing club that acts continuously for the betterment of our society. The Club has a unique integrated business model, comprising racing and racecourse entertainment, a membership club, responsible sports wagering and lottery, and charities and community contribution. Through this model, the Club generates economic and social value for the community and supports the HKSAR Government in combatting illegal gambling.

The Division

The Security, Integrity and Information Security ("SIIS") Division is responsible for the preservation of integrity by combatting criminality and corruption risks that can threaten horse racing, betting, and membership at the Club. The maintenance of a secure environment and integrity is key to our business. Not only is it important to ensure horse racing in Hong Kong is fair, it is also of paramount importance to the Club that there is governance and fair opportunities in all bet-placements. The department consists of Integrity & Financial Crime Risk, Racing Security & Integrity Assurance, Corporate Security and Information Security Risk & Assurance functions.

The job holder reports to the Senior Manager, Due Diligence. He/she is responsible for daily administrative and operational support to the Due Diligence (DD) team. ASIC design, FPGA prototyping, AI algorithm design;

Strong programming skills of at least one of the following languages: Verilog/VHDL, System Verilog, Python, C/C++, Matlab;

R&D experiences of using Cadence and Synopsys EDA tools or machine learning frameworks such as Caffe, Tensorflow and PyTorch.

Executive Officer I/II, Office of EMBA(Chinese) Programme (Ref. 260000SD) (Closing date: May 29, 2026)

The CUHK Business School is a leading business school and a pioneer in business education in Hong Kong. Since its establishment in Hong Kong in 1963, the CUHK Business School has gained world recognition of nurturing business leaders with immense contributions in Asia Pacific. The School has been offering a comprehensive range of undergraduate and postgraduate programmes with over 5,000 students from 30+ countries/regions, as well as executive education. It has one of the most extensive alumni networks in the region, with over 47,000 alumni around the world.

 

Among all the postgraduate programmes offered by the School, the EMBA (Chinese) Programme is a highly selective programme that aims to attract highly motivated professionals in the business sector. This part-time programme caters to the needs of working professionals in Hong Kong, mainland and the region whose needs are centered on leadership development.

 

The CUHK Business School now seeks to appoint a high calibre candidate to the position of Executive Officer in the Office of EMBA (Chinese) Programme.  Reporting to the Director of EMBA(Chinese) Programme and/or Functional Manager, the appointee will be responsible for (a) developing and executing branding content strategies for the Programme, including but not limited to editorial planning for Programme website, official social media accounts, video storytelling, and students' success features; (b) curating and leading the creation of compelling written and visual content that effectively showcases the Programme’s unique value proposition, student journeys, and Hong Kong experience; (c) designing and organising student experience initiatives that connect current students to resources external and internal to CUHK; (d) building and maintaining relationships with external stakeholders to create meaningful touchpoints for students’ professional development; (e) collaborating with internal academic units to facilitate students’ access to university-level resources and research strengths; (f) supporting partnership and corporate engagement efforts relate to student experience enrichment, to build pipelines for high quality candidates and enhance brand synergy; (g) collecting and reflecting student feedback to continuously improve branding and experience initiatives; and (h) performing other impromptu duties as assigned by the supervisor. Working at flexible hours and business travel outside Hong Kong will be required.

 

Applicants should have/be (i) a Bachelor’s degree or above in Marketing, Business Administration, Journalism, Communications, or a related discilpine; (ii) fulfilled the English language requirements set out on the webpage: https://www.hro.cuhk.edu.hk/en-gb/languageforeo; (iii) at least 8 years (for Executive Officer I) or 5 years (for Executive Officer II) post-qualification executive experience in branding, content creation, digital media, or event management, ideally within top business schools in Asia; (iv) demonstrated ability to initiate and sustain partnerships with diverse stakeholders; (v) the ability to work independently and under pressure; (vi) a collaborative team player, (vii) prior experience in business school/executive programmes setting is highly advantageous; (viii) excellent interpersonal and communication skills; and (ix) fluency in Cantonese, Putonghua, and English. Shortlisted candidates may be invited to sit for a written test and/or interview, as appropriate.

 

Applicants must submit copies of certificates showing that they have fulfilled the language requirements and academic qualifications stated above, otherwise their applications will NOT be considered.

 

Appointment will initially be made on a 2-year contract with contract-end gratuity commencing as soon as possible, renewable subject to good performance and mutual agreement.

 

[CUHK Business School is also known as the Faculty of Business Administration.]

 

The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for the post above via the CUHK career site. For more information and to apply online, please visit http://career.cuhk.edu.hk.

＜THE HISTORY AND VISION OF Onitsuka Tiger＞

Onitsuka Tiger was born in 1949 as a sports shoe brand. The company continued to evolve until 1977, actively incorporating innovative ideas and technologies. Company description:

The Hong Kong Jockey Club

Job description:

The Hong Kong Jockey Club

Founded in 1884, The Hong Kong Jockey Club ("the Club") is a world-class racing club that acts continuously for the betterment of our society. The Club has a unique integrated business model, comprising racing and racecourse entertainment, a membership club, responsible sports wagering and lottery, and charities and community contribution. Through this model, the Club generates economic and social value for the community and supports the HKSAR Government in combatting illegal gambling.

The Division

The Corporate Affairs (CA) Division strengthens the strategic development and positioning of the Club as a world-class racing club and charity organisation, through engaging key stakeholders in both Hong Kong and the Mainland, and maintaining efficient and effective corporate communications.​​​

Job Summary

The job holder contributes to strengthen the strategic development and positioning of the Club as a world-class racing club, charitable and sports organisation, through engaging key stakeholders. The job holder also assists in formulating and executing stakeholder engagement strategies to build up relationships with the Government, political parties, different tiers of councils, key district and community stakeholders, as well as supporting the Club's betting businesses. The job holder's responsibilities may include preparing materials for meetings with stakeholders, advising on event attendance, and coaching team members.

The Job
Assist in developing and implementing comprehensive stakeholder engagement strategies to develop an effective and reliable network of relationship with stakeholders, including government officials, members of different tiers of councils (i.e. Legislative Council and District Councils), political parties' members, district and community stakeholders.
Assist in organising stakeholder engagement activities, briefings, meetings and/or volunteer programmes for government officials, council members, political parties' members, district stakeholders or other external and community stakeholders in support of the Club's initiatives, operations and related businesses.
Prepare written and presentation materials for the abovementioned engagement activities as and when appropriate.
Assist in handling sponsorship applications and overseeing the execution of sponsored projects and events.
Advise seniors on attendance of stakeholder engagement activities, Club's sponsored projects and events in accordance with relevant district event protocols and local political climate and coach junior team members as and when appropriate.
Ensure compliance with Responsible Gambling Policy (RGP) and all stipulated legal requirements pertaining to wagering, thereby protecting the integrity of the Club's business
Undertake other duties as assigned by supervisors.
About You
A recognised university degree in communications, public relations, public administration, business studies, external affairs and/or any other related discipline
A minimum of 3-6 years' experience working in corporate communications, external relations, government relations, public relations, community engagement, media management and/or journalism, NGOs

title: Education Operations Coordinator/Assistant
snippet: Education Operations Coordinator: top-notch admin & operations, AI-savvy, calm under pressure, big heart. Keep our education team running smoothly
label: 运营
full_jd:
About the Role

This is a hands on operational role for someone who genuinely loves making things run well. Reporting directly to and working closely with the Education Manager, you will handle messages, keep lessons on track, fix problems calmly when they arise, and build the systems and trackers that keep everything organised — so the Manager can focus on the bigger picture and genuinely step away when needed.

We also want someone who uses modern tools, including AI, not just to answer the odd question but to actively streamline workflows, automate repetitive work, and save the team time. A good understanding of our courses, UK admissions and exams is essential so you can act with context and confidence.

Key Responsibilities

Messages & Communication

Act as a reliable point of contact across our communication channels (WhatsApp & email), responding promptly, warmly and professionally.

Triage and prioritise incoming messages — handling the majority directly and escalating only what genuinely needs management.

Communicate clearly with tutors and parents to arrange, confirm and reschedule lessons and consultations.

Live Lesson Support

Keep an eye on scheduled lessons and step in quickly when something goes wrong: technical issues, tutor or student no-shows, last-minute changes.

Be reachable during scheduled lesson times (checked daily via the lesson calendar) to resolve issues fast, on a rotating basis shared with other team members — so coverage never depends on any one person.

Troubleshoot calmly and follow clear escalation guidelines for genuine emergencies.

Administration, Systems & Records

Own the department’s day-to-day admin: scheduling, documents, records, follow-ups and reminders, so nothing slips.

Build, maintain and improve tracking spreadsheets: enquiry and lead tracking, lesson-hour records, billing reconciliation and similar.

Keep data clean, accurate and well-organised across our systems and trackers.

AI & Workflow Improvement

Use AI tools practically to streamline and speed up everyday work: drafting, summarising, organising information, and checking data.

Identify repetitive or manual processes and improve or automate them, including building smarter spreadsheets and trackers.

Help raise the whole team’s efficiency by sharing and applying better tools and workflows.

What We're Looking For

1+ years in a strong administrative, operations or coordination role. You are exceptionally organised, accurate and dependable.

Demonstrated, practical use of AI tools to improve real work — not just asking chatbots questions, but using them to streamline workflows, build or check spreadsheets, and save time. (Be ready to give a concrete example at interview.)

Genuinely strong with spreadsheets (Excel / Google Sheets) — comfortable with formulas, tracking systems and clean data structures.

Good understanding of education / UK admissions and exams (boarding schools, interviews, UKiset / ISEB / CAT4 and similar) — or the ability to learn our offering quickly and thoroughly.

Excellent written and spoken English; Cantonese and/or Mandarin highly advantageous given our client base.

Calm and resourceful under pressure — you solve problems rather than escalate them, and you exercise sound judgement on what to handle versus flag.

Responsible, conscientious and not afraid of hard work — you take ownership, you care about doing things properly, and you genuinely have heart for the people you support.

Comfortable being reachable during scheduled lesson times , including some evenings, weekends and public holidays.

Working Pattern

Schedule: Five-day working week. Lesson-time coverage is scoped to the actual lesson schedule (checked daily). Working on Saturdays & Sundays is a MUST. Please only apply if this is fine with you.

Benefits: Annual leave, medical insurance, MPF, and visa sponsorship for the right candidate.

What We Offer

A genuine learning environment: you will work closely with the Education Manager and gain real exposure to UK boarding-school admissions, interviews and entrance exams.

Hands-on experience with modern tools, including AI, that you can use to sharpen your own skills and make your work easier.

Mentorship and close support from experienced colleagues in a small, collaborative team where your work genuinely matters.

A stable, valued role in a growing, premium education consultancy — a place to do meaningful work and be appreciated for it.

To apply, please send your CV and a short note on a process or tool you have improved (bonus points if it involved AI or a spreadsheet you built) to cou••••@academic-asia.com.
