专业要求

机械工程、机电一体化、机器人工程或相关专业

工作职责

Job Title: 研究助理（机械结构工程师） Department: 智能泛在物联网理论与应用学科创新引智基地 111 Center for Theory and Application of Intelligent Ubiquitous Internet of Things(111AIoT), VPR, HKUST(GZ) 工作职责 1. 负责机器人整体机械结构设计，包括本体框架、底盘移动系统、臂架、手部模块及内置测量装置设计与开发。 2. 参与机器人各模块结构方案论证、仿真分析、原型制作及优化，提高机器人稳定性、运动精度与可靠性。 3. 推进零部件选型、加工工艺制定及装配流程设计，确保产品量产可行性。 4. 协同电控、传感器和算法团队完成系统集成，解决机械与其他模块的适配问题。 5. 持续迭代优化机械设计，提升机器人运动精度、负载能力及环境适应性。 6. 编写设计文档、技术规范、测试报告，确保结构设计过程可追溯。 7. 支持产品在研发、试产、量产及后期维护阶段的机械结构相关工作。

任职要求

1. 本科及以上学历，机械工程、机电一体化、机器人工程或相关专业。 2. 3~5 年及以上机械结构设计经验，有机器人（人形、轮式、医护或陪护型）研发经验优先。 3. 精通 CAD/3D 建模软件（如 SolidWorks、CATIA、AutoCAD），熟练使用有限元分析（FEA）工具（ANSYS、Abaqus）进行强度、刚度、振动和疲劳分析。 4. 熟悉金属材料（铝合金、钢）及非金属材料（工程塑料、复合材料）特性及加工工艺，具备工程化落地能力。 5. 了解机器人运动学、动力学及控制原理者优先。 6. 有零部件选型、装配调试、量产工艺经验者优先。 7. 良好的创新思维和问题解决能力，能承受研发节奏和高强度研发任务。 8.具备项目管理能力，能参与产品从概念设计到量产全周期管理。 加分项 1. 有人机交互或医疗/健康机器人产品研发经验。 2. 参与过 RoboMaster、Robocon 或其他机器人竞赛。 3. 熟悉传感器集成、嵌入式结构适配、可拆卸维护设计经验。 4. 有团队协作经验，能跨硬件/软件/算法模块沟通和整合。 HKUST (GZ) is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to our core values of inclusiveness, diversity, and respect.

About the Role

We are not looking for a traditional marketing manager who wants to sit in meetings or reinvent the wheel. We are looking for a Super-Operator.

In this role, you will be the ultimate execution engine. Our strategy and project plans are developed using cutting-edge AI engines and approved by leadership. Your job is to take those approved plans, interface with our AI tools, and execute them with flawless precision, speed, and organization.

This is a 90% remote team. We value asynchronous communication, extreme ownership, and respect for established processes.

Key Responsibilities

Execute AI-Driven Plans: Take approved, AI-generated marketing, sales, and launch roadmaps and turn them into live digital assets, email campaigns, or operational timelines.

E-Commerce & Digital Support: Manage daily updates, product positioning, and campaign setups inside Shopify and our marketing platforms.

Project Coordination: Act as the administrative anchor for major company initiatives, including tracking contractor progress for our upcoming physical Wellness/Foot Rehab Center.

Process Documentation (SOPs): You don't just do a task; you document how you did it using Loom videos and Notion so the system is repeatable.

Cross-Functional Support: Provide operational and data support to our Ad Lead and Affiliate Lead to keep projects moving forward without friction.

What We Are Looking For

High AI Fluency: You don't just use ChatGPT to fix spelling. You know how to prompt Claude, ChatGPT, or Midjourney to analyze data, format tables, write copy, and build checklists at 5x human speed.

Extreme Agency (Resourcefulness): If a piece of data is missing, you don't freeze and wait to be told what to do. You search, leverage AI, find a workaround, and present a solution.

Respect for Process & Authority: You take pride in executing approved strategies exactly as requested. You value strict workflows, clear documentation, and clean professional escalation.

Timezone Discipline: You must be online and deeply focused during Hong Kong business hours (GMT+8).

Communication: Exceptional written English and a comfort with asynchronous communication (Slack, Notion, and sending daily Loom video recaps).

 
CRITICAL: HOW TO APPLY (Read Closely) 

We do not look at standard resumes or generic cover letters. To be considered for this role, you must follow these exact instructions:

Do NOT click the standard "Quick Apply" button.

Send a direct application message to “HR•@barefoot.asia” with the EXACT subject line: Barefoot Operator Found - [Your Full Name]

In the very first line of your message, state:

Which AI tool you used most frequently this week and exactly what you used it for.

Confirm that you are fully available to work on the GMT+8 (Hong Kong) timezone.

Note: Applications that do not follow this exact subject line and layout will be automatically archived by our system without review. If you have the attention to detail we need, we look forward to meeting you!

title: Senior Manager (Brand & Content) - Global Engagement and Communications Office
company: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
snippet: Senior Manager (Brand & Content) - Global Engagement and Communications Office
label: 内容
full_jd:
Position Overview

The Global Engagement and Communications Office is seeking a strategic, creative, and dynamic Senior Manager (Brand & Content) to lead content development and brand promotion for HKUST, with a particular focus on the University's 35th anniversary. In this role, you will be responsible for developing compelling content across print and digital platforms, including a dedicated anniversary book, while helping to elevate and champion the HKUST brand more broadly.

Your primary mission is to craft and articulate a powerful brand narrative for HKUST-highlighting its journey, achievements, and future aspirations-to key stakeholders including alumni, students, faculty, partners, and the public, both locally and internationally. Language proficiency, fast learning ability, and solid experience in brand and communications are essential for success in this role.

Key Responsibilities:
1. Content Development (Print, Digital & Anniversary Book)

Lead the end-to-end development of high-quality content for print and digital platforms, including but not limited to the official 35th anniversary book.
Write, edit, and produce engaging feature stories, institutional messages, historical highlights, and impact narratives that celebrate HKUST's legacy, current achievements, and future vision.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders (faculty, leadership, alumni relations, and GEC colleagues) to source stories, identify key milestones (including the 35th anniversary), and ensure content accuracy and relevance.
Manage external vendors such as writers, editors, designers, and printers for the anniversary book and other print materials.

2. Brand Promotion & Integrated Communications

Develop and execute a brand communications strategy to promote HKUST across multiple channels, with the 35th anniversary serving as a key marquee initiative.
Ensure consistent messaging and visual identity across all content, aligning with HKUST's overall brand guidelines while giving special attention to anniversary-related communications.
Create compelling content for digital platforms including the University website, anniversary microsite, social media (LinkedIn, Instagram, WeChat, etc.), email newsletters, and digital campaigns.
Work closely with the GEC team to integrate both ongoing University messaging and anniversary-specific communications into a cohesive narrative.

3. Stakeholder Collaboration & Project Management

Partner with academic departments, and administrative units to gather content and align communications with institutional priorities, including but not limited to the 35th anniversary.
Manage multiple content projects simultaneously, ensuring deadlines, quality standards, and brand consistency are met.
Provide strategic input on how to best showcase HKUST's achievements to local and international audiences on an ongoing basis, while maximizing the visibility opportunities presented by the 35th anniversary.

4. Performance Tracking & Continuous Improvement

Establish KPIs to measure the reach and engagement of content and campaigns, including those tied to the 35th anniversary.
Use analytics tools to generate insights and refine content strategies for greater impact across all platforms.

Qualifications & Experience

A bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Brand Management, or a related field. A higher degree is preferred.
Minimum of 10-15 years of experience in content development, brand communications, or related roles, preferably within education, publishing, media, or the non-profit/public sector.
Exceptional writing and editing skills are non-negotiable. While native English speaker status is not required, we are open to native English speakers if their experience is relevant. Proficiency in Chinese (Cantonese and/or Putonghua) is highly advantageous but not a must.
Proven experience in developing content for print, digital, and long-form publications such as books or commemorative volumes.
Demonstrated experience in brand promotion and integrated communications across multiple channels.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to work independently, learn quickly, and manage multiple stakeholders.
A fast learner who can quickly absorb and articulate HKUST's history, culture, and achievements.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You are a strategic storyteller who can transform institutional history and achievements into compelling narratives for diverse audiences.
You have a strong command of language and a keen eye for detail, quality, and design sensibility.
You are digitally savvy, content-obsessed, and experienced in producing content that resonates across print and digital platforms.
You are a proactive, results-oriented self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment.
You are a collaborative team player and an influential advisor, able to build strong relationships across the University.
You are excited by the opportunity to contribute to a major institutional milestone-HKUST's 35th anniversary-while also helping to shape and elevate the University's brand.

(Duration: 2 years, with the possibility of contract extension subject to needs)

Starting salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits including annual leave, medical and dental benefits will be provided. A gratuity will be payable upon successful completion of contract.

Please apply on or before: 23 June 2026.

About Social Power

Social Power is a leading social media intelligence agency in Hong Kong, serving a diverse portfolio of blue-chip clients and regional projects across the Asia Pacific.

With 15 years of industry-leading experience, we have evolved alongside the digital landscape. Under the new AI era, we are doubling down on our commitment to intelligent, data-led insights We are an energetic team dedicated to embracing the synergy of AI and human intelligence, offering a workplace where heritage meets innovation. If you are eager to kickstart your career at the intersection of tech, data, and pop culture, you’ll fit right in.

Don't worry if you haven't done this before—we will train you from the ground up. In this role, you will learn how to turn social media buzz into powerful business strategies:

Data Exploration: Learn to mine, process, and visualize data from various social media platforms.

Play with AI: Get hands-on with latest AI tools to automate routine tasks, play with prompt engineering, and make workflows faster.

Trend Spotting: Help craft social media analysis reports that decode what netizens are talking about and why it matters to big brands.

System Operations: Learn the ins and outs of our proprietary social listening and KOL analysis systems.

Brand Monitoring: Keep an eye on real-time internet trends and assist the team in spotting potential online crises early.

Who We Are Looking For

We don’t care about a long list of past technical experience. We care about your drive, your curiosity, and how fast you want to run.

Tech & AI Enthusiast: You don't need to be a coder, but you should have a genuine passion for technology. If you are already experimenting with LLMs/AI tools in your daily life just for fun, you’re exactly who we want.

Curious & Self-Motivated: A proactive learner who isn't afraid to ask questions, try new things, and adapt to a fast-paced environment.

Analytical Mind: You enjoy connecting the dots. You notice trends when scrolling through social media and wonder why things go viral.

Good Communicator: Capable of turning numbers and charts into clear, written "human" stories for our clients.

Experience Levels: Fresh graduates or early-career switchers from any discipline are highly welcome!

Why Join Us?

Work at the forefront of the social intelligence and AI industry.

A culture that values innovation over tradition and efficiency over long hours.

Massive room for career progression as our AI capabilities and team expand.

A supportive environment where "not knowing" is okay, as long as you are eager to learn.

Interested?

Give yourself the opportunity to grow with the future of data. Please send us your application including:

Your Resume

Your Expected Salary

Date of Availability

full_jd:
Lingnan University is one of the eight publicly funded institutions in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) of the People’s Republic of China (PRC) and has the longest established tradition among the local institutions of higher education.  It is widely recognised for providing quality education with a focus on whole-person development and conducting high-impact research for a better world.  Moving forward, Lingnan University is well positioned to take lead as a comprehensive university in arts and sciences in the digital era, with impactful research and innovations.

Lingnan University offers undergraduate, taught postgraduate, and research postgraduate programmes in the Faculties of Arts, Business, Social Sciences, and the Schools of Data Science, Graduate Studies and Interdisciplinary Studies.  To foster interdisciplinary collaboration and scientific progress, Lingnan University established the Lingnan University Institute for Advanced Study (LUIAS), attracting distinguished scholars from around the world to collaborate with its faculty and students.  With traditional strengths in arts, business, social sciences, and interdisciplinary studies, the University aims to equip students with practical knowledge and critical thinking skills to thrive in the future.  Subsequent to the establishment of the School of Data Science and LUIAS, Lingnan University is transforming into a hub for global leaders to develop and promote human-centric technology and social policies.  Further information about Lingnan University is available at https://www.ln.edu.hk/.

·         Experience in community-based or aging-related research is highly preferred.

·         Familiarity with Hong Kong’s healthcare system and elderly population characteristics.

·         Strong written and spoken English; Cantonese proficiency is a strong asset for community interaction.

full_jd:
GENERATION HONG KONG: THE NEW EDUCATION TO EMPLOYMENT NON-PROFIT PLATFORM

We're hiring!

ARE YOU OUR MATCH?

Generation Hong Kong is not the typical non-profit organization (NGOs) that you could imagine. Instead, we’re a ​fast-growing non-profit start-up that doesn’t only solve problems but also drive system changes in the education to employment space. We are a team of passionate individuals coming from different backgrounds and professions, from commercial to education and non-profit sectors. "Better our Best" is our value that brings us all together. If you are open-minded, agile and want to drive changes at a deeper systemic level, this is the place that feels like home.

WHO WE ARE

Generation is an independent nonprofit founded in 2014 by McKinsey & Company to help bridge the education to employment gap - at speed and scale. We have trained and graduated 150,000+ people into careers across 17 countries with diverse social, economic and labor-market contexts. Since 2018, Generation Hong Kong has trained over 1,200 learners in Hong Kong across 7 training programs.

Everything we do is to support underserved individuals into life-changing careers. We believe our proven methodology can eventually serve millions of stakeholders including individuals and employers. We will never be perfect, and we always have more to learn. We use data, experience, and dialogue to grow and improve. And we are collaborating closely with our partners to drive the systemic change in the education to employment space.

WE ARE NOW LOOKING FOR:

Senior Project Officer / Project Officer

JOB OVERVIEW

The Senior Project Officer / Project Officer is a full-time role that will report directly to the Project Manager and is a part of the driving force to shape the project, executing and optimizing program delivery across the learner journey—from recruitment to classroom management to placement and alumni engagement. This role supports the Project Manager in ensuring operational excellence, stakeholder coordination, data tracking, and learner success. The key responsibilities are:

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Overall Project Development & Coordination: Build and implement day-to-day operations and project delivery, including but not limited to handling enquiries, support interviews and analysis to introduce selected professions to target populations, gather alumni feedback for program development, venue booking, material preparation, project documentation, status reports, and other necessary tasks to ensure the goals and objectives are achieved. 

Stakeholder Engagement: Support to engage stakeholders (Funder, Corporate, SME, NGOs, Learner, Alumni); Establish and maintain effective communication channels with stakeholders, including regular updates, meetings, and report; Develop and maintain a database of stakeholder information, including contact details, preferences, and feedback, as well as logistical support for team members.

Recruitment & Selection: Assist in outreach and recruitment efforts, including liaising with community organizations and alumni referrals; Organize info sessions, interview potential candidates, and conduct pre-program follow-ups; Provide ongoing support to learners during enrolment to ensure strong turnout and readiness. 

Event Management and Support: Organize and execute events, workshops, and seminars aligned with program goals; Coordinate participant registration, attendance, and communications before, during, and after events; Follow up with partners post-event to ensure commitments are met and feedback is collected for future improvements.

We're looking for someone who demonstrates the following competencies:

3+ years experience in NGO, education sector, or human resources in Hong Kong, with established networks in these areas

Demonstrated success in project management, alumni relations, event planning, or community building

Track record of meeting deadlines and achieving objectives in a fast-paced environment

Relationship building with diverse stakeholders (funders, NGOs, industry associations, employers, learners and alumni)

Fluent in written and spoken English & Chinese (Cantonese)

Proficient with MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), with data management capabilities being advantageous

Passion for education to employment initiatives and building sustainable impact and communities

Entrepreneurial mindset with adaptability and resilience in a startup environment

Solutions-oriented approach with commitment to excellence and teamwork

Self-awareness and openness to giving and receiving feedback

Immediate availability preferred

Job Description: Sales & Marketing Manager (ASEAN Markets)

Company Overview
We are an established Hong Kong‑based trading company with a wholly owned manufacturing plant in Foshan, specializing in the production of secondary aluminum ingots for domestic and export sales. Our Hong Kong office acts as the group’s central trading, logistics, and finance hub. Building on a stable annual turnover of approximately HKD 4 billion, we are now expanding into the ASEAN region and seek an entrepreneurial, results‑driven sales professional to spearhead this growth.

Job Title
Sales & Marketing Manager (ASEAN Markets)

Work Location
Hong Kong (with regular travel to the ASEAN region as required)

Job Purpose
This is a new role created to develop and capture business opportunities across the ASEAN markets. You will take full ownership of two core product lines: (i) the trading of aluminum zorba (raw material) and (ii) the export of secondary aluminum ingots. This is a highly autonomous position offering a commission‑based remuneration package designed to reward high performance.

Key Responsibilities

Market Development & Sales Strategy: Formulate and execute a comprehensive sales and marketing plan to penetrate ASEAN markets for both aluminum zorba trading and secondary aluminum ingot exports. Identify emerging opportunities, monitor competitor activity, and provide regular market intelligence reports.

Customer Acquisition & Relationship Management: Proactively identify, approach, and secure new customers—including smelters, recyclers, traders, and industrial end‑users. Build and nurture long‑term business relationships with key buyers and suppliers across the ASEAN region.

Trading & Export Operations: Manage the end‑to‑end sales process from enquiry to contract. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery conditions for aluminum zorba and secondary ingot transactions. Coordinate closely with the in‑house logistics and finance teams in Hong Kong to ensure seamless shipment, documentation, and payment collection.

Revenue & Target Achievement: Take full ownership of personal sales targets and revenue goals. The primary compensation is commission‑based, directly reflecting your sales performance and contribution to the company’s ASEAN expansion.

Cross‑functional Collaboration: Liaise with the Hong Kong logistics team on shipment schedules and with the finance department on credit terms and payment arrangements. Provide regular sales forecasts and activity reports to senior management.

Qualifications & Requirements

Industry Experience: Solid sales or trading experience in the non‑ferrous metals, aluminum, or metal recycling industry is highly preferred. Existing knowledge of aluminum scrap (zorba) and secondary aluminum ingots, as well as an established network of buyers in ASEAN markets, will be a distinct advantage.

Track Record: Proven success in a commission‑only or high‑variable‑pay sales environment. Demonstrated ability to independently generate leads, close deals, and achieve ambitious revenue targets.

Market Knowledge: Strong understanding of international trade practices, Incoterms, and cross‑border sales cycles. Familiarity with ASEAN import regulations and market dynamics is a plus.

Language Skills: Excellent command of English and Mandarin is essential. Proficiency in Cantonese or additional ASEAN languages (e.g., Vietnamese, Thai, Bahasa) will be an asset.

Personal Attributes: Highly self‑motivated, entrepreneurial, and resilient. Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Willing and able to travel frequently within the ASEAN region.

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, International Trade, Marketing, or a related discipline is preferred.

Remuneration
This position offers a commission‑based compensation structure, directly aligned with your sales performance. High achievers will be well rewarded.

Job Description

Special educational needs (SEN)/English as an additional language (EAL) teacher provide individual support to pupils with learning difficulties and/or pupils whose first language is not English which prevent them from benefiting from the standard system of education. SEN education helps pupils with specific learning difficulties such as Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), Dyslexia or Dysgraphia. SEN/EAL teachers are responsible for teaching pupils within the class or in a separate class; planning and carrying out lessons and various activities to help engage the students. SEN/EAL teachers must work with an emphasis on meeting the particular needs of their pupils and use a variety of alternative teaching methods to aid the learning process. The teacher must be flexible and highly resourceful. They must learn to alter their teaching style depending on a range of factors, including the age of the pupils, the pupils’ educational placement and individual learning needs. 

Qualification

To qualify as a SEN/EAL Teacher in IMS, you’ll need to achieve a Bachelor Degree in any subjects with PGCE (Postgraduate Certificate of Education), or equivalent SEN qualification or EAL/TESOL Certificate and 2+ years teaching experience within a recognized educational organization experience.

Responsibilities

As an SEN/EAL teacher, you’ll need to

Deliver effective sessions for either individuals or small groups of pupils within, or outside the class

Develop Individualized Learning Plan (ILP) for pupils

Prepare lessons and specific teaching materials

Develop and adapt conventional teaching methods to meet the individual needs of pupils

Collaborate with the classroom teachers and the Learning Support teachers to define appropriate activities for the pupils in relation to the curriculum

Liaise with parents, external agencies and a range of other professionals, such as speech and language therapists and educational psychologists

Provide a clear and constructive feedback to students and their parents/caregivers

Carry out administrative tasks, including updating and maintaining records of pupils’ progress

Skills

You’ll need to

Communicate with the teaching teams in order to be proactive

Build good relationships with pupils and their families

Show initiative and problem-solving skills

Use observant and responsive approach

Responsible for tracking data related to specific ILP goals

Be flexible – it’s important to be able to respond to the needs of the pupils and adapt or change plans accordingly 

Be patience, understanding and empathy with pupils and parents

Have a good sense of humour

Other duties

Demonstrate rapport with, respect for, and kindness toward the students.

Protect the privacy and confidentiality of each student in the school.

Prepare a safe and inclusive environment that caters for the physical, social and mental wellbeing of students within your care.

Attend staff meetings with other teachers to discuss classroom issues and opportunities.  Support Administration staff in planning special meetings as needed.

Support and/or lead whole school events such as Sports Day, Winter Performance, School Camp, Talent Show, Sports Tournaments, Open Day etc.

Willingness to support whole school programmes/initiatives outside direct area of expertise such as Student Council, Junior CAS etc.

Interact and communicate, with the support of the Principal and School Managers, with the PTA in support of PTA events which benefit the children directly or indirectly.

Run Extra Curricular Activities (ECAs) for students to attend after regular school hours, when required.

About Liva Law & Associates

Liva Law & Associates is a boutique Hong Kong law firm. While our core practice focuses on SFC and related regulatory matters, we also handle a broad range of litigation, commercial and general legal work for a diverse client base including licensed corporations, fund managers, companies and individuals.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for a motivated Assistant Solicitor to join our General Practice, working primarily with private clients across a wide range of matters such as personal injury, family, criminal and probate. Given the variety of work we handle, this is an ideal role for someone who enjoys a broad and dynamic caseload, is eager to develop across different areas of law, and takes genuine ownership of their matters.

Skills and experience:

NQ to PQE 2

A keen interest in private client work, including personal injury, family, criminal and probate matters, with the adaptability to handle a varied caseload

Exposure to general civil litigation and/or SFC regulatory matters would be an advantage, though not essential

Strong attention to detail, a proactive attitude, and the ability to see a matter through to completion

full_jd:

Posting Date: 2026-05-26

Technological and Higher Education Institute of Hong Kong

The Technological and Higher Education Institute of Hong Kong (THEi) is a member institute of the Vocational Training Council (VTC), established in 2012. It is an innovative, professional and entrepreneurial organisation committed to greening and sustainability. THEi offers over 20 professional "Applied Science-Oriented" undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes across six Academic Departments: Department of Food and Health Sciences, Department of Construction, Environment and Engineering, Department of Sport and Recreation, Department of Hospitality and Business Management, Department of Design and Architecture, and Department of Digital Innovation and Technology. These programmes integrate theoretical knowledge with practical applications cover industries with growth potential in Hong Kong and the Asia-Pacific region, ensuring that students can apply what they learn effectively. THEi’s undergraduate and postgraduate degree programmes are accredited by the Hong Kong Council for Accreditation of Academic and Vocational Qualifications, as well as by the relevant professional bodies where appropriate. By adopting an applied Science-Oriented teaching approach, THEi equips students with professional skills and knowledge to meet various future challenges upon graduation. THEi also collaborates closely with the industry and engage students in active learning pedagogies including a strong emphasis on project-based learning involving real-world problem-solving with and for local industries and professions.

For more information about our Institute, please visit https://www.thei.edu.hk.

Executive Assistant II (Human Resources Office)

Human Resources Office

Ref No.: HRO/EAII/02/26

Major Duties:

(a) To provide secretarial and administrative support to the Human Resources Office;
(b) To provide support in all-round Human Resources functions, including but not limited to staff recruitment, onboarding & offboarding process and compensation & benefits etc.;
(c) To maintain accurate and updated employee databases and filing records;
(d) To draft simple correspondence, such as emails, letters and notices, etc.;
(e) To assist in HR document management, and the compilation of management reports and statistics;
(f)  To handle the sourcing, ordering and stock management of office supplies; and
(g) To provide logistical support for various boards, meetings and staff activities.

Requirements:

(a) (i) Level 2 or above in 5 subjects, including English Language*, Chinese Language and Mathematics, in the Hong Kong Diploma of Secondary Education (HKDSE) Examination, or equivalent^; OR
     (ii) Level 2 / Grade E or above in 5 subjects including English Language (Syllabus B)*, Chinese Language and Mathematics in the Hong Kong Certificate of Education Examination (HKCEE); OR
    (iii) Diploma of Applied Education + Maths Plus / Diploma Yi Jin + Mathematics / Project Yi Ji; OR
    (iv) A recognised Certificate / Diploma / Foundation Diploma / Foundation Certificate / Diploma of Foundation Studies; OR
    (v)  A recognised Associate Degree / Higher Diploma or above.
* Completion of Hong Kong Vocational English Programme (HKVEP) at Level 2 / Passing 5 specific VTC’s Vocational English Module Certificates is considered an alternative qualification.
^ “Attained” in Applied Learning subjects (subject to a maximum of two Applied Learning subjects), and Grade E in Other Language subjects in HKDSE Examination are accepted as equivalent to Level 2 in the New Senior Secondary subjects.
(b) Proficiency in computer software applications, including MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint and Chinese word processing;
(c) Good communication, interpersonal and organisational skills;
(d) Good command of English and Chinese, preferably including Putonghua;
(d) Flexible, polite, detail-minded, organised and self-initiated;
(e) Demonstrate a strong sense of confidentiality and integrity; and
(f)  Ability to work independently and be a good team player.

Notes:

1. Shortlisted applicants will be required to attend and pass a computer skills test.
2. The appointee may be required to work irregular hours or shifts and perform duties on Saturdays and/or Sundays as necessary.
3. The remuneration package will be competitive and commensurate with qualifications and experience.
4. The appointee will work at the Chai Wan Campus.

Application Procedures:

A completed application form [THEi-HR-601 (Dec 2025)], together with a full curriculum vitae, should be sent to thei-jobs@thei.edu.hk.

Applicants should take note of the following:
(1) Completed application form and detailed curriculum vitae (CV) should be combined into one file in PDF format with a file size below 10MB.
(2) The file should be saved with the applicant’s name as “surname and given name”, e.g. “CHAN Siu-lam.pdf”.
(3) For the email subject, please cite “Application for Executive Assistant II, HRO (Ref No.: HRO/EAII/02/26)”.

Review of applications will commence as soon as possible and continue until the post is filled.

The Institute reserves the right not to fill the post(s).  Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.  Information on unsuccessful candidates will normally be destroyed 12 months after the completion of the recruitment exercise.

EPURE

About the Company
Gourmet Dining Group (GDG) is committed to providing quality dining experience with great food, top-notch ambience and attentive hospitality. The group owns two MICHELIN starred restaurants: Arbor (Two Stars) combines seasonal Japanese produce and refined Nordic sensibilities to create innovative Nordic-Japanese cuisine, while ÉPURE (One Star) channels seasonal ingredients from France into elegant, contemporary French cuisine. Ami and Wood Ear are the group’s latest project, presenting an elevated “fine bistronomie" experience, where guests can enjoy great food with a fine dining touch as well as rare whiskies in a relaxing and friendly atmosphere. The group also introduced the legendary DALLOYAU brand from Paris to Hong Kong, running seven retail shops and restaurants in the city’s most premium locations.

Our Employee Propositions
We provide excellent working environment and comprehensive employee benefits, along with promising career advancement and learning opportunities. We are seeking candidates of the highest caliber who are passionate and motivated to join our team.

ÉPURE Supervisor / Assistant Supervisor (Michelin Star Restaurant)I(5-Day Work)

Responsibilities:

Assist in the daily operations of the restaurant
Provide attentive and superior service to the guests
Maintain the hygiene standard and tidiness of the restaurant, tableware and silverware 

Requirements:

Form 5 or above 
At least 3 years of relevant experience in Western restaurants
Presentable, customer service-oriented, pleasant personality, willing to learn and good communications skills
Excellent guest interaction skills
Self-organized and detail-oriented with strong sense of responsibility
Good command of spoken English and Chinese

Candidates with less experience will be considered for the post of Assistant Supervisor 

We offer attractive remuneration package, employee benefits & staff caring items, including:

Competitive Salary
Meal Allowance
Discretionary Bonus
Tips
Medical & Dental Benefits
8 Days of Holiday per Month, 15 Days of Statutory Holidays, 12 Days of Annual Leave, 14 Weeks of Maternity Leave and Paternity Leave
Mandatory Provident Fund
On-the-Job Training & Training Sponsorship
Career Advancement Opportunities
Staff Purchase Discounts
Staff Resting Area
Staff Activities such as our Christmas Party, Annual Dinner, etc.

 

For applicants interested in joining the team behind this unique and exciting addition to Hong Kong’s culinary scene, please E-mail to hrs@gd-group.hk or WhatsApp to 5374 3198 for sending your résumé in addition to expected salary to us.

For more information, please visit our website: http://www.epure.hk/

Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.

title: Administrative Assistant
snippet: We are seeking a highly organized and art-loving Junior Administrative Assistant to be the welcoming face of our dynamic team
label: 助理
full_jd:
【About Us】

We are a dynamic, globally-minded team deeply rooted in the art and creative industry. We reject traditional rigid 9-to-5 schedules and champion a culture that values both freedom and responsibility. Here, you will not only stay in tune with the latest art industry trends but also enjoy flexible working hours and the exciting potential for global mobility (Work From Anywhere) in the future!

【Your Role】

As the "face" and "caretaker" of our team, you will be the central hub of our office operations. You don't need extensive experience (we highly welcome outstanding fresh graduates!), but you must be highly responsible, proactive, and passionate about the art world.

【What You'll Do】

Front Desk & First Impressions: Welcome daily visitors and represent the company's professional and artistic image. Handle incoming calls, mail, and courier services.

Office Environment Management: Ensure the reception, meeting rooms, and public areas remain tidy and aesthetically pleasing, creating a comfortable environment for the team to brainstorm and create.

Administrative & Logistics Support: Manage the procurement and inventory of office supplies, afternoon tea, and daily necessities. Assist with daily administrative workflows such as flight/hotel bookings and expense reimbursements.

Culture & Event Assistance: Help organize internal team building and holiday events, and provide basic logistical support for art exhibitions and project launches.

【Who You Are】

Experience: Associate degree or above, 0-2 years of working experience (curious and driven fresh graduates are highly encouraged to apply).

Art Enthusiast: A strong interest in the art, creative, or cultural sectors. Candidates who frequently visit exhibitions and follow art trends will be given priority.

Great Communicator: Cheerful and approachable, with excellent interpersonal communication skills and a strong service-oriented mindset.

Tech & Language Savvy: Proficient in basic MS Office software (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Since we offer global working opportunities, basic English reading and writing skills are a huge plus.

Reliable & Detail-Oriented: Organized, attentive to details, and resourceful and flexible when solving problems.

title: Social Media & Content Assistant (with PA Duties) – Global Fintech Company
snippet: We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Social Media & Content Assistant to support the Founder of a global Fintech organisation.
label: 内容
full_jd:
About the Role:

This role is responsible for capturing high-quality images and video content of the Founder’s daily activities, events, and engagements, and coordinating with marketing teams across the US and China as well as the Founder’s documentary production crew. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and is comfortable working closely with senior leadership.

Responsibilities

Accompany the Founder to meetings, events, and engagements to capture professional-quality photo and video content on a daily basis.

Operate camera equipment including action cameras (e.g. Insta360), smartphones, and other devices to produce content suitable for social media, marketing, and archival purposes.

Review, select, and organise daily footage; export and upload to designated cloud storage with proper naming conventions and date-based folder structures.

Ensure consistent content quality and adherence to brand guidelines across all captured materials.

Serve as the on-the-ground liaison between the Founder and marketing teams based in the US and China, ensuring timely delivery of content, briefing materials, and approvals.

Coordinate schedules and content needs with the Founder’s documentary production crew, ensuring access, logistics, and shot lists are aligned.

Communicate content plans, event schedules, and deliverables across time zones in both English and Mandarin.

Track content requests and deadlines from multiple stakeholders and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

Assist in preparing and scheduling social media posts across platforms (Twitter/X, Instagram, Weibo, Douyin, etc.).

Monitor social media channels and flag relevant engagement, mentions, or trending topics to the marketing teams.

Draft captions, short-form copy, and basic graphics as needed for social media content.

Provide general ad hoc support to the Founder’s office, including errands, scheduling assistance, and personal tasks as required.

Assist with logistics and coordination for the Founder’s family when needed.

Handle other administrative tasks as assigned by the Executive Assistant.

Requirements

Fluent in both English and Mandarin (spoken and written) — this is essential for daily cross-team communication.

1–3 years of experience in social media, content creation, marketing coordination, or a related role.

Strong photography and videography skills; comfortable shooting in varied environments (offices, events, travel, casual settings).

Proficiency with content editing tools (e.g. CapCut, Adobe Premiere/Lightroom, or equivalent).

Highly organised, reliable, and able to manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.

This role has no fixed working hours. The schedule will follow the Founder’s activities, typically from late afternoon through evening, with a minimum of 6 days per week. Hours will vary depending on travel, conferences, and events, and the successful candidate must be comfortable adapting at short notice.

Hong Kong-based with valid right to work in Hong Kong.

Discretion and professionalism — this role involves close proximity to senior leadership and access to confidential information.

Nice-to-Have

Experience working in tech industries.

Familiarity with both Western and Chinese social media platforms (Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok, Weibo, Douyin, WeChat, Xiaohongshu).

Basic graphic design skills (Canva, Figma, or Photoshop).

Experience supporting C-suite executives or high-profile individuals.

Cantonese language ability.

Willingness to travel domestically and internationally at short notice.

title: Upper Primary Educational Assistant (Grade 3-5 Homeroom)
snippet: Works under the direction and supervision of the classroom teacher to assist in fostering access, participation and learning for all students.
label: 助理
full_jd:
An Educational Assistant works under the direction and supervision of the classroom teacher(s) to assist in fostering access, participation and learning for all students.  This includes supervising classroom activities, teaching and working with students on an individual, small group, or whole class basis.  The Educational Assistant also helps to supervise activities in the classroom and may take on additional responsibilities such as teaching classes on their own and covering planned absences.  Responsibilities also include supervision of students throughout the day (e.g. recess, lunch, library, transitions) and other times as required such as during assemblies or field trips.

The Educational Assistant also assists with administrative and clerical tasks (e.g. preparation of classroom materials, filing, reporting attendance, answering telephone inquiries, assisting with progress reports, ordering supplies) to support the classroom, grade level, and division’s operations.

KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:

Instructional Support

Collaborate with teachers to provide instructional assistance to students on an individual, small group, or whole class basis.

Teach small group activities (e.g. art projects, math, language arts)

Confer with individual students to assist with ongoing assessment through observational notes (or other) in various areas (e.g. guided reading, writing, math groups) or with independent work (e.g. publishing stories).

Motivate and encourage students in and out of the classroom.

Assist students on technology devices (e.g. computer, iPad) for a variety of activities (e.g. internet access, reading).

Supervision and Safety of Students

Ensure the safety of students by providing appropriate supervision of students during recess, lunch, on the playground, in the library, during transitions (e.g. to/from the bus, up/down stairs, to/from nurse’s or principal’s offices), school gatherings (e.g. assemblies, chapels), on field trips and at other times as may be required.

Ensure the orderly entry and exit of students during arrival and departure (e.g. exiting classrooms, getting on and off the bus, going up/down stairs, in the hallways).

Follow up on special student needs including medications.

Clerical and Administration

Assist teachers with the preparation of classroom materials (e.g. photocopying, filing, classroom decoration, art supplies, materials for units of study) and teaching resources (e.g. stationery).

Prepare other ancillary documents/items as necessary (e.g. labels, bus tags, student folders, Student Information Packets, student portfolios).

Communicate with parents as necessary.

Document student work, support teaching, and communications through the use of technology (e.g. video cameras, updating web pages).

Report attendance through the Student Information System.

Prepare and manage calendars for parent volunteers.

Label, maintain and update files (e.g. student progress files, student work.)

Prepare class lists with emergency contact name(s), telephone number(s), and health issues; create a class emergency phone list and others as required.

Collect and distribute student data forms. Prepare and update other lists as required (e.g. homeroom class, after school activities). 

Other duties as required (e.g. deliver/collect internal mail, photocopying, laminating, book binding, answering the phone, responding to queries, clean up after art projects & parties, distribute, collect and compile lists for After School Activities, book orders).

Activities and Events

Collaborate with teachers in planning, organizing and arranging logistics for field trips (e.g. book locations, transportation arrangements, collection of permission slips from parents).

Collaborate with teachers in planning special celebration activities and other events as required. Organize chapels; an Educational Assistant may be asked to lead a chapel.

Assist in the planning and organization of outdoor activities (e.g. camp) including spending the night with students and teachers at a Hong Kong camp or outdoor facility.

Other

Substitute for the teacher for short periods of time when the teacher is absent or otherwise occupied with other school duties (e.g. meetings). Substituting for the teacher for 3 hours or the day is part of the normal job responsibilities, i.e. no additional compensation will be due.

Substitute for the teacher an entire day on occasion when no appropriate substitute teacher is available; this is compensated separately.

Participate in meetings as required (e.g. faculty, team, grade level) with teachers, colleagues, and administrators as required to support students and the school.

Participate in in-house Professional Development opportunities.

Undertake any other duties and functions as required to strengthen the contributions of the division and support and improve the smooth operation of the school.

 

Minimum requirements and qualifications:

Education:

Form 6 and related post-secondary education (e.g. “Educational Assistant” Certificate, other course work related to early childhood education).

Teaching certificate or enrolment in a teaching certification program preferred.

irst Aid certification/training.

Experience:

2 years as an Educational Assistant.

Successful experience working in the classroom with students in the assigned grade level preferred or hands-on experience working with upper primary aged children.

Required skills:

Strong written and verbal English skills, Cantonese or Mandarin a plus.

Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.

Ability to work independently and take initiative to support a classroom and team.

Proficiency with technology (Email, Calendars, Word, Excel, Microsoft 365, TEAMS); SIS a plus.

 

Dispositions

 

Passionate about young children.

Interested in, respects, and has an appreciation for diverse cultures, languages, and religions.

Actively supports the HKIS Mission and Student Learning Results.

Reports To: Associate Director, Biddable / Director, Biddable

Function: Media Management & Delivery

Location: Hong Kong

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary and Impact

WPP Media Hong Kong is seeking an Assistant Manager, Biddable to join our Media Activation team. This role is focused on project leadership and client management within the biddable space. You will be responsible for overseeing the end-to-end delivery of campaigns, acting as a client contact, and coordinating the day-to-day work of junior team members to ensure operational excellence and client success.

You will be expected to work closely with client leads and our analytics specialists to provide end-to-end solutions for clients.

Core Responsibilities:

Campaign & Project Management: Oversee the end-to-end management of biddable campaigns for a portfolio of clients, ensuring projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to a high standard.

Client Relationship Management: Serve as a key day-to-day point of contact for clients, building strong relationships, managing expectations, and confidently presenting campaign plans and performance reports.

Team Coordination & Quality Control: Provide daily guidance and support to Specialists and Executives. Review campaign setups, reports, and client communications to ensure quality, accuracy, and strategic alignment.

Strategic Planning & Insights: Contribute to the development of biddable media strategies, translating client objectives into actionable campaign plans. Analyse performance data to deliver clear, strategic insights and recommendations to clients.

Skills and Experience

At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:

·       Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.

·       Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.

·       Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

Required Skills & Experience:

·       3-4 years of relevant experience in performance marketing, with a strong background in client-facing roles.

·       Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously.

·       Excellent communication and presentation skills, with proven ability to build client trust.

·       Experience in reviewing the work of and providing guidance to junior team members.

·       Thorough understanding of key biddable platforms and their strategic application.

·       Fluent in written and spoken English and Cantonese.

Desired Skills & Experience:

·       Experience working in a matrixed organization.

·       Knowledge of WPP Media brands and capabilities.

·       Experience with organizational transformation and change management.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

title: Marketing Manager
company: Chamber of Young Snow Company Limited
snippet: We seek a self-driven and passionate Marketing Manager to lead ROI-driven campaigns, own end-to-end cultural events, and grow our audience.
label: 内容
full_jd:
About Us

Founded in 2016 by Dr. Li Shi Cheng, Chamber of Young Snow is a Hong Kong-based NGO dedicated to elevating Chinese heritage and fostering East-West cultural dialogue. We run world-class exhibitions, cultural festivals, artist residencies, and academic collaborations with institutions such as HKU and Peking University. We are a catalyst — a meeting ground for scholars and creators, and a guardian of cultural memory.

About the Role

We are looking for a self-driven Marketing Manager who can own both digital strategy and event execution. You will lead campaigns, manage budgets, and deliver cultural events end-to-end — all while working independently. You won't be alone: you'll have a dedicated UI/UX professional, a remote design team, and a business development team that steps in when projects scale up. If you thrive with autonomy, move fast, and care about culture, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

Performance Marketing & Audience Growth

Plan and run ROI-driven campaigns across Google Ads and Meta/IG Ads to drive event registrations and community engagement. Manage ad budgets efficiently, own our social channels (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube), and identify opportunities on emerging platforms like Xiaohongshu and Douyin.

Event Management & Cultural Programming

Take ownership of our events — from exhibitions and public lectures to large-scale cultural festivals. Handle logistics, vendor and venue coordination, and on-the-ground execution. Align programming with our cultural partners and academic institutions, and drive marketing before and after each event to maximise reach and attendance.

Teamwork & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work independently but never in isolation. Partner with a dedicated UI/UX professional on digital experiences, brief the remote design team on creative needs, and call on the business development team when a project demands broader coordination. Liaise with agency partners on paid ads and SEO.

AI & Innovation

Use AI tools — ChatGPT, Midjourney, automation scripts — to work smarter across content, campaigns, and reporting. Stay current on generative AI and emerging ad formats to keep our cultural storytelling fresh and competitive.

Entrepreneurial Execution

Own your KPIs: audience growth, website traffic, event attendance, and campaign ROI. Test new channels boldly, iterate quickly, and scale what works.

Requirements

Education: Degree in Marketing, Business, Arts Management, Events Management, or related field.

Experience: 5+ years in performance marketing with budget management. Proven event planning and management experience, ideally in a cultural, arts, or NGO setting.

Technical Skills: Proficient in Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, and Excel/Sheets. Comfortable with AI and automation tools (ChatGPT, ad scripting, analytics).

Attributes: Highly self-motivated; thrives working independently across multiple workstreams. Adaptable and eager to test new platforms.

Languages: Professional English and Chinese (Cantonese or Mandarin accepted).

Nice-to-Have: Passion for Chinese art, culture, and heritage. Basic design sensibility (Photoshop, Canva).

Why Join?

Own the marketing and events agenda for one of Hong Kong's most respected cultural NGOs. Work with real autonomy, backed by a UI/UX professional, a remote design team, and a business development team when you need them. Flat structure, big ideas, and a team that genuinely cares about culture. Competitive salary, performance bonuses, and room to grow.

教育，是香港家庭最核心的關注點，也是最需要「信任感」與「專業度」的領域。

Edu-Kingdom (教育王國) 作為全港歷史最悠久、最具權威性的家長社群與教育資訊平台，正式納入 PressLogic 旗下。我們不只提供即時的論壇熱話，更致力於為家長在升學、育兒與成長抉擇的每一個關鍵時刻，提供最具深度、最可靠的指南。

為了推動 Edu-Kingdom 的內容升級與商業版圖擴展，我們正尋找一位具備「教育升學洞察力」與「深度專訪實力」的編輯人才。

你將成為 Edu-Kingdom 的內容核心，穿梭於日常權威資訊與品牌商業策劃之間，將論壇百萬家長的真實痛點，轉化為具備商業價值與社會影響力的深度內容。

(資深申請者將直接被考慮為 Senior Digital Editor / Content Lead)

💼 核心職責 (Core Responsibilities)

深度人物專訪與名校探校 (High-level Interview & School Features)： 獨立策劃並執行對「校長、升學專家、幼兒心理學家」的深度專訪。你能夠用專業、得體的視角，挖掘學校的辦學理念與獨特優勢，為家長呈現最真實的探校報告。

升學與育兒專題策劃 (Educational IP & Feature Planning)： 針對香港主流升學體制（幼小銜接、中一自行收生、DSE/IB/A-Level 課程、海外升學）及育兒痛點，主導撰寫結構清晰、具權威性的「升學懶人包」與深度專題。

論壇輿情轉化與社群內容 (Forum Insights to Editorial Content)： 深入 Baby Kingdom 論壇 等社群，敏銳捕捉家長關注的熱門話題與痛點，將碎片化的論壇討論，提煉轉化為具備高共鳴度、高品質的社交媒體內容與圖文企劃。

品牌商業項目策劃 (B2B Commercial Advertorials)： 與業務團隊緊密合作，為教育機構、國際學校、知名母嬰品牌策劃高轉化率的廣告內容、微電影/短片劇本 (Video Script) 或聯乘企劃，在維持媒體公信力的同時，實現出色的商業推廣成效。

數據驅動優化與 AIGC 應用 (Data-driven & AI driven)： 善用數據分析工具，持續優化內容成效；並積極將 AI 寫作及排版工具融入日常工作流，釋放更多精力專注於高質量的深度創作。

💡 我們期待的你 (About You)

深厚的教育/母嬰媒體經驗： 擁有 3 年以上數位媒體、教育類雜誌或市場營銷文案經驗（若有 5 年以上經驗並具備團隊帶領能力，將聘為 Senior 職級）。

熟悉香港升學教育生態： 對本地及國際學校升學體制（包括叩門、選校策略、面試技巧、學制對比）有深入研究，或本身對家庭生活、育兒成長內容具備極高的專業度與熱情。

卓越的專訪與溝通手腕： 具備與校長、學者等高階決策者溝通的成熟心態與大體談吐，能撰寫出既有生活溫度、又具權威說服力的文字，擅長以「第一身故事」打動讀者。

影音與視覺企劃力： 熟悉短片拍攝流程（如街訪、人物訪談紀錄片等），能獨立撰寫流暢、有張力的影片劇本，並具備與拍攝團隊高效溝通的能力。

數據與科技適應力： 樂於學習數據驅動的內容邏輯，對新型態內容手法（如 AIGC、互動式內容、社群小工具應用）持開放態度。

Collaborating with internal teams and stakeholders to facilitate efficient case handling and resolution.

A university degree in any discipline or a diploma with strong career motivation.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage with diverse parties.

Proficiency in written and spoken English and Chinese.

Competency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Chinese word processing.

At Anzure, we are committed to investing in our people and supporting long-term professional growth.

5-Day Work Week

Performance Bonus

This is a role for a strong communicator and writer who is confident shaping narratives, developing polished corporate content, and managing communications from a brand stewardship perspective. The position is less focused on consumer or product campaign marketing, and more focused on corporate narrative, reputation, thought leadership, PR, and B2B communications.

Corporate Communications & Messaging

Develop and deliver GEG’s corporate communications strategy across external channels.

Own and evolve GEG’s corporate messaging, ensuring clarity, consistency, and alignment with business priorities.

Maintain core brand and communications tools including messaging frameworks, company boilerplates, media materials, and brand language guidelines.

Content Development & Brand Storytelling

Build and maintain strong relationships with relevant journalists, editors, and industry media.

Develop content that grows visibility, engagement, and credibility for GEG and its leadership team.

Partner with marketing leads across the group to ensure alignment of corporate messaging and brand positioning.

Support the development of materials that present GEG’s collective strengths, capabilities, and achievements in a clear and consistent way.

Identify opportunities to strengthen how the group story is communicated across subsidiaries and external audiences.

Develop polished B2B communications materials including pitch decks, credentials, case studies, brochures, and sales support content.

Ensure all B2B collateral is well-written, strategically positioned, and on-brand.

Represent GEG at selected industry events and networking opportunities where appropriate.

Research, write, and coordinate compelling submissions that articulate GEG’s innovation, impact, and achievements.

Maximise the communications value of nominations and wins through PR and content amplification.

Experience in PR, media relations, and thought leadership content development.

label: 编辑
full_jd:
【關於這份工作】 隨著 PressLogic 正式將香港最大親子討論平台 Baby Kingdom 納入集團版圖，我們正在積極擴編！這不是一份傳統的編輯工作，我們需要你兼具「Social 編輯的敏銳度」與「廣告策劃的商業頭腦」，在日常流量內容 (Traffic Content) 與品牌合作項目 (Commercial Projects) 中自由切換，創造具備影響力與高轉化率的親子內容。

🎯 我們要找的是這樣的你：

1. 你是「自帶流量故事」的發掘家: 你對 Baby Kingdom 親子王國及教育王國等高互動性的平台內容有超強觸覺。你不僅瀏覽內容，更能像偵探一樣深入論壇熱話中，挖掘那些最具爭議性、最感動或最「寫實」的父母真實故事。

2. 你是「品牌與讀者」的超強橋樑: 你明白如何將生硬的「品牌廣告」轉化為父母愛看的故事！擅長將客戶的商業訴求與產品賣點，包裝成貼地、具高度代入感且具備高轉化率 (Conversion) 的贊助帖文 (Advertorial) 或短片 Script，完美平衡客戶需求與讀者口味。

3. 你是「共鳴感」的創造師: 你知道 「爆文」的密碼，擅長將知識資訊、育兒或升學的日常煩惱，「翻譯」成貼地、具高度代入感的故事 或短片腳本，讓讀者忍不住留言：「說出我的心聲！」，確保內容能被大量分享和討論。

4. 你對「升學教育與家庭生活」有研究熱情: 無論是本地學校的叩門心得、國際學校的課程優勢，還是育兒路上的理念爭議，你都充滿熱情和見解。你能將複雜的資訊，用清晰、有趣且具備情感連結的方式傳遞給目標家長群 (Target Audience)。

5. 你是個擁抱 AI 科技的實幹型創作人 : 懂 Social 玩法、懂得與設計、Sales 及拍攝團隊協作。不怕問、不怕改，積極擁抱 AI (AIGC) 和各種數碼內容上的變化，願意嘗試以新角度、新工具優化產出效率。

📌 工作職責：

內容策劃與製作

論壇故事挖掘與轉化： 深入 Baby Kingdom、教育王國 等社群平台，主導挖掘高共鳴度的用戶故事、熱話及教育資訊，並策劃、改寫成 社交媒體爆文。

教育主題聚焦： 撰寫並製作不同形式的內容（文章／影片／圖文／短片等），確保內容能提供具價值的 本地及國際學校升學、育兒心態、兒童健康等教育主題資訊。

平台策略： 深入理解平台和目標受眾的定位，量身設計符合平台語氣與讀者口味的主題和敘事方式，特別注重 內容的情感轉化力。

About BNBU

Strategically located in the heart of China’s most vibrant Greater Bay Area, our campus is within the one-hour livelihood circle that encompasses Hong Kong, Macau, Shenzhen and Guangzhou. Founded in 2005, BNBU is jointly established by Beijing Normal University and Hong Kong Baptist University and enjoys a fine reputation as a pioneer in liberal arts education. Attracting prestigious scholars from around the world, it is a campus of robust international culture, where all classroom lessons are taught in English. Long a magnet for students with ambitions of studying overseas, BNBU sees many of its graduates snapped up by the world’s leading universities. Our Faculty of Business and Management, Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences, Faculty of Science and Technology, School of Culture and Creativity, School of AI and Liberal Arts and School of General Education together offer a total of 30 undergraduate programmes and more than a dozen postgraduate programmes. Growing rapidly in size, quality and diversity, BNBU now attracts over 9,000 students to its picturesque campus in the coastal city of Zhuhai, and is actively recruiting first-class faculty members to make it a top-tier liberal arts university in China.

 

We are now seeking accomplished and forward-thinking scholars to join us as Disciplinary Leaders, tasked with steering the strategic development and future growth of our key academic fields including: Accounting; Business Analytics; Business Management (including but not limit to Human Resources, Marketing Management, and Digital Media Management); Public Relations and Advertising; Data Science; Environmental Science; Applied Psychology; Game Design; Culture, Creativity & Management and Media Arts and Design.

 

Job Description

These senior faculty positions are pivotal to our mission. The successful candidates will provide the intellectual vision and academic direction to elevate their disciplines, ensuring they remain at the forefront of innovation, relevance, and scholarly impact.

The appointed Discipline Leader will be entrusted with the following key responsibilities:

1.      Provide Strategic Academic Leadership: Define and implement a compelling strategic vision for the discipline, guiding its development, innovation, and long-term growth in alignment with BNBU's mission.

2.      Champion Research Excellence: Establish and sustain a world-class, competitively funded research programme, fostering a vibrant culture of scholarly inquiry, publication, and innovation within the discipline.

3.      Mentor the Next Generation: Provide inspirational guidance and mentorship to undergraduate and postgraduate students, while actively supporting the professional development of junior faculty members.

4.      Drive Curriculum Innovation: Lead the ongoing enhancement and modernization of the curriculum, ensuring pedagogical excellence and maintaining the discipline's relevance in an evolving global context.

5.      Forge Strategic Partnerships: Develop and nurture robust relationships with industry, professional bodies, and international institutions to create impactful collaborations and expand the discipline's reach and influence.

Job Requirement

The candidates should hold a Ph.D. or equivalent, supported by a strong international record of research and publication. He/she should be a visionary leader and distinguished scholar, who is eligible for faculty appointment as a full professor. Essential qualities include demonstrated academic leadership, a commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, a passion for teaching in a multicultural setting, and excellent communication skills, all underpinned by a genuine dedication to building an inclusive academic environment.

Program Overview & Strategic Vision

In an era of global macroeconomic volatility, capital preservation has shifted from a luxury to a critical necessity. This Graduate Programme is not a traditional operational desk job; it is a high-octane, market-facing acceleration platform designed for high-calibre analytical minds under the age of 25. The Structural Architecture Phase
Immerse yourself in an intensive regulatory compliance and foundational financial training framework to secure mandatory industry licenses. Trainees will deeply analyze global risk-mitigation structures, the mechanics of multi-asset allocation, cross-border wealth preservation tools, and compliance guidelines governing the Hong Kong financial ecosystem.

The Market Engagement Phase
Transition into active market consulting by conducting comprehensive financial health diagnostics and portfolio stress-testing for private accounts. You will be responsible for translating raw market intelligence into customized wealth protection proposals, leading critical advisory presentations, and managing the end-to-end execution of capital alignment strategies.

The Asset Command Phase
Evolve from an individual strategic executor into a business unit enterprise builder. In this phase, you will take full ownership of your market sector's asset expansion goals, unlock performance-leveraged compensation tiers, and spearhead specialized advisory squads by mentoring incoming trainee cohorts to scale platform revenue.

Market Intelligence & Client Origination: Utilize advanced macro-trend analysis and sector research to identify, approach, and engage high-net-worth individuals, entrepreneurs, and corporate ecosystems requiring strategic portfolio risk-mitigation.

Portfolio Consultation & Architecting: Evaluate complex client financial profiles, identify structural asset gaps, and design tailor-made global risk management, retirement, and estate-planning frameworks aligned with current economic indicators.

Asset Optimization & Relationship Retention: Execute systematic, data-driven portfolio reviews to ensure long-term tactical alignment with shifting client objectives, thereby securing sustained account loyalty and institutional referral pipelines.

Who Thrives Here

Strict Graduation Timeline: This intake is strictly reserved for final-year students or recent graduates completing their studies on or before 31 March 2026. (Please note: Candidates graduating after March 2026 cannot be accommodated in this cohort).

Core Competencies: Exceptional emotional intelligence, a high degree of internal accountability, unyielding resilience under pressure, and a strong professional affinity for metric-driven, performance-linked financial incentives.

The Competitive Edge (Why Us?)

Transparent Merit-Based Ascendancy: We enforce a strict anti-bureaucracy policy where corporate politics are non-existent; your promotion to a senior advisory or management role within 12 months is dictated solely by your objective portfolio metrics.

Operational Autonomy & Synergy: Benefit from an optimized 10:00 start time, allowing you the professional flexibility to structure your daily operations, client engagements, and market analysis around peak liquidity hours.

Global Talent Mobility (IANG Support): Full corporate administrative assistance and renewal documentation support are available specifically for high-performing international graduates holding valid IANG status.

We are a Hong Kong-based, SFC and SEC-registered investment manager running equity long/short and long-only strategies focused on Japan. Role

We are looking for a talented individual to join our team as Operations Manager.

 

This position offers a unique opportunity to develop a broad skill set across fund operations. Working directly alongside the COO in a lean, institutional-quality environment, you will gain hands-on exposure to the full spectrum of operational infrastructure to regulatory frameworks.

 

We are committed to developing our team members. High-performing individuals can expect to grow into senior roles within the firm as we continue to scale.

Operations (ongoing professional development supported):

-          Trade settlement and post-trade processing

-          NAV reconciliation across funds and accounts

-          Communication and relationship management with service providers — Administrators, Prime Brokers, OMS/PMS

-          Experience in new accounts onboarding

-          Handle internal and external reporting requirements

-          Other duties as assigned by the COO

title: Marketing Assistant
snippet: The Marketing Assistant plays a key role in promoting the programmes and activities of the Museum.
label: 助理
full_jd:
TITLE:                         MARKETING ASSISTANT

RESPONSIBLE TO:    ASSISTANT MARKETING MANAGER, HEAD OF MARKETING

RESPONSIBLE FOR:  ASSISTANCE IN PROMOTING THE MUSEUM’S COLLECTIONS, EXHIBITIONS, PROGRAMMES AND INITATIVES AS WELL AS GROWING AND MAINTAINING THE MUSEUM’S DIGITAL PRESENCE 

ORGANISATIONAL MISSION:

The Hong Kong Maritime Museum (HKMM) is an independent, non-profit registered charity founded by members of the Hong Kong shipping industry, supported by the business community, individuals and the Hong Kong SAR Government. As a cultural institution, we are dedicated to showcasing and preserving the maritime heritage and contemporary marine environment of Hong Kong and the South China Sea. Rooted in China, but looking to the world, we aim to inspire people's appreciation of their relationship with the sea. By connecting East and West, maritime cultural heritage and sustainable ocean development, we delve into the profound ties between people and the sea. Through our rich exhibitions and educational programs, we hope to cultivate public passion and respect for maritime culture and promote the sustainable development of the marine environment.

 POSITION OBJECTIVE

The function of the Marketing Assistant is to support the Marketing Team in promoting the Museum’s collections, exhibitions, programmes and initiatives, with the goal of increasing visitation and brand awareness. The Marketing Assistant plays a key role in growing the Museum’s digital presence by producing and maintaining content for platforms such as the website and social media.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES 

To assist the Head of Marketing and Assistant Marketing Manager in rolling out key projects including promotion of major exhibitions, the launch of the Hong Kong Maritime Museum Jockey Club Anchor Plaza, the Museum’s digital transformation and developing HKMM as the cultural hub along the Central Waterfront.

To work with the Assistant Marketing Manager in managing the Museum’s social media platforms, planning and producing content, responding to enquiries, growing and maintaining online communities, evaluating and reporting platforms’ performance, researching on social media trends, developing new functionalities and channels.

To copywrite for the Museum’s advertisement and promotional materials.

To plan and prepare the Museum’s e-Newsletter and maintain the subscribers’ database.

To improve website functionality and interface, update and produce website content, analyse and report web traffic.

To explore and manage new digital products that can be used to improve marketing performance and museum experience. 

To keep track of media coverage by compiling media clipping report, reporting media value, and maintaining media database.

To build relationships with Hong Kong and Chinese media, influencers, and partners.

To collaborate with the Museum Shop and Café staff in implementing joint promotions with the Museum.

To support the administration and onsite operation of special events and the Museum’s membership programme. 

To handle the marketing team’s administration including expenses record and processing, collateral production and distribution, indoor and outdoor communication touchpoints maintenance. 

To perform any other duties as assigned by the Head of Marketing.

 QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE 

A Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, language studies or related disciplines. 

1-2 years of experience in copywriting, digital marketing, and social media content production, preferably in the art and cultural field. 

Excellent command of written and spoken English and Chinese. 

Hands-on experience managing Facebook, Instagram, Xiaohongshu and WeChat.

Proficient in digital tools (Canva, CapCut, Photoshop, Google Analytics, Meta Business Suite, Mailchimp, Wix, etc.).

Good communication and organizational skills.

Presentable, detailed-oriented and a team player.

Interested parties, please submit application with cover letter, CV, and portfolio of previous work (if any) to liz•••••@hkmaritimemuseum.org and wil••••••••@hkmaritimemuseum.org.

Your new company

A top-tier securities brokerage firm is looking for a Director (Head of Settlement Operations) to join their operations department.

Your new role

Lead and manage the team of 15+ headcounts across settlement, IPO operations, payments, and corporate actions, supporting post-trade processes, controls, and operational change initiatives across Global Markets and Securities businesses in Hong Kong and APAC markets.
Manage daily operational support for Global Markets, institutional, private wealth, and retail businesses across multiple asset classes including OTC derivatives, structured and vanilla products, futures and options, cash equities, virtual assets, and primary market transactions such as IPOs, placements, and debt issuance
Oversee end-to-end operations across settlement and clearing, cash management, static data, reconciliation, tax and regulatory reporting, syndicate support, new product onboarding, and client servicing
Ensure timely and accurate securities and cash settlement across domestic, cross-border, and international markets through close coordination with brokers, prime brokers, custodians, global custodians, exchanges, clearing houses, and ICSDs such as Euroclear and Clearstream
Supervise pre-settlement processes including trade matching, confirmations, exception handling, break resolution, and same-day issue remediation to improve settlement efficiency and minimize failures
Maintain a strong control environment across the trade lifecycle by identifying process gaps and risks, and implementing mitigating controls to reduce operational and key person risk
Ensure all processes, policies, and procedures comply with internal governance standards and regulatory requirements, including regular reviews, audit readiness, and regulatory reporting obligations
Lead strategic initiatives to enhance operations through automation, system implementation, platform integration, and operating model optimization
Oversee the operational readiness of new products, business initiatives, and market changes, ensuring proper controls, procedures, capacity planning, and training are in place
Monitor service delivery using KPIs, management reporting, and incident tracking, leveraging data insights to improve performance and support decision-making

What you'll need to succeed

Degree holder in Finance, Business, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline
Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in settlement, middle office, or post-trade functions within banking, securities, or financial markets institutions
Proven leadership experience managing teams in a regulated financial services environment, with the ability to lead across complex operations and diverse stakeholder groups
Strong knowledge of post-trade lifecycle processes across securities, derivatives, and structured products, including settlement, reconciliation, cash management, controls, and interaction with market infrastructure
Solid understanding of products, regulatory requirements, audit standards, operational risk management, and control governance within financial markets operations
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior management, business leaders, control functions, and external counterparties

What you need to do now

Customer-nominated freight forwarders (FOB terms).

Container consolidation and utilization.

Support continuous improvement initiatives to streamline logistics processes and reduce costs.

Strong understanding of international shipping practices, Incoterms (especially FOB), and trade compliance.

Experience with logistics documentation and working with freight forwarders and customs brokers. Building excellent supply chain relationships.

Proficiency in ERP/WMS/TMS systems and Microsoft Office Suite.

Excellent communication, negotiation, and organizational skills in English and Mandarin.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and meet strict deadlines.

snippet: IP Paralegal in one of the top international law firms
