full_jd:
ABOUT US

Bird & Bird is a highly respected global law firm. We have built our international reputation not only on exceptional legal expertise, but also on our ability to think beyond the details of law to meet our clients' needs.  Since 2012 we have experienced significant growth to our practice in Asia and now have a team of 40 partners and over 130 lawyers and legal professionals and 100 support staff located across our regional network of offices in Hong Kong (1995), Beijing (2004), Shanghai (2008), Singapore (2009), Sydney (2014), Shenzhen (2023) and Tokyo (2024).

The firm offers excellent prospects for progression and our culture provides all our people with world-class support to achieve their ambitions and goals.

OUR PROMISE

Bird & Bird is committed to maintaining an inclusive working environment and we are an equal opportunities employer. We will actively support and supervise your professional development.  For those with the necessary energy and ability, we will ensure that the firm is a first-class platform on which you can develop into an industry leader.  We support an agile working environment and are happy to discuss flexible working. The role offers potentially significant career progression.

ROLE

This role will report to the partners primarily and work closely with associates of the Intellectual Property (IP) department in Hong Kong and mainland China, taking the responsibility of supporting the IP team with respect to day-to-day operations and projects. There will be career growth for outstanding performers.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Support preparation of basic legal documents and evidence in connection with contentious matters in Hong Kong and Mainland China, under the supervision of partners and associates.

Assist with legal research and IP licensing related matters.

Support the coordination and management of outbound legal and compliance matters for Chinese clients, including:

Maintaining daily communications with clients and international colleagues;

Dealing with various client requests in a timely and professional manner; and

Reviewing draft bills for approval and handling feedback from clients.

Assist with international and domestic client pitches, including the preparation of presentation materials.

Other ad hoc projects as assigned by partners/lawyers.

 

SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES

A strong academic background and law degree from a reputable Chinese law school, successful completion of the PRC bar examination, and prior study in or admission to a common law jurisdiction would be advantageous

A demonstrable interest in, or prior exposure to, intellectual property law and foreign legal systems

Excellent communication skills in both written and spoken English and Chinese

Prior work experience in a legal environment is advantageous but not essential

Professional, meticulous and conscientious

Mature, strong sense of responsibility, ability to work independently, helpful and supportive with good team skills

Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously

A good sense of judgement, able to prioritize tasks, efficient and able to work under pressure

Team player, willing to learn and attention to details is important

Strong PC skills, well-versed in Microsoft applications

 

WHY JOIN US

Gain hands-on experience across a broad range of intellectual property, dispute resolution and outbound legal matters in an international law firm environment.

Work alongside experienced partners and associates on complex, cross-border matters.

Develop your legal research, drafting, and client management skills in a supportive and collaborative team.

Be part of a firm committed to excellence in client service and professional development.

full_jd:
While we do our best to review every application, if you haven’t heard from us within six weeks, it likely means we’ve moved ahead with other candidates this time. Rest assured, anything you share with us stays confidential and is used only for recruitment purposes. 

Here at Swire Hotels, we don't do ordinary things. We thrive on the different and the exciting, and yes perhaps a little quirky and without doubt, fun.  

With a dynamic culture and an open door for your feedback, you're not just filling a role — you're owning it. We provide the training and the freedom for you to flourish, with leaders who support and encourage you. The difference is you. Everyday is a fresh page in our collective story. 

Ready to join us at Swire Hotels? 

Swire Hotels is a group of individual hotel brands who set out to craft extraordinary hospitality for our guests. Our two brands, Upper House and EAST, are found all over the world, with Upper House in Hong Kong, Chengdu, Shanghai, and EAST in Hong Kong, Beijing and Miami. Each of these hotels is exceptionally unique yet joined by a shared appreciation for aesthetics and service excellence. 

We craft our journeys with passions in:  

Art – Perhaps the greatest expression of one person’s individuality which we proudly celebrate, art flows through everything at Swire Hotels.  

Sustainability – We strive to create a healthy ecosystem of people who are concerned about our impact on the environment, embody our values, and have the passion to always grow, inspire and innovate.  

Wellness – Everyone’s journey of personal growth is different, and we want you to focus on your wellbeing in ways you are comfortable with. 

 
Job Overview
 

As an Administrative Assistant, you will provide overall administrative assistance to People & Culture Team and Central Support Office. This position will report to the Head of People & Culture.   

Key Responsibilities 

Welcome to the core of what being a Administrative is all about! 

Here's the quick lowdown on what you'll do day-to-day (mid-July to mid-October): 

Assist with meeting logistics and day-to-day office management, including maintaining the pantry and coordinating with the building management office 

Manage key documents, filing systems, corporate administration, and secretarial duties 

Handle general administrative tasks, including preparing reimbursement reports and submitting claim forms 

Support any ad-hoc projects and assignments as required 

Requirements 

Here's exactly what you need to excel in this role: 

The Non-Negotiables (Must-Haves): 

Experience: At least 2 years’ relevant experience in a similar capacity, preferably in the hospitality industry or a multinational company 

Education: Higher diploma holder or above in any discipline 

Skills: Excellent command of written and spoken English and Chinese. You’ll also need strong interpersonal and communication skills in this position. Proficiency in MS office applications. Possess high integrity and respect confidentiality, and be able to work under pressure. 

Personality: Proactive, agile, organized, presentable and detail minded. 

The Cherries on Top (Nice-to-Haves): 

A good team player and a self-starter; well-organised, resourceful, energetic and confident 

Good interpersonal and problem-solving skills; sound influencing power 

We've kept it short and sweet – just the essentials you'll need. 

What We're Looking For: The Soul Behind the Skillset 

Skills are teachable, but your spirit is what truly sets you apart. If you feel a connection with what we stand for, we're eager to meet you. 

Adaptable Thinkers: You’re not just open to change; you thrive on it. The dynamic nature of our environment energizes you. 

Feedback Enthusiasts: You value open communication and aren’t afraid to give or receive feedback to help us all grow together. 

Passionate Pioneers: You bring more than skills; you bring energy and zeal to make a difference every day, connecting with a team that does the same. 

Pause for a second before you hit 'apply.' Do these values align with your own? Is this the team you've been wanting to join? If your answer is a clear 'YES,' we're excited to get to know you better. 

Benefits 

For Every Member of Our Family: 

Turn up in smart casual attires and be as comfortable as you can at work! 

Stagger your working hours and have the flexibility to create a working schedule that fits you! 

Whoosh into the office with ease as it is conveniently located near an MTR station and accessible with public transits! 

Enjoy complimentary meals to keep you fuelled and focused throughout the day! 

Join our wellness programme and healthy pantry and attend to your mental and physical wellbeing! 

The successful candidate will be joining our family from mid-July to mid-October.

This is not a purely strategic role — you will own the roadmap and remain closely involved in execution, working alongside a lean internal creative team and a network of specialist external agencies. You will report directly to the CEO.

Key Responsibilities
Brand Strategy & Budget

•     Define and execute the overall marketing and brand strategy for Lockly and LocklyPRO, with active marketing execution for Smartec

•     Manage the global marketing budget and maintain brand consistency across all markets, channels, and touchpoints

Channel Marketing & Sales Enablement

•     Partner with the global sales team to develop pitch & product decks, catalogues, sell sheets, brand & product videos, POP materials, and other retail-facing content

•     Oversee the accuracy and storytelling quality of all product listings across retail platforms, including Amazon, Home Depot, Best Buy, and Lowe’s

•     Support channel partners and distributors with materials and training that drive sell-through

B2B Lead Generation

•     Develop and manage lead generation and nurture programs for LocklyPRO and Smartec across tradeshows, content, outbound, and digital channels

•     Work closely with the B2B sales team, Customer Success, and international distributors on new product launches and feature rollouts

Digital Marketing, DTC & Direct Channels

•     Own Lockly.com as a sales channel — responsible for promotions, full sales funnel management, and conversion rate optimization

•     Oversee email, SMS, and app push notification strategy and execution, including campaign and lifecycle flows

•     Manage the affiliate program, CRM strategy, and loyalty and referral programs

Content, Creative, UGC & KOL

•     Lead the in-house creative graphics team and collaborate with external agencies on all content / video production

•     Drive creative direction and execution for brand and product videos, campaign assets, and all channel content

•     Oversee UGC and KOL programs — both agency-managed — including brief-setting, final content review, and performance assessment

PR, Social Media & Communications

•     Manage the PR agency across media coverage, product launches, awards submissions, press reviews, and speaking opportunities

•     Oversee the global social media team across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Reddit (agency-managed), and LinkedIn — setting strategy, reviewing output, and monitoring analytics

Events, Cross-Functional Collaboration & AI

•     Lead preparation and on-site execution for CES, industry tradeshows, and PR events, including pre- and post-show communications

•     Collaborate with R&D on product roadmap input, feature feedback, and launch readiness

•     Build and maintain AI-powered marketing tools and workflows that improve team efficiency and content quality — hands-on tool building is expected

Requirements
Must-Have

•     Overseas market experience — You have marketed products across multiple international markets and can adapt strategy without losing brand coherence

•     English excellence — Native or near-native written and spoken English, with the ability to write, edit, and direct copy to a professional standard

•     Mandarin — Professional working proficiency required for cross-team and regional collaboration

•     AI tool building — You have built functional AI workflows, automations, or tools, prompt engineering, or no-code/low-code platforms

•     Team leadership — 5+ years leading marketing teams, with concurrent experience managing in-house staff and external agencies

•     Storytelling — Ability to craft compelling narratives for technical products across consumer, commercial, and trade audiences

•     Hands-on mindset — Self-motivated, agency mentality, and comfortable staying close to the work at every level

Strong Advantage

•     Experience across both B2C and B2B marketing within the same organisation

•     Background in consumer electronics, smart home, or hardware categories

•     Direct ownership of DTC e-commerce, CRM, or retention marketing programs

Additional Information

•     This is a lean, fast-moving team — resource efficiency and initiative are essential

•     You will be building and improving marketing systems, not inheriting finished ones

•     Occasional before- and after-hours availability will be required given the global nature of the role

About Fizz
We are the Hong Kong office of Fizz Creations, which has been providing fun, innovative, and quality products to the world of gifts for 15 years. We constantly push the boundaries with new designs and concepts both in the UK and worldwide. We supply most of the key regions across the world, including USA, UK, EU and Australia. Within these we supply to TK Maxx, Walmart, Tesco, Aldi, Lidl and Kmart plus many others, with really exciting brands such as ICEE, SLUSH PUPPiE, The Grinch, PAC-MAN, Tetris, Harry Potter, Sonic… and many more!

Position Overview
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Logistics Coordinator to manage and support the full logistics process for international shipments. This role involves coordinating shipments from suppliers in China to either customer-nominated forwarders or directly to our warehouses in the UK and US. The ideal candidate will be experienced in international shipping, highly organized, and capable of managing documentation, supplier communication, and logistics arrangements across multiple regions.

Key Responsibilities
Shipment Coordination
• Coordinate outbound shipments from suppliers in China to:
• Customer-nominated freight forwarders (FOB terms).

• Company warehouses in the UK and US (FOB + destination freight).

• Container consolidation and utilization.

• Prepare and verify shipping documentation, including bills of lading, packing lists, and customs paperwork.Liaise with freight forwarders, couriers, and customs brokers to ensure timely and compliant delivery.

• Track and monitor shipments, proactively resolving delays, damages, or discrepancies.

• Maintain accurate shipping records and generate logistics reports for internal use.

Supplier & Logistics Management
• Communicate with suppliers to ensure goods are ready for shipment according to agreed Incoterms (primarily FOB).

• Review and confirm supplier shipping documents for accuracy and compliance.

• Arrange freight and delivery for shipments going to company warehouses, including customs clearance and final-mile logistics.

• Monitor supplier performance and escalate issues as needed.

Additional Responsibilities
• Purchase and coordinate delivery of packaging materials (e.g., labels, polybags) based on customer requirements.

• Arrange and track delivery of pre-production and gold seal samples to customers or internal teams.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives to streamline logistics processes and reduce costs.

Qualifications
• 2–4 years of experience in logistics, shipping, or supply chain coordination.

• Strong understanding of international shipping practices, Incoterms (especially FOB), and trade compliance.

• Experience with logistics documentation and working with freight forwarders and customs brokers. Building excellent supply chain relationships.

• Proficiency in ERP/WMS/TMS systems and Microsoft Office Suite.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and organizational skills in English and Mandarin.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment and meet strict deadlines.

• Good team player. Ready to help and resolve issues.

Preferred Skills
• Experience managing shipments from Asia to Europe and North America.

• Familiarity with packaging procurement and sample logistics.

• A continuous improvement mindset with a focus on cost efficiency and operational excellence.

full_jd:
Digital Marketing Executive
Position Overview
We are a fast growing watch and jewelry company looking for a versatile, forward-thinking Digital Marketing Executive to manage and scale our online presence across three distinct business pillars: Luxury, Fast Fashion, and B2B ODM (Original Design Manufacturing) watch and jewelry segments.
The search landscape has evolved past simple keyword ranking. In this role, you will be responsible for a comprehensive "Search Everywhere" strategy. You will optimize our digital footprint not just for traditional search engines (SEO), but also to be the definitive answer for voice assistants (AEO) and the cited, trusted source inside generative AI models (GEO).
Key Responsibilities
1. Content & Social Media Management
- Brand Presentation: Help maintain the right look and feel for our different lines (keeping it clean and elegant for our premium line, and fun/trendy for our fast-fashion line).• Social Media: Plan and post content across our active social channels (e.g., Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn) to drive engagement and inquiries.

• B2B Content Support: Help write or format simple updates, product updates, or LinkedIn posts to promote our ODM manufacturing capabilities to business clients.

2. E-Commerce & Website Merchandising
• Product Content Management: Ensure the e-commerce website reflects current inventory with flawless, high-resolution imagery, compelling copywriting, and accurate technical specifications (e.g., movement types, carat weights, material compositions).

• User Experience (UX) Optimization: Monitor website performance, user journeys, and checkout funnels to identify friction points and improve conversion rates.

3. Advanced Search Visibility (SEO, AEO, & GEO)• Traditional SEO: Maintain a technically flawless, fast website architecture. Perform semantic keyword research and execute link-building to capture transactional, high-intent traffic.

• Answer Engine Optimization (AEO): Restructure consumer and B2B copy into an "answer-first" framework. Optimize FAQ schemas, unstructured Q&As, and clear snippets to secure Google’s "Position Zero" and voice search queries (Siri, Alexa).

• Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Optimize brand entities and digital PR footprints to ensure our luxury collections, fast-fashion lines, and manufacturing capabilities are actively recommended and cited as sources in generative AI engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).

4. Performance Marketing & Lifecycle Automation• B2C Growth: Run highly targeted paid media (Meta, Google, TikTok, Pinterest) using lookalike audiences for fashion consumers and high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs).

• B2B Lead Gen: Leverage LinkedIn Ads and hyper-specific search terms to capture global sourcing managers looking for watch/jewelry ODM partners.

• Email & CRM: Manage distinct email funnels—from high-touch VIP clienteling for luxury buyers, to flash-sale workflows for fast-fashion, and automated lead-nurturing for ODM prospects.

Key Competencies & Requirements
• Experience: 3+ years in multi-tiered digital marketing (ideally managing both B2C and B2B segments). Exposure to the accessories, fashion, or hardware manufacturing sector is highly preferred.

• Next-Gen Search Expertise: Proven understanding of how LLM (Large Language Model) crawlers behave. You must know how to build a content strategy aimed at AI citation and brand entity optimization, rather than just stuffing keywords for legacy Google rankings.

• Technical Stack:

• E-Commerce/Web: Shopify Plus, WordPress/WooCommerce, Webflow (for crisp B2B landing pages).

• Analytics/AI Auditing: Google Analytics 4, SEMrush/Ahrefs, and experience running prompts/audits in AI chatbots to track brand visibility.

• Data & Structure: Strong foundational understanding of Schema markup and technical site health (Core Web Vitals).

• Product Knowledge: A genuine interest in or knowledge of horology (watchmaking) and gemology/jewelry trends is highly desirable.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.

Why Join Us ? We are a nimble team where your work actually visible and matters. This is a fantastic opportunity for a marketer looking to expand their portfolio across both B2C and B2B markets, while gaining hands-on experience with the latest AI and digital search trends in a supportive environment.

The Role:

GirlStyle 女生日常一直以最貼地、最有溫度嘅內容陪伴女生每一天。現在，我們的目標是實現全面的 "From Audience to Community"！

我們正在尋找一位極具親和力、擁有強大執行力與商業觸覺的 VIP Community & Event Manager (PIC)。你的任務是從 0 到 1 構思並打造一個專屬的 VIP 女生圈子。你將會把 GirlStyle 獨有的溫暖與美感，從線上延伸到私域（Private Traffic）以及真實的線下世界。這不只是一份 Marketing 工作，你將會是這個社群的靈魂人物，與編輯部並肩作戰，讓粉絲對 GirlStyle 的熱愛化為現實中的美好聚會與商業價值。

Core Responsibilities:

1. 0-1 VIP 社群建立與私域日常營運 (Community & Private Traffic)

社群策略構思： 從零開始規劃 VIP 制度與社群玩法，凝聚一群最符合 GirlStyle 質感與風格的忠實讀者。

私域大管家： 負責日常維繫 VIP Community WhatsApp Group，帶動話題、分享獨家資訊、解答問題，建立充滿溫度與歸屬感的高黏性互動圈子。

2. 每月實體活動策劃與執行 (Monthly Offline Events)

O2O 體驗創造： 負責構思並落地執行每月的 VIP 線下活動（例如：美妝工作坊、新品試用會、打卡下午茶等）。

全盤統籌： 擔任活動 PIC，一手包辦場地安排、流程規劃、物資準備與活動當日的現場統籌，確保每個細節都完美符合女生的美感標準。

3. 商業合作與 B2B/B2C 推廣規劃 (Commercial & Pitching)

變現策略： 為社群及實體活動規劃具吸引力的商業合作與贊助形式（Sponsorship Models）。

提案與包裝： 負責撰寫及準備對外招商的 B2B 商業提案（Pitch Deck），以及對內/對外的 B2C 宣傳推廣內容，協助 Sales Team 將活動成功賣出。

4. 跨部門內容聯動 (Cross-functional Synergy)

與編輯部緊密合作 (Work closely with Editorial Team)： 確保社群活動的主題與 GirlStyle 日常的編輯內容方向一致，實現線上內容與線下活動的無縫接軌、互相導流。

Requirements:

Experience: 3-5 年或以上 Marketing、Event Management、PR 或社群營運 (Community Building/私域運營) 經驗。

0-1 Builder: 具備從零建立社群、策劃實體活動的成功經驗，抗壓性高且執行力強。

Commercial Mindset: 具備商業包裝能力，有撰寫 B2B Pitch Deck 及策劃品牌贊助 (Sponsorship) 的實務經驗。

Aesthetic & Vibe: 對 Beauty、Fashion、Lifestyle 有極高敏銳度及美感要求，完全 Get 到「女生日常」的調性與受眾喜好。

Communication Guru: 性格開朗、極具親和力。既能在 WhatsApp group 中帶動氣氛、與素人讀者打成一片，也能自信地面對品牌客戶進行提案。

AI-Empowered: 樂於擁抱 AI 工具，輔助日常的活動靈感發想與推廣文案撰寫。

Salary: Model Scale 1 Pay Scale Point 0 (HK$15,175 per month) to Model Scale 1 Pay Scale Point 8 (HK$17,880 per month)
Entry Requirements: The post is open to both male and female. Candidates should –
(a) have 1 year's experience or above in the past 7 years (from 13 June 2019 to 12 June 2026) in one or more of the following fields of work -
(i) cleansing such as street sweeping, refuse / waste collection in public place, street washing, gully cleansing, conservancy service, public litter container cleansing;
(ii) removal / disposal of dead bodies;
(iii) cemeteries / crematoria related duties such as transportation of coffins, handling cremated human remains, exhumation in cemeteries or related work;
(iv) pest control in public place including mosquitoes control and the use of pesticides;

(b) know simple Chinese or English; and
(c) have a pass result in the Basic Law and National Security Law Test.

(Note: Candidates will be required to pass a trade test.)
Note: Basic Law and National Security Law Test:
All applicants for civil service jobs will be assessed on their knowledge of the Basic Law and National Security Law. A pass result in the Basic Law and National Security Law Test (BLNST) is an entry requirement for all civil service jobs. (a) public cleansing duties such as street sweeping, refuse / waste collection in public place, street washing, gully cleansing, conservancy service, public litter container cleansing;
(b) removal / disposal of dead bodies;
(c) cemeteries / crematoria related duties such as transportation of coffins, handling cremated human remains, assisting in exhumation in cemeteries or related work; and
(d) pest control duties.
Notes:
(1) A Workman II works 45 hours per week (normally 6 days excluding lunch breaks). Construction Stage:

(a) Check samples and elated documents against contract requirement and make comment to project team members.

(l) Monitor and report immediately any unavailable technical approvals, including drawings before the inspections of works to be covered up.
(m) Maintain and update the following records and summary in the format as required by the Project Manager or Supervisor and his delegates: (i) Material and equipment checking. (ii) Works inspection for the daily and scheduled activities. (iii) Abortive works, and compensation events covered by Project Manager’s Instructions. (iv) Test and system performance commissioning.
(n) Provide Site Progress Reports for Site Progress Meetings.
(o) Submit site progress, the technical, accident and special reports to Project Manager or his delegates as required.
(p) Check Contractor’s setting out of all elements. Carry out routine inspections of building works and check for conformity with the Client’s Requirements, accepted design, drawings, specification and contract requirements. Report to the Supervisor or his delegates on all unsatisfactory works.
(q) Monitor the progress of on-site and off-site works against the accepted programme. Maintain site record including site record books and submit monthly returns to concerned parties as required.
(r) Take site photos on site progress of works installation and noticeable defective works and non-compliance of works.
(s) Attend project and contractors progress meetings as required and as directed by the Project Manager or his delegates.
(t) Liaise with the Supervisor on all site matters.
(u) Liaise and co-ordinate with the other government departments and public utilities companies for the work on site as required.
(v) Arrange and attend the pre-handing over and handing over inspections with relevant parties, including inspections by FSD, statutory parties, utilities services, users, clients’ departments, maintenance agents, etc.
(w) Carry out any inspection works, prepare any site records and reports and witness and report the acceptance of all testing and commissioning works as required by the Supervisor and the Supervisor’s delegates.
(x) Carry out inspection of Defect and outstanding building work at the Completion of the works.
(y) Carry out such other duties as directed by the Project Manager or Supervisor or his delegates.
(z) Supervise the on-site and off-site building works.

Post Handover Stage
 

(a) Provide and update the list of outstanding and defective works and arrange inspections.
(b) Arrange handover of spare material and as-built records including drawings complete with manuals, warranties and certificates to the maintenance agents.
(c) Monitor and report the progress and status periodically on the followings: (i) Submission and readiness of As-built drawings. (ii) Submission and readiness of Test reports. title: Freelance Social Content & Community Lead
snippet: Drive our community engagement, content strategy, and support overall growth initiatives for Doggo Fest 2026
label: 内容
full_jd:
Are you a dog lover with a "social-native" gene? Do you know how to turn a simple moment into a viral Reel? Do you want to be the creative voice behind Hong Kong's most exciting pet festival?

Doggo Fest is Hong Kong's premier pet festival, rapidly scaling to become a regionally recognized IP. We are seeking a dynamic and social-native individual to drive our community engagement, content strategy, and support overall growth initiatives for Doggo Fest 2026.

Behind Doggo Fest is CW Exhibition Services, a full-service powerhouse that creates iconic festival IPs and immersive brand activations. We are a team of passionate creators and executors dedicated to building vibrant experiences and fostering strong communities.

This isn't just a "posting" job; it's a chance to own the storytelling for a rapidly growing brand and directly contribute to its success.

The Role: Driving Engagement & Growth for Doggo Fest

As our Social Content & Community Lead, you will be the driving force behind Doggo Fest’s digital presence and community engagement. You will translate the festival’s vibrant energy into compelling content that captivates our audience and directly contributes to our growth objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

Dynamic Content Creation: Independently plan, film, edit, and produce high-quality short-form video content and static posts for Instagram, Facebook, and potentially Xiaohongshu. You will capture the authentic spirit of Doggo Fest and the Hong Kong pet community, transforming event preparations, partner stories, and community moments into engaging narratives.

Community Cultivation: Actively monitor and engage with our social media community, responding to comments and direct messages to foster a positive and interactive environment. You will identify and amplify user-generated content, celebrating our community’s passion for pets.

Marketing Coordination & Ticketing Support: Serve as a key liaison between our internal team, external marketing agency, sponsors, and exhibitors. You will facilitate information flow, ensure timely asset collection, and support ticketing communications to drive sales. This includes developing promotional content and providing first-line support for inquiries.

Strategic Campaign Management: Work closely with the Founder on marketing campaign and agency management, gaining invaluable insights into high-level business strategy and operational optimization. You will learn to critically assess marketing performance and contribute to strategic discussions.

What We’re Looking For

The "Social Gene": You live and breathe Instagram, Facebook, and maybe even Xiaohongshu. You know what's trending before it's a trend.

Production Skills: Demonstrated ability to independently create high-quality, engaging short-form video content (filming, editing, sound design) and graphic design (Canva proficiency is a must). A strong portfolio showcasing social-first content is essential..

Experience: 3-5 years of proven experience in a agency or a dynamic in-house team running social content (lifestyle, events, or pet brands are a huge plus).

Proactive & Autonomous: Self-starter with a strong sense of ownership, capable of managing multiple tasks and stakeholders with minimal supervision.

Communication & Organization: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in Cantonese and English (Mandarin a plus). Highly organized with strong project coordination abilities.

Dog Lover: Passion for pets and a genuine understanding of the Doggo Fest brand ethos.

AI-Native: Proficient in leveraging AI tools for content ideation, copywriting, scheduling, and efficiency. You actively seek out and implement AI solutions to enhance productivity and creativity.

The Working Model & What We Offer

Hybrid Freedom: This is a freelance, project-based role (June - December 2026). You’ll be in our office ~2 days a week to vibe with the team and coordinate, spend ~1 day in the field capturing content, and handle the rest remotely.

Direct Impact: The opportunity to shape the brand voice and community of Hong Kong’s leading pet festival, with direct impact on growth and revenue.

High-Impact Environment: A fast-paced work environment with a lean, high-leverage team.

Strategic Learning: Unique opportunity to shadow the Founder, gaining insights into high-level business strategy, agency management, and operational optimization.

Compensation: A project-based freelance compensation.

Outstanding performance in this project-based role may lead to an invitation for a permanent full-time position or a long-term retainer partnership covering Doggo Fest and our expanding portfolio of community activations.

How to Apply

Ready to join the pack? Send your CV, a brief note on why you're a fit for Doggo Fest, and – most importantly – a portfolio of your best social content (especially Reels/Video) to rec••••••••@cwexhibition.com

Include "Social Content & Community Lead" in the subject line. We can't wait to meet you!

location: Mong Kok ·  Yau Tsim Mong District
label: 编辑
full_jd:
招聘職位：營運經理 (中文部教材編輯)

【關於我們】

我們是一家快速成長的教育集團，旗下擁有多個知名教育品牌，其中曜莘中文教育中心是中文專科教育，涵蓋幼兒認字班到小學課程。隨著品牌版圖不斷擴張，我們誠邀一位具備戰略思維、優秀營運能力及品牌觸覺的領軍人才加入，統一提升各分校的營運效能，並強化品牌市場影響力。

核心職責：

1. 品牌戰略與形象管理

負責曜莘中文教育中心的營運策劃、執行，管理各分校的員工及其他一切營運工作。

統籌品牌的視覺形象與品牌調性，確保各分校執行的一致性。

策劃並執行集團年度營運策略，提升品牌在教育市場的知名度與口碑。

2. 營運流程標準化 (SOP)

優化集團跨品牌的營運流程，包括招生轉化、客戶服務標準及行政自動化。

定期巡查各區分校，確保日常營運符合集團質量指標。

審查及監控教材及協助教材內容設計和製作進度。

管理教學質素，維持表現，確保各分校的營運進度

3. 數據驅動管理

監控各校區的 KPI（如新收生人數、營運成本），編製分析報告並向管理層提供優化建議。

管理集團中央數據系統，利用數據優化課堂編排與資源配置。

4. 團隊領導與跨部門協作

協調各分校中心經理和教師的工作，確保總部政策有效落地。

與課程開發團隊及市場部緊密合作，將教學成果轉化為品牌推廣動力。

協助培訓同支援老師及行政團隊，解答家長查詢、介紹課程、學生報名手續、課堂及評估安排程序。

協助教授中文課程及編制教材 (K.1 - P.6)，提供優質客戶服務和高水平的教學質素。

與各部門間的溝通及合作，維繫學生、員工和管理層之間的關係。

入職要求：

學歷與背景： 擁有市場營銷、商業管理經驗及具備教育學士學位，主修中文。

經驗要求： 具備教育中心教學經驗及 5 年以上營運管理經驗，其中至少 2 年涉及多店管理或集團教育品牌經驗。

核心能力：

性格開朗、有愛心和耐性、守時、細心認真、喜歡小朋友。

富有責任感，具備良好抗壓能力與團隊協作精神。

良好態度、溝通技巧、組織及能獨立處理大量工作的能力。

極佳的統籌能力，能同時處理多間分校的複雜事務。

對數據敏感，能從報表中發現潛在的營運問題。

具備品牌建設經驗能指導市場推廣方向。

具有教授中文課程經驗，對中文必須有專業的知識。

DSE中文5等優先考慮。

語文能力：

出色的中文撰寫及口頭表達能力。

能操流利廣東話。

性格特質：

具備領導魅力、強大的抗壓性、以及在快速變化的環境中解決問題的彈性。

為什麼選擇我們？

決策影響力： 您將直接參與集團品牌擴張與課程發展的重大決策。

競爭力待遇： 優厚基本薪金 + 員工子女教育優惠。

穩定平台： 品牌在市場已具備堅實基礎，提供長期發展保障。

適合對象

✔ 具備連鎖補習社、大型教育機構或加盟連鎖管理經驗者。

✔ 希望從單店管理提升至集團戰略管理層的資深經理。

✔擅長將「教學質素」轉化為「品牌價值」的營運專才。

Shape your Career with Citi

We’re currently looking for a high caliber professional to join our team as Vice President, Research Analyst (Bio-Tech) - Hybrid (Internal Job Title: Research Analyst - C13) based in Hong Kong.  Being part of our team means that we’ll provide you with the resources to meet your unique needs, empower you to make healthy decisions and manage your financial well-being to help plan for your future. 

The Research Analyst is a strategic professional who stays abreast of developments within own field and contributes to directional strategy by considering their application in own job and the business. Recognized technical authority for an area within the business. Requires basic commercial awareness. There are typically multiple people within the business that provide the same level of subject matter expertise. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Significant impact on the area through complex deliverables. Provides advice and counsel related to the technology or operations of the business. Work impacts an entire area, which eventually affects the overall performance and effectiveness of the sub-function/job family.

In this role,

The Analyst (VP) will have primary responsibility of a group of stocks in the sectors described above
Responsibilities include building financial models, writing research reports, conducting macroeconomic analysis on the global energy industry, communicating our team's ideas to institutional investors, conducting due diligence and working with Citi's product team to identify trends in the space.
Self-starter; used to working in a team environment and who has the ambition to progress his/her career within equity research
Conduct analysis
Make Investment Recommendations
Interact with Institutional Clients
Arrange company visits and regular management contact for investing clients and due diligence purposes
Attend industry conferences and speak to industry contacts
Track company events and earnings
Develop financial models and valuation techniques
Establish yourself as an expert
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:

4-8 years relevant experience
Distill research into an investable thesis and write report/note
Market ideas to internal constituents and clients via phone calls and client marketing trips
Help facilitate direct corporate access for investors
Provide independent (regulatory controlled)
Secure and maintain applicable licenses.

snippet: Identify new categories, assets, and growth opportunities, translating insights into commercially viable propositions and business cases
label: 市场
full_jd:
Company description:

The Hong Kong Jockey Club

Job description:

The Hong Kong Jockey Club

Founded in 1884, The Hong Kong Jockey Club ("the Club") is a world-class racing club that acts continuously for the betterment of our society. The Club has a unique integrated business model, comprising racing and racecourse entertainment, a membership club, responsible sports wagering and lottery, and charities and community contribution. Through this model, the Club generates economic and social value for the community and supports the HKSAR Government in combatting illegal gambling.

The Division

The Sports Business Division is central to the Club's overall aspiration to become a globally recognised sports and entertainment brand, with world-class horse racing at its core. The Division's overarching focus is to deliver sustainable growth of the Club's sports business, deepen customer engagement, and contribute to position the Club as a leading global sports and entertainment brand to enable its commitment to social betterment. Its strategy is delivered through three pillars: broadening the fan base and prospecting new customers, growing the sports wagering business, and building the Club's brand and commercialising its assets.

The Job
Support the development and execution of a five‑year sponsorship commercial strategy, including board reporting and progress tracking
Identify new categories, assets, and growth opportunities, translating insights into commercially viable propositions and business cases
Provide market intelligence, performance analysis, forecasting, and benchmarking to support sponsorship decision‑making
Develop standardised sponsorship packages and lead the creation of insight‑led proposals and pitch materials in collaboration with Sales and Design teams
Ensure proposals align with approved revenue, valuation, and margin targets, identifying cross‑sell and upsell opportunities
Support senior‑level partner engagement and represent HKJC at relevant industry events
Foster collaboration across commercial functions and champion data‑driven decision‑making

About You
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related discipline
At least 10 years of solid experience commercial strategy, business development, or ventures, ideally across more than one of: management consulting, sports/entertainment, or startup/venture/private equity
Strong analytical and commercial acumen with the ability to build business cases and translate insights into action
Solid understanding of the Asia sports marketing landscape and brand decision‑making
Confident and credible in senior, client‑facing stakeholder environments
Entrepreneurial, results‑driven, and hands‑on mindset
Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
Collaborative and adaptable, able to work effectively in a fast‑paced, matrixed organisation
Good command in both written and spoken English. Chinese would be a plus.

Apply Now!

We offer competitive salary and benefits packages, dynamic working environment and development opportunities.

Add horsepower to your career today. Click the "Apply Now" button to create an account and submit your application.

Equal Opportunity and Inclusive Hiring

We are an equal opportunity employer and strive to create an inclusive workplace for all. Applicants from diverse backgrounds are welcomed to apply. If you have any special needs or require accommodations during the interview process, please e-mail us via careers@hkjc.org.hk.

full_jd:
Central Administration and Services Division

Major Duties:

(a) Provide support to the Legal Team in reviewing contracts (e.g. memorandum of understanding, non-disclosure agreements, exhibition agreements, collaboration agreements) and other legal documents; drafting contracts and legal documents; and translating legal documents between English and Chinese;

(b) Conduct legal research on legal issues, codes, statutes, judicial decisions, and other relevant sources of law;

(c) Provide support on legal services in relation to trademarks and other intellectual property matters;

(d) Facilitate internal units’ legal compliance and their discharge of statutory functions;

(e) Assist in contract negotiation with external parties, communicate with external lawyers and support in-house training / briefing sessions; and

(f) Provide support in tasks which may include organising case files, preparing meeting documents, etc; assist in budget planning and monitoring legal expenditure; and support the Legal Team in communicating with internal stakeholders and working with external parties including government bodies, and other organisations.

Requirements:

(a) A recognised degree in Laws and possessed Postgraduate Certificate in Laws (P.C.LL.);

(b) Qualified lawyer in Hong Kong with at least 2 years of recent post-qualification experience, in litigation and intellectual property law;

(c) Experience working as an in-house lawyer or in a commercial organisation or tertiary education institution is an advantage; and

(d) Effective communication skills in both written and spoken English and Chinese. Fluency in Putonghua is an advantage.

Notes:

(1) The post is at the rank of “Officer”.

(2) Applicants with substantial experience and achievements in the relevant field but without the required academic / professional qualifications OR those with exceptional academic / professional qualifications but with less experience may also apply.

(3) The appointee(s) may be required to perform duties outside normal office hours and in designated places as assigned.

Application Procedures:

Interested applicants should apply for the post via email. A completed application form [VTC-1 (Rev. 11/2024)], together with a full curriculum vitae, should be sent to vtc•••••••@vtc.edu.hk.

Candidates should take note of the following:

(1) Completed application form (VTC-1) and detailed curriculum vitae (CV) should be combined into one file in PDF format with a file size below 10MB.

(2) The file should be saved with the applicant’s name as “your surname and given name”, e.g. “CHAN Siu-lam.pdf”.

(3) For the email subject, please cite “Application for Legal Officer (C/CASD/LOFF/05/26-AP2)”.

(4) Original and copy of other supporting documents are to be provided at a later stage upon request.

Closing date for application: 10 June 2026

Applicants not invited for interview within 10 weeks from the closing date may consider their applications unsuccessful.

The Council reserves the right not to fill the post(s).

Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only. Information on unsuccessful candidates will normally be destroyed 12 months after the completion of the recruitment exercise.

title: Assistant Programme Officer
snippet: The core responsibilities are providing operational and administrative assistance to the academic/teaching-related matters.
label: 项目
full_jd:
SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION

Established in 2000, the College of International Education (CIE) is a self-funded unit of the Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU), offering full-time associate degree (AD), Higher Diploma (HD) and Undergraduate (UG) Honours Degree Programmes at the Shek Mun (Shatin) campus.  It is a major education providing unit of the School of Continuing Education (SCE), one of the seven Faculties/Schools of HKBU. CIE currently enrolls over 3,500 students and is committed to the University’s mission of providing quality whole-person higher education with a Christian heritage.  Applications are now invited for the following position:

Assistant Programme Officer (Ref. No.: 25•••745)

The appointee will be responsible for providing operational and administrative assistance to the academic/teaching-related matters at the College of International Education (CIE). Major duties are composed of but not limited to: a) providing general clerical and secretarial support; b) providing on-site and logistic support to student development activities, outreach activities, and the College’s functions; and c) running and coordinating programme activities, including animal laboratory and internship work.

Requirements:

(i) Holder of Associate Degree / Higher Diploma with at least one year of work experience; OR (ii) Possession of HKCEE 5 passes including English Language (at least Grade C if Syllabus A / Level 2 from 2007) and Chinese Language (at least Level 2 from 2007), or at least 5 subjects attaining Level 2 in HKDSE including English Language and Chinese Language, or Yi Jin graduates, with more work experience;

Good command of written and spoken English and Chinese (both Cantonese and Putonghua);

Effective communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work independently; and

Proficiency in computer applications including MS Office application (both English and Chinese) and Excel.

The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term contract ending in August 2027. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.

Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

Application Procedure:

Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.

The School reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions then applicable at the time of offer.

Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

title: Assistant Personal Shopper, NET-A-PORTER (Fashion Stylist)
company: The NET-A-PORTER Group Asia Pacific Limited
snippet: NET-A-PORTER are now seeking a talented Assistant Personal Shopper to join the APAC team.
label: 助理
full_jd:
NET-A-PORTER is the leading luxury fashion destination for women. The first digital platform of its kind, NET-A-PORTER has revolutionised the way women shop, delivering fashion, fine jewelry & watches and lifestyle collections to the world’s most discerning women.

Today, NET-A-PORTER continues to own discovery, inspiration, exceptional curation, customer experience and engaging storytelling. NET-A-PORTER creates exclusive, personalised experiences for its EIPs (Extremely Important People), with dedicated Personal Shoppers and invitation-only moments. PORTER, the editorial voice of NET-A-PORTER, entertains and inspires women through daily content, and tells the stories of incredible women across the globe.

NET-A-PORTER is part of LuxExperience, the leading digital, multi-brand luxury group.

NET-A-PORTER are now seeking a talented Assistant Personal Shopper to join the team. The role is primarily sales orientated, and will involve creating lasting customer relationships with both new and existing customers. Most importantly, you will provide exceptional service levels to ensure that our customers enjoy the best shopping experience, the latest trends and best designs – where ever they are!

Some of the essentials for you to know are:

Location: Hong Kong Office

Reporting into: Assistant Personal Shopping Manager

 

Besides a competitive salary, we can offer you:

Performance bonus schemes dependant on the type of role you are in

Our famous staff discount along with exclusive staff sales

MPF plus voluntary contribution from the company

Multi-purpose insurance

Rental Reimbursement Program

Flexible working

A chance to be part of a fun and caring team that support each other

Here is a breakdown of what you’ll be doing:

Proactively assist personal shoppers to target and build personal relationships with high value customers in the APAC region

Profile customers individually based on their shopping patterns

Provide personal styling recommendations by demonstrating detailed product knowledge and understanding of customers’ fashion and lifestyle preferences

Ensure that sales leads are identified and prioritised by analyzing your customer list

Increase the spend of individuals and develop customer loyalty by understanding their needs

Ensure prompt follow up with customers acquired through events and partnerships

Optimise every opportunity to grow the customer base and acquire new high value clients

Maintain a self-driven awareness of fashion industry, brands/products, and cultural awareness for clients based across different regions

Identify customers’ shopping patterns and trends, provide feedback to your seniors and follow up with the relevant strategy

Work alongside the wider business to understand key trends and increase business acumen 

Participate in Client Relations, marketing, and partnership events as required

Together with your manager or personal shopper, entertain high profile customers and conduct one to one appointments

The type of person we are looking for:

At least 1 year of experience in customer-facing roles, preferably in luxury fashion

Proficient in MS office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook

Excellent communication and inter-personal skills, with confidence to network and build genuine relationships with customers

Strong commercial awareness in luxury fashion

An eye for detail and good organisational skills is essential

Fluent in spoken and written English. Fluency in Mandarin and Cantonese is preferrable

Must have the confidence to contribute ideas to the working processes at NET-A-PORTER – even those outside your day-to-day remit

From the moment you join the LuxExperience Group we are committed to making your journey with us inspirational and evolutionary. If you are passionate, committed and thrive in a collaborative and fast-paced environment, then please apply with a CV.

LuxExperience is an equal opportunities employer, we encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We recognize and celebrate the benefits that diversity brings to our workplace, our business and our customers. We welcome and will consider all applications regardless of race and nationality, religion, color, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

If you require any reasonable adjustments to complete your application, please do not hesitate to advise us accordingly.

snippet: Assists the class teacher to ensure that our pupils achieve their very best and to become independent and accomplished learners.

full_jd:
Job Title: Cubs Club Child Care Assistant (0 – 3 years old) (Fixed-term Contract)

Job Purpose: Cubs Club is part of the Early Years department and caters for children of teaching staff working at Harrow Hong Kong. The sessions are different depending on the age of the children. Baby sessions are for those under 16 months and they are accompanied by an adult from home. Toddler sessions are held in the afternoons and cater for those from 17 months. Rising 3s is our Pre Nursery class that has a maximum of 7 children who are due to start Nursery in the following school year.

The Cubs Club Child Care Assistant assists the class teacher to ensure that our pupils achieve their very best and to become independent and accomplished learners.

Start Date:  August 2026 - June 2027

Application deadline: 4 June 2026 (The School will review applications on a rolling basis. Please apply immediately.)

Interested candidates please click the “Quick Apply” button. Personal data provided by job applicants will be treated in strict confidence and used strictly for recruitment purpose only. Only short-listed candidates will be notified.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

Specific aims and key responsibilities

Enrichment

• Providing purposeful experiences, socialisation and stimulating play opportunities for the children. This interaction varies based on the ages, needs and preferences of the children

• Examples of guided play and learning experiences include music and movement, simple puzzles, drawing and painting, reading and using manipulative toys to enhance fine motor skills

• Regular visits to the playground to encourage Gross Motor skills and spatial awareness

Planning

Following the curriculum and planning of the Cubs Club Leader in supporting age-appropriate educational and social activities. This includes assisting with:

• Working in liaison with the Cubs Club Leader, planning and setting up activities related to a thematic approach

• Helping to set up and clear up for each session, both the inside and outside areas on a daily basis

• Cleaning and maintaining resources

• Taking part in activities with children in either small groups or giving one to one support

• Assisting with displays and building Role-Play areas

• Making and rotating resources

• Serving food at snack and lunch times and supporting good eating habits and manners

• Supporting physical activity through dance, yoga, playtimes etc

• Adding photographs to the Online learning Journals via Seesaw

Safety

• Working with children from infancy through to preschool age

• To be responsible for the physical wellbeing of the children. This includes making sure the environment is safe and secure and free of hazards that could hurt children

• Assisting in some of the cleaning and disinfecting playthings and work surfaces

• Carefully supervising and monitoring children during play and ensuring children do not hurt one another, modelling how to interact carefully and respectfully

• Ensuring that equipment such as baby seats, pushchairs and highchairs is all in good working order and that children are always safely secured

Health Care

• Being actively involved with the health care and wellbeing of all children, including:

• Ensuring the needs of the children are always met and their next steps for development are identified

• During the Baby sessions, supporting the adults who accompany them when feeding, changing, holding, playing and comforting them

• For toddler sessions, supporting toilet training, helping with toilet use, and changing nappies are essential daily tasks, along with assisting with personal hygiene, such as washing hands and wiping noses.

• In Rising 3s classes, consolidating toilet training, nappies changing if needed, supervising toilet visits, helping with washing or dressing while promoting independence in their self-care skills.

• Regularly updating the child’s communication book during the sessions to provide information to the parents eg feedback, goals, celebrations etc

Others

• Implementing safeguarding procedures at the School

• Undertaking duties as the Head of School or a designated representative may reasonably request.

Education is ever-changing and all staff are expected to participate constructively in school activities and to adopt a flexible approach to their work. Whilst every effort has been made to explain the main duties and responsibilities of the post, each individual task undertaken may not be identified. The post holder will be expected to comply with any reasonable request from the line manager to undertake work of a similar level that is not specified in this job description. This job description will be reviewed regularly and may be varied in light of the business needs of the school. 

Person Specification

The successful candidate will be likely to fit the following profile:

Education:

• Higher diploma or above

Qualifications:

• Have in place the right to work in Hong Kong

• Strong understanding of child development and age‑appropriate learning practices

• Acceptable personal and professional background checks with the ability to be allocated unsupervised access to children (as reported via an International Child Protection Certificate background check and/or appropriate police and other checks from relevant countries of present and previous residence/work.

Skills:

• Excellent communication skills in English (Speaking, Listening, Reading and Writing)

• Have the ability to translate Harrow Hong Kong’s vision to be a leading school in Asia into reality

• Excellent organisational, administrative and IT skills

Knowledge:

• Native English speaker or near native English speaker

• Computer literate

Experience:

• Previous experience in a similar role in kindergarten is preferred, but not essential

• Experience of collaborating with colleagues

Personal Qualities:

• A team player with a reflective and flexible approach

• High levels of personal and profession

WeLab uses game-changing technology to help users access credit, save money, and enjoy their financial journey.  

At WeLab, we always put our people first. Embarking on a career with WeLab means being part of the driving force to make financial services accessible for everyone. In our flat and agile organization, you will get all the opportunities to make real impacts and deliver change. Most importantly, while you achieve greatness, we will ensure you have an amazing experience at WeLab! 

Our team is energetic and passionate who can deliver and execute, and we are looking for intellectually curious, open-minded, and smart-working individuals who are just as passionate as we are about making financial services enjoyable. 

Join us to build a better financial future for everyone! 

About you:

You're a go-getter with mad juggling skills (or multiple hats) who can thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment

You have a strong thirst for knowledge and are driven to find solutions that don't exist yet

You are comfortable with ambiguity and extremely resourceful (in your past life you could've been a detective)

You always find a way to get things done without sacrificing the quality of your work, integrity and values. No task is off limits for you.

You are humble and prioritize the success of the team over your own with an eagerness to help those around you

You don't shy away from challenges and have the ability to bounce back from setbacks

 What you’ll do and what success looks like in this role:

Trade Order Management & Settlement: Monitor and manage trade orders for HK and US stocks, ensuring accurate and timely settlement. Keep a close eye on fails and proactively follow up on trade breaks. 

Corporate Actions: Process corporate actions (dividends, distributions, splits, mergers, rights issues, etc.) meticulously to ensure accurate position records and timely distributions. 

Reconciliation: Perform daily reconciliations of trade activities, cash and position balances, broker statements, and internal records across multiple asset classes. Quickly identify and escalate any discrepancies to the supervisor for prompt resolution. 

Process Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities to improve the efficiency and quality of our operational services and present innovative suggestions to the team. 

Project Support & Testing: Provide hands-on support for ad-hoc projects and assist in user acceptance testing (UAT) for various system enhancements related to wealth management operations. 

Compliance Support: Ensure strict adherence to relevant regulatory requirements and internal policies to safeguard our operations. 

Documentation: Maintain accurate, organized, and up-to-date documentation of all operational activities. 

What is required and what we’re looking for:

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. 

1 to 2 years of relevant experience in securities trading or wealth management operations. (Highly motivated fresh graduates or candidates with less experience will also be considered). 

Experience in handling Mutual Funds is highly desirable and considered a strong plus. Exposure to virtual assets is also advantageous. 

Understanding of market settlement practices and margin financing. 

Hands-on experience with Bloomberg, CMU, CCASS, or other settlement systems is preferred. 

Basic knowledge of the rules and regulations of the SFC and the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong. 

Excellent interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills, with a strong sense of responsibility and attention to detail. 

A true team player who is flexible, independent, and comfortable working under pressure in a dynamic working environment. 

Proficient in Microsoft Office applications. 

Good command of spoken and written English and Chinese (Cantonese/Mandarin). 

Perks and Benefits to enrich your experience at WeLab:

Learning and development stipend - we value lifelong learning and believe the best way to invest in our employees is to encourage them to continue to learn 

Wellness and happiness – Numerous activities to let you focus on your physical and mental wellbeing. We allow flexible time offs to take care of personal matters and to enjoy time with family and friends 

Comfortable and positive work environment – Open plan office for easy collaboration and social with your colleagues, or branch out into your own thinking pods when needed, with FREE food and drinks for when you want to recharge 

Work smart, play hard – Connect with your colleagues over food and drinks at the stocked pantry, in the spacious social area with board games and a ping pong table, or over activities like hiking, yoga, badminton, etc. 

A big and contagious smile on everyone’s face to make you happier :)

full_jd:
Job Type: Full-time

Are you a recent graduate eager to build a dynamic, client-facing career in the financial industry?

Our client is a leading financial advisory provider in Hong Kong, dedicated to offering unbiased, comprehensive investment and financial advisory services. They are currently expanding their team and are looking for ambitious, communicative, and driven individuals to join their team.

Whether you are a local university graduate or an IANG visa holder, if you are passionate about helping clients achieve their investment goals through professional consultation, this is the perfect launchpad for your career.

About the Role

This is a highly interactive, front-end position focused on client consultation and relationship management. You will not be stuck behind a desk crunching numbers all day. Instead, you will be the face of our firm, engaging directly with clients, understanding their unique needs, and providing tailored financial strategies. You will receive comprehensive training to equip you with the industry knowledge and advisory skills needed to excel as a trusted financial professional.

Key Responsibilities

•Client Consultation: Conduct comprehensive financial reviews and consultations with clients to understand their financial objectives, risk tolerance, and wealth management needs.

•Relationship Management: Build, maintain, and deepen long-term, trusted relationships with a portfolio of clients through regular front-end engagement.

•Tailored Solutions: Leverage our independent platform to provide objective, customized financial strategies and product recommendations that align with clients' best interests.

•Business Development: Actively engage in networking and business development activities to expand your client base and market presence.

•Continuous Learning: Stay up-to-date with market trends, financial products, and regulatory changes to provide the most accurate and professional advice.

Who We Are Looking For

•Education: Fresh graduates with a Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (Finance, Business, or Economics is a plus, but not strictly required). Both local graduates and IANG visa holders are highly encouraged to apply.

•Communication Skills: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with fluency in English and Chinese (Mandarin is a strong advantage).

•Mindset: A highly motivated, proactive, and client-centric mindset. You should enjoy meeting new people and possess a genuine desire to help others succeed financially.

•Resilience: The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and a strong willingness to learn and adapt.

What We Offer

•Professional Training: A structured, comprehensive onboarding and mentorship program designed specifically for fresh graduates to transition smoothly into the financial sector.

•Clear Career Progression: A transparent and rewarding career path from an associate to a Senior Advisor or Management role, based on merit and performance.

•Independent Platform: Access to a wide range of financial products and solutions from global institutions, allowing you to offer truly unbiased advice.

•Visa Sponsorship: Full support for IANG visa renewals for eligible candidates.

•Dynamic Environment: A collaborative, energetic, and supportive team culture that celebrates success and personal growth.

How to Apply

If you are ready to step into a rewarding, client-facing career and make a tangible impact, we want to hear from you! Please submit your updated CV and a brief cover letter outlining your interest in the role, and press Apply

title: Programme Officer
company: The Hong Kong Academy for Gifted Education
snippet: Design, revamp, and implement learning programmes, coaching and mentoring, support and guide students in participating competitions/external events.
label: 项目
full_jd:
The HKAGE is looking for

Programme Officer

in Talent Development Division

(Ref_TDD/PO/20260501/JDB)

Main Job Responsibilities:

Student Programme Development and Implementation

1.       Design, revamp, and implement a wide range of talent development programmes, exhibitions, and related competitions aligned with the Academy’s Talent Development framework, promoting Whole Person Development, academic excellence, innovation, and future skills competencies.

2.      Coordinate and coach gifted students through project‑based, collaborative, and self‑directed learning experiences that foster curiosity, confidence, sustained engagement, advanced academic growth, and innovative thinking.

3.      Implement academic advising, coaching, and mentorship initiatives to support gifted students in exploring interests, identifying strengths, shaping personalised learning pathways, and engaging in progressively rigorous and meaningful learning experiences.

4.       Explore and support gifted student participation in local, regional, national, and international competitions, academic conferences, research projects, exhibitions, and enrichment, advanced or specialised and innovation learning opportunities, while overseeing programme logistics, finance, service provider coordination, and gifted student placement criteria.

5.       Oversee programme operations including enrolment, scheduling, records management, risk and emergency handling; administer divisional and academy‑level educational and publicity events to showcase gifted student development and achievements.

 

Programme Evaluation and Quality Assurance                                                  

6.     Establish and maintain a comprehensive repository of teaching and learning materials, gifted student works, and artefacts to support institutional knowledge sharing, case studies, exhibitions, and long‑term asset management.

7.       Conduct class observations, participant interviews, and administer feedback and evaluation mechanisms to assess learning experiences and outcomes, ensuring continuous improvement, quality assurance, and evidence‑based decision‑making.

8.       Uphold institutional accountability by adhering to all relevant policies, guidelines, and codes of ethics, ensuring programme integrity, professional standards, and responsible practice across all activities.

9.       Compile analytical and evaluative reports with substantiated evidence on programme effectiveness, team performance, goal attainment, and key performance indicators (KPIs), contributing to strategic planning and operational transparency.

10.       Contribute actively to the development of the Academy’s knowledge hub in Gifted Education by supporting innovation, thought leadership, research dissemination, and the sharing of effective practices within the professional community.

 

Communication and Publicity

11.  Maintain effective, professional communication and collaboration with internal teams, service providers, and external stakeholders to ensure seamless programme delivery and alignment with strategic objectives.  

12.       Design and disseminate promotional materials, coordinate events and campaigns, and contribute to Academy-wide publicity initiatives to showcase gifted student achievements and enhance public engagement.

13.       Administer and support annual divisional and academy-level events, while fostering cross-functional collaboration to ensure cohesive execution and impactful outcomes.

14.       Ensure all practices, services, and provisions comply with academy guidelines and policies, while remaining responsive and flexible to ad-hoc duties and assignments as required.

15.       Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by supervisors, contributing to the overall effectiveness and agility of the team. 

Requirements:

A recognized bachelor’s degree preferably in STEAM disciplines or equivalent.

Minium 4 years work experience with NGO, education institution or civil services especially in academic or learning programme development, project and event management.

A registered teacher with 2-4 years’ relevant experience will also be considered.

Prior experience in coaching, mentorship, training, counselling, mentoring would be advantageous.

Demonstrated good communication and interpersonal skills. Be patient, empathetic and interested to work with young people. 

Good command of both English and Chinese (written and spoken) is essential.  Putonghua will be an added advantage.

Proficient in using MS Office.  Good knowledge of IT tools application such as generative AI applications, Canva, social media platforms, and electronic publishing is a plus.

Occasionally travel to the Chinese Mainland and overseas with students is required.

Candidates possess a first-aid certificate is preferable.

Candidates with less experience may be considered for the post of Assistant Programme Officer.

Terms of Appointment:

The successful candidates will be offered an initial term of two years. Re-appointment will be subject to mutual agreement and good performance. The Academy offers a competitive salary for good candidates. Fringe benefits will be offered according to the job grade of prevailing policy.

For the protection of children, prospective employees are required to undergo a Sexual Conviction Record Check before commencement of employment.

Full details of this post can be found on our website https://www.hkage.edu.hk or by emailing Ms Siu at rec••••••••@hkage.edu.hk.

The recruitment exercise will commence and continue until the post is filled.  All information received will be treated in the strictest confidence.  Data collected will be used for recruitment purpose only and will be kept for a period of 12 months.

The HKAGE is a subvented non-governmental organisation, to advocate and provide support services for gifted students, parents and teachers/ schools.

Who are we looking for? 

CEG OnCampus Hong Kong is currently looking for a new Agent Support Coordinator to join our Global Recruitment Hub in Hong Kong.

The role forms part of the Agent Support team based at CEG Global Recruitment Hub in Hong Kong. A main priority for this role is to support the agent management processes and controlswhich align to the UK Agent Quality Framework and other applicable policies and requirements, as well as maintain the Agent Database and support the Group in their communication with external agencies and ensuring speedy processing of Agent applications and contracts. 

Key to this role will be ensuring that there is seamless communication between marketing, sales and the agent network. This is a varied and busy role and will include a wide range of activities, including, but not limited to, the proactive communication with our sales team, new agent applicants and existing agents, maintenance of agent records, monitoring of marketing resources and supporting sales and agent training activities. 

The role suits a natural organiser, with a positive and proactive outlook and who is prepared to work hard in a fast-moving sales environment at the centre of a growing organisation and make a significant contribution to the achievement of sales goals.

Key working relationships:

Global Agent Support Director

Global Sales, Marketing and Admissions teams, including all overseas offices

Educational Agents and Cambridge Education Group strategic partners

Global Sales Support team Business Systems Support Manager/Analysts

Finance/Commission team

Key responsibilities & activities within the role:

Responding to Agent queries within the agreed turnaround time of 24-48 hours.

Maintaining the Agent Database to ensure up to date and accurate information.

Ensure that all agents are onboarded in a professional and consistent way, with regular communication and follow-up.

Ensure all agents are fully referenced, contracted and managed in line with our Agent Management Policy.

Support the delivery of the annual Agent Performance Review cycle, ensuring timely tracking, follow-up, and completion of all agreed actions with internal teams and agents

Ensure agent database is fully up-to-date and meets the needs of the business.

Manage the distribution and delivery of marketing collateral to overseas events and to agents.

Provide regular and timely reports on stock levels from the distribution partner for marketing team.

Help to ensure regular and proactive communication with overseas offices and the network of sales consultants to ensure that the sales and marketing plan is implemented globally, and that internal communication is consistently effective throughout the sales organisation.

Work to maintain a yearly calendar of sales and marketing key events which will require administrative support, for example, the annual remuneration scheme, and distribution of materials.

Support sales and marketing with agent training, including the organisation of global/regional webinars, where necessary, and corresponding relevant materials.

Proactively identify manual or inefficient processes within Agent Support operations and recommend improvements to enhance efficiency, consistency, and service quality

Other administrative duties as required to ensure efficient and effective running of the sales department, and also the Hong Kong based CEG Global Recruitment Hub

Support the Global Agent Support Director and the Global Director of Sales Operations in all aspects of administration.

To undertake other duties not specifically stated above, which from time to time are necessary for the effective performance of the business without altering the nature or level of responsibility involved.

Key aspects we will be looking for:

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in supporting an international sales organisation, preferably working with sales staff across multiple overseas locations, and will demonstrate the following core attributes:

Exceptional administrative skills and attention to detail

Educated to a Degree level (Desirable)

Fluent in written and spoken English (essential)

Strong knowledge of the Microsoft Office software suite, including Excel and Outlook

Experience working with systems and databases

Excellent interpersonal skills and experience of dealing directly with internal and external customers on the phone and in person

Good team player

Proactive approach to problem solving

Flexible approach to working, excellent time management

A friendly professional manner and appearance

Calm and clear-minded under pressure

What does Cambridge Education Group do?

We offer a wide range of options across our portfolio of global centres, each with its own unique features and qualities, enabling us to meet our students' demands as required.

Whether students choose to study at one of our centres with OnCampus or Castel or complete an online programme through CEG Digital or iheed, Cambridge Education Group promises to help students Achieve More with expert tutors, innovative high-quality content, premium facilities, and the personal service our students deserve. Our students are central to everything that we do.

Knowledge in project management, familiar with community resources, school and social welfare systems in Hong Kong is a plus.

Strong interpersonal and communications skill, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse populations.
