title: Deputy General Manager (E-Commerce & Operations)
label: 运营
full_jd:
Company Overview 
We are a highly efficient, fast-growing cross-border eCommerce company with an agile team of 27 professionals, generating over HKD 200M in annual revenue. Specialized in children's apparel, we operate successfully across major global Amazon marketplaces with over 4,000 active SKUs. 
 Founded 18 years ago by our passionate Founder from a 2 people workshop, our company culture is deeply rooted in hard work, ultimate execution, and a "get-your-hands-dirty" mindset.  We believe that true leaders lead from the front, not from an ivory tower. 

Role Summary & The Ideal Candidate 
As we transition from our entrepreneurial roots into a structured, scalable enterprise, we are looking for a system-builder who can execute too.  
 The Founder (an MBA graduate) is a hands-on practitioner who understands every granular detail of the business and designs practical operational strategies. We need a Deputy General Manager who shares this diligent work ethic to be the Founder’s right-hand partner. 
You are NOT a corporate bureaucrat who only looks at macro-dashboards or delegates all tasks. You are someone who has personally guided an eCommerce company through the scaling phase (e.g., from 40M to 200M+), knowing exactly how to transform manual "small-workshop" habits into institutionalized, data-driven systems.  

Key Responsibilities (Your Mission for Scaling): 
• Execution of Strategic Vision: Partner closely with the Founder to internalize, refine, and execute high-execution operational plans. Translate the Founder’s vision into concrete, documented SOPs step-by-step actions for the team to follow flawlessly. 

•  Hands-on Team Management: Lead, mentor, and manage a high-performing teams day-to-day operations. Maintain high team morale and accountability. 

• Cross-Functional Driving Force: Actively supervise and bridge the collaboration between the front-end e-Commerce Operation & Marketing team and back-end supply chain functions, including Purchasing, Inventory Planning, Shipping & Logistics team. Ensure zero gaps between sales forecasts and stock availability.  

• Systemize E-Commerce Operations and Upgrade Inventory Control & Supply Chain: Transform our current operational flow from manual coordination into a structured project management system. Establish BI data dashboards to ensure all decisions are driven by automated KPIs. Introduce or optimize advanced AI inventory control system to automate safety stocks and lead-time calculations for our 4,000+ fashion SKUs.   

• "Pragmatic P&L & Cost Management:" Actively manage and optimize the Profit and Loss (P&L) statement for Amazon and other marketplaces. Rather than just tracking numbers, you will aggressively control operational costs (including Amazon FBA fees, advertising TACOS, returns losses, and logistic cost) to maximize net profit margins and drive sustainable revenue growth. 

Job Requirements (Who we are looking for): 
• Background: Degree holder or above in Business Administration, E-Commerce, Marketing, , Supply Chain or relevant disciplines.  

• Experience: At least 10 years of practical experience in the cross-boarder eCommerce sector, with at least 7 years in a senior managerial role (e.g., Operations Director, Co-founder, or DGM).   

• The "Scaling" Track Record: Proven experience in scaling an eCommerce business from a small-to-medium setup into a structured company. You must have personally participated in building ERP workflows, implementing project management tools, and structuring KPIs.   

• Industry Knowledge: In-depth, hands-on understanding of Amazon Marketplace regulations, PPC logic, and account health maintenance. Experience in Fashion/Apparel retail or garment trading is highly advantageous.  

• Core Competency: A strong business sense with an analytical mind, yet comfortable dealing with granular, messy frontline data.  

• Work Ethic & Personality: Diligent, proactive, and resilient. You match the pace of a hard-working Founder and possess the humility to handle both high-level system architectural design and frontline problem-solving.  

• Communication: Excellent bilingual communication skills in Chinese and English. 

What We Offer (Your Growth & Rewards): 
•  Results-Driven Rewards: An attractive and competitive base salary, plus an aggressive performance bonus tied to company profitability. Your financial reward directly reflects your impact.  

• Work-Life Harmony: 5-day work week, bank holidays, birthday leave, and comprehensive medical insurance to ensure you have the peace of mind to drive the business forward.  

• Exclusive Perks: Generous staff purchase discount on our globally loved kids' apparel lines.  

• Entrepreneurial Mentorship & Strategic Growth: Work as the CEO's primary right-hand partner. You will have a rare, front-row seat to learn and collaborate with a highly successful, hands-on Founder (an MBA graduate with 18 years of cross-border eCommerce mastery). Elevate your management philosophy, data-driven decision-making, and systematic scaling mindset to a business-owner level.  

• High Autonomy & Direct Culture: Skip the corporate politics. We offer a direct, transparent, and results-oriented environment where your voice dictates the operational systems of a 200M+ enterprise. 

How to apply:
Interested parties please click APPLY NOW and submit your CV with EXPECTED SALARY & Recent Salary, and resume stating date of availability.
All personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only.

Kimpton Tsim Sha Tsui Hong Kong

About Kimpton Tsim Sha Tsui Hong Kong

Immerse yourself in a luxe metropolitan escape at Kimpton Tsim Sha Tsui Hong Kong, the city's 'culture of time' that intertwines modern interpretations of local heritage with multicultural cues. Our thoughtfully designed 495 rooms and suites are timeless, offering hidden luxuries like sunken bathtubs and cozy daybeds, all accompanied by captivating views of Victoria Harbour. Five innovative culinary outlets present unique options, from contemporary and classic to Michelin-starred chef-helmed specialties. For any occasion, activation, or celebration, 400sqm creative spaces allow endless possibilities to transform dreams into reality. 50 stories above the bustling city lies a rooftop infinity pool decorated with the iconic Hong Kong skyline where hand-crafted cocktails can be enjoyed from an exclusive speakeasy. Peace seekers can find respite at our wellness facility with a state-of-the-art fitness center and dedicated spa. We invite you to Kimpton Tsim Sha Tsui Hong Kong to embark on a unique journey of heartfelt connections and inspiring discoveries.

Why We’re Here

Kimpton believe heartfelt, human connections make people’s lives better. Especially the people who work here.

Our founder, Bill Kimpton rebelled against impersonal, genetic hospitality that makes people feel disconnected. He initiated a new boutique hotel standard and environment where people could connect, from the heart. That was the goal then, and it is still our purpose today.

Your work here has meaning. You’re here to improve the lives of coworkers, guests, owners, communities, and together we make that happen. It’s what drives all that we do. Every day you can improve lives in your own, unique way and you can expect the same in return. It all starts with you.

How We’re Different

Our San Francisco-born entrepreneurial spirit and zest for life kick started this culture in 1981, and it shines through to this day.

It all flows from you. The lively, rebellious, genuine you – with your diverse background, talents, experiences, and plucky personality – is fully welcome, and celebrated here. Because we know that when people can be themselves at work, they shine.

That’s what we seek out and celebrate. It’s people of all kinds who share a knack for creativity and self-leadership. People who don’t need to be told what to do to get things done. People who have an innate passion for making others’ lives better.

It adds up to a work environment that’s a bit quirky, irreverent, exciting, uncommon, empowering, and downright exceptional. Guess feel it; you’ll feel it too.

Concierge Assistant (Bell / Door Attendant)

Our guests’ memorable experiences have to start somewhere. So why not with you? As the Concierge Assistant at Kimpton Tsim Sha Tsui Hong Kong, you will take ownership of delivering exceptional first impressions – providing personalized recommendations to the city, firsthand information of the latest activities and restaurants in town. 

A little taste of your day-to-day 

Every day is different, but you’ll mostly be: 

Delivering a bespoke staying experience based on Kimpton Guest Journey as unique individuals
Greeting guests, opening doors and assisting guests/visitors entering and leaving the property
Assisting guests/visitors in and out of vehicles, including loading/unloading luggage
Transporting guest luggage to and from guest rooms and/or designated area; assisting with luggage storage and retrieval
Managing outgoing guest mail, courier services, postage of parcels and freighting as directed by guest
Handling any guest enquiries regarding the city, restaurants, transportations, events and attractions

What we need from you 

A minimum of 1 year's experience in a hotel guest service operation
A certificate in hotel management or equivalent 
Proactive, agile, creative, charming and joyful   
Strong knowledge of the local community, including dining, entertainment and attractions  
Excellent communication skills in both English and Chinese (Cantonese and Mandarin) are essential, both spoken and written; knowledge of other languages is a plus

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you apply for the job. Start your journey with us today.

Please send us your full resume along with current and expected salary via email at recruitment@kimptonhongkong.com.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All applications will be treated in strict confidence. Personal data collected will be used for recruitment purpose only. Applicants who do not hear from us within six weeks should consider their applications unsuccessful.

title: Technical Sales & Project Engineer
label: 运营
full_jd:
Role Overview
We are seeking a versatile and results-driven Technical Sales & Project Engineer to drive business growth and ensure the successful delivery of our technical solutions. This unique, multi-faceted role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, technical execution, and operational delivery.
You will not only act as the trusted technical advisor to our clients during the pre-sales phase but will also take ownership of post-sales project management to ensure what is promised is flawlessly executed. Additionally, you will handle key commercial administration duties to keep the sales pipeline and project lifecycles organized and compliant.
Key Responsibilities
1. Technical Sales & Account Management
• Act as the primary technical point of contact for prospective and existing clients, understanding their business needs and mapping them to our product/service portfolio.

• Present and demonstrate complex technical solutions, architecture, and MVPs confidently to both technical stakeholders (engineers/IT) and C-level executives.

• Partner with internal R&D or engineering teams to translate client requirements into robust technical proposals and accurate Scopes of Work (SOW).

• Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts to maximize account value.

• Respond to Technical RFIs (Request for Information) and RFPs (Request for Proposal) with high precision.

2. Post-Sales Project Management
• Lead the transition of won accounts from the sales phase to implementation, acting as the primary Project Manager.

• Define project lifecycles, milestones, deliverables, and resource allocation using project management tools.

• Coordinate with internal development, operations, and engineering teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with client expectations.

• Manage client expectations, lead regular project status meetings, and proactively resolve blockers or scope-creep issues.

• Oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and client sign-off, ensuring smooth solution deployment and handover.

3. Commercial & Sales Administration
• Prepare, issue, and track commercial documents, including quotations, cost sheets, variations, and formal service contracts.

• Maintain accurate, up-to-date client records, sales pipelines, and project documentation within the CRM and internal databases.

• Coordinate vendor registration processes and ensure compliance with client procurement requirements.

• Liaise with the finance and administration teams to monitor project billing milestones, invoice issuance, and payment collections.

• Compile monthly sales performance and project progress reports for executive leadership.

Requirements & Qualifications
Experience & Education
• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical/business discipline.

• 2–5 years of experience in Technical Sales, Pre-Sales Engineering, or Technical Project Management, preferably within a B2B technology, smart solution, or SaaS environment.

• Proven track record of managing technical projects from inception to completion while managing client relationships.

Skills & Competencies
• Technical Acumen: Ability to quickly learn, articulate, and configure technical systems, software architectures, or engineering solutions.

• Project Management: Proficiency with project management methodologies (Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall) and tools (e.g., Jira, Asana, Trello, or MS Project). A PMP or Scrum Master certification is a plus.

• Commercial & Admin Savvy: Familiarity with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and strong proficiency in MS Office (Excel for costing, Word for proposals).

• Communication: Exceptional interpersonal, negotiation, and presentation skills. Ability to bridge the gap between deeply technical teams and commercial stakeholders.

Personal Attributes
• Hybrid Mindset: Equally comfortable closing a deal, building a Gantt chart, and organizing contract paperwork.

• Problem Solver: Highly analytical with a proactive approach to anticipating project risks and client roadblocks.

• Organized & Disciplined: Capable of managing multiple client accounts and project timelines simultaneously without compromising on administrative accuracy.

Job Description

Join Us as a Clinical Research Associate I – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to perform and coordinate different aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. As a Clinical Research Associate I, you'll conduct remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You will manage procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and/or monitoring environments (i.e., FSO, FSP, Government, etc.). Acting as a site processes specialist, you will ensure that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, and SOPs to guarantee subjects' rights, well-being, and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigational sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to your role are outlined in the task matrix.

What You’ll Do:
• Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings
• resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable.
• Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. May help to identify potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Performs trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
• Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
• Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the team as required. Ensures study systems are complete, accurate and updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System).

About Us：
Fung Wing Education focuses on children's learning, and more importantly on their character education. Fung Wing Education was established in 2008. It has a total of 13 education centers, employs more than 100 tutors, and has more than 8,000 students. It is an educational institution trusted by parents and students. Fung Wing Education’s teaching team is committed to designing teaching materials that are more relevant to school curricula and of higher difficulty to stimulate students’ critical thinking skills and concentration.
Fung Wing Kids aim to provide our learners with a range of developmentally appropriate activities to explore their different skills and nurture their early development at this important stage. title: Assistant Logistics Officer
snippet: Responsibilities also include monitoring 3PL performance, inventory control, supporting audit and customs processes.
label: 助理
full_jd:
Your Role

The Assistant Logistics Officer supports JEB’s logistics operations, focusing on shipment execution and sales coordination. The role works very closely with suppliers, warehouses, freight forwarders, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery and customs compliance. Responsibilities also include monitoring 3PL performance, inventory control, supporting audit and customs processes. This is a great opportunity for early‑career professionals to gain end‑to‑end logistics experience and grow into supervisory roles.

 

Key Responsibilities

Handle order processing and coordinate inbound, outbound, re-export, and customs/logistics arrangements.

Coordinate with suppliers, warehouses, and internal teams to track material deliveries and support on‑time project completion.

Issue purchase orders in coordination with factories based on the requested delivery dates.

Maintain in/out inventory records and ensure inventory accuracy.

Verify invoices and obtain approval for payment, audit, and accrual purposes.

Monitor shipment status and track shipments summary across all modes of transport (truck, sea, air, express, couriers).

Support general administrative work, samples and other ad-hoc duties as required.

Qualifications & Experience

Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, or related discipline.

2–3 years of relevant experience in logistics, production, or sales support.

Knowledge of import/export processes, inventory control, customs, duties and taxes.

Responsible, accurate, organized, and willing to learn and take on tasks.

Familiar with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, AI); programming skills are an advantage.

A proactive team player, eager to learn and able to handle pressure and deadlines.

If you have the knowledge, skills, and experience for this role, we would love to hear from you!

In a city renowned for its international outlook and connectivity, The Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts (HKAPA) plays a unique and influential role in nurturing future generations of performing artists, including performers, practitioners, designers, and technicians. Ranked 10th in the 2026 QS World University Rankings for Performing Arts and 1st in Asia, the Academy and its Schools of Chinese Opera, Dance, Drama, Film & Television, Music, and Theatre & Entertainment Arts form a vibrant centre of practice, production, teaching, and practice-as-research. Its outstanding reputation is reinforced by the quality of its graduates and its partnerships with centres of excellence locally, regionally, and internationally. Through international residencies, visiting artists, and a distinguished alumni network—including some of the most respected professionals in their disciplines—the Academy is committed to training future world-class performers and practitioners.

Reporting to the Head of Student Affairs, the appointee performs general administrative duties to assist with the day-to-day operation of the Student Affairs Office, including administering student finance, scholarships, student accommodation, and other duties assigned by the Head of Student Affairs.

The appointee will work on weekday mornings or afternoons for a maximum of 16 hours per week and occasionally on Saturday mornings.

Applicants should have:

(a) A recognised Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification;

(b) Normally, at least two years of administrative experience, preferably at a tertiary educational institution;

(c) Good command of spoken and written English and Chinese (Cantonese and Putonghua);

(d) Sound numerical sense and a high level of computer literacy, particularly EXCEL and word-processing;

(e) Excellent interpersonal and communication skills;

(f) Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail; and

(g) A customer service orientation to support students' needs.

TERMS OF APPOINTMENT

Appointment will be initially for 1-year starting from July 2026.  The starting salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

APPLICATIONS

To apply, please submit a completed Application Form (https://www.hkapa.edu/job-opportunity/part_time-assistant-executive-officer-student-affairs), together with a cover letter, curriculum vitae and copies of academic qualifications, to the Human Resources Office, The Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts, No.1 Gloucester Road, Wanchai, Hong Kong, or email (hr•@hkapa.edu) on or before 12 June 2026.  Please quote reference code 'PT-AEO(StA)' in the Application Form.  Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

We protect what’s special about them, while offering them rich knowledge, opportunities, and best practices; and they get to be part of something bigger. Ensuring that the children are safe and secure at all times

What the role is ?

Perform API reviews and delta name screening to identify potential risk factors and support compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

Conduct ongoing monitoring and daily screening activities, ensuring quality and timely completion within required turnaround time.

Perform due diligence checks on client profiles to assess risk and maintain data accuracy.

Liaise with internal stakeholders to support operational and risk management needs.

Participate in system enhancement initiatives and user acceptance testing (UAT) where required.

The Sales Operations Associate supports distributor/Sales Agent effectiveness and ensures disciplined trade marketing execution across markets. Coordinate credit note and payment processes for trade marketing investments, ensuring alignment between approved spend and actual execution

Manage SAP processes for trade marketing activities, including budget setup, spending control, and administration in line with financial controls

Prepare, submit, and monitor Purchase Requisitions (PRs) and Purchase Orders (POs), ensuring accuracy and compliance with approval workflows

Track budget utilization vs. plan across programs, channels, and vendors, and provide visibility on variances and risks

Support month-end/period-end activities including accruals and reconciliation between SAP records and trade execution

 

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Marketing, or a related field

At least 3-5 years experience in FMCG or comparable industry sales

Fluent in English and Cantonese; proficiency in Mandarin is an advantage

Assistant Manager to the Director in the Institute for Precision Prevention (IPP) (Ref.: 536448)

 

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly qualified and experienced Assistant Manager to support the Director of the Institute for Precision Prevention (IPP) in advancing the protecting.health Global Initiative in Hong Kong, led by Nobel Prize Laureate Prof. Dr. Ferenc Krausz. This position is integral to establishing Hong Kong as a leading hub for personalized preventive medicine research and precision health innovation.

 

The successful candidate will be appointed as an administrative staff in the IPP, to commence as soon as possible, on a three-year fixed-term basis, with the possibility of renewal, subject to funding availability and satisfactory performance.

 

protecting.health aims to revolutionize healthcare by pioneering personalized preventive medicine for prevalent non-communicable diseases (NCDs) including cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and cancer, claiming 17 million premature deaths every year. The protecting.health/hong kong study is a large-scale, longitudinal health monitoring study that is part of a series of identically designed studies implemented in multiple countries to jointly develop the world's first health screening test for early, pre-symptomatic detection of prevalent NCDs through advanced blood molecular phenotyping and artificial intelligence.

 

This position offers a unique opportunity to play a central role in building the infrastructure and external profile of a landmark initiative with global impact. The Assistant Manager will work in close collaboration with the IPP leadership team to ensure the successful implementation and visibility of IPP's research programs.

 

Key Responsibilities

Project Implementation & Coordination

Coordinate and supervise the roll-out and implementation of the protecting.health/hong kong study, working closely with the central protecting.health team to ensure alignment with protocol and project requirements and operational milestones
Monitor project progress, identify risks and bottlenecks, and implement solutions to ensure timely and successful delivery
Facilitate communication and collaboration among multi-disciplinary teams and external partners
Oversee the implementation of necessary funding, including project planning, timeline management, stakeholder coordination, and deliverable tracking

 

Strategic Communication & Institutional Representation

Build and enhance IPP's external presence and serve as a liaison between IPP and HKU management and leadership, ensuring alignment with institutional priorities and facilitating administrative support
Represent IPP at institutional meetings, present project updates, and contribute to strategic planning discussions

 

Operational Support

Support the Director in strategic planning, operational decision-making, and resource allocation
Prepare reports, presentations, and documentation for internal and external stakeholders, including funding bodies and institutional review boards
Assist in the preparation of grant applications, progress reports, and scientific communications

 

Qualifications & Qualities

University degree, preferably a Master’s degree or Ph.D. in life sciences (e.g., molecular biology, epidemiology, public health, biomedical sciences) or a related field
Demonstrated skills and experience in project management in clinical research, population health studies, or large-scale research initiatives
Excellent organizational skills with proven ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English and in Chinese (Cantonese)

full_jd:
About Us

We are a private equity firm headquartered in Hong Kong. The Managing Partner is currently seeking an Executive Assistant to report directly to them.

Role Summary

This position serves as the Executive Assistant to the Managing Partner. The scope of responsibilities covers office administrative matters as well as operational coordination at the partner's personal and family level, including home renovation projects, children's school admissions, and the recruitment and management of domestic staff.

The role is positioned as a long-term, stable operational position with clear responsibilities, primarily based on standard working hours with occasional emergency handling. Prior background in the financial industry is not required for candidates.

Key Responsibilities:

Corporate Administration (Approx. 50%)

-Manage the Managing Partner's schedule and meetings, organizing the next day's agenda one day in advance.

-Set up video conferences, attend meetings, record, and prepare meeting minutes.

-Read and reply to emails on behalf of the partner, and report important matters upward in a timely manner.

-Travel arrangements: Determine budgets and itineraries, and execute in collaboration with the company's administration department.

-Liaise with the finance teams of various subsidiaries and coordinate related matters.

Personal & Family Affairs (Approx. 50%)

-Coordination of home renovation projects: Liaise with renovation companies, designers, and suppliers, and track progress.

-Full-process support for children's school admissions: Form filling, document organization, deadline tracking, and interview scheduling.

-Liaise with the property management office to handle daily matters.

-Recruitment of domestic staff (Filipino domestic helpers): Visa and contract processing, daily scheduling, attendance tracking, and handling of unexpected incidents.

-Driver recruitment and daily management.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree or above (Overseas study background is a plus, but not required).

Fluent in Mandarin and English; proficiency in Cantonese is preferred to facilitate communication with local contractors and property management.

3 to 5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant / Personal Assistant / Administration or Operations related role; experience in domestic staff HR or large-scale project coordination is preferred.

Proactive, reliable, detail-oriented, and highly discreet (tight-lipped); possess good stress resilience and emergency handling capabilities.

Working hours: Monday to Friday, standard working hours; occasional overtime or weekend phone support may be required based on the actual needs of family, renovation, or school matters.

Signing a confidentiality agreement is required upon onboarding.

Personal Resume / CV

A short essay of no more than 300 words describing a challenging issue you have solved independently, emphasizing your thought process and methodology.

We will contact shortlisted candidates within two weeks of receiving the application materials.

关于我们 About

snippet: responsible for providing administrative and operational support to IT projects and daily IT services.
label: 项目
full_jd:
In a city renowned for its international outlook and connectivity, The Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts (HKAPA) plays a unique and influential role in nurturing future generations of performing artists, including performers, practitioners, designers, and technicians. Ranked 10th in the 2026 QS World University Rankings for Performing Arts and 1st in Asia, the Academy and its Schools of Chinese Opera, Dance, Drama, Film & Television, Music, and Theatre & Entertainment Arts form a vibrant centre of practice, production, teaching, and practice-as-research. Its outstanding reputation is reinforced by the quality of its graduates and its partnerships with centres of excellence locally, regionally, and internationally. Through international residencies, visiting artists, and a distinguished alumni network—including some of the most respected professionals in their disciplines—the Academy is committed to training future world-class performers and practitioners.

Reporting to the Enterprise Systems Architect, the Project Officer (Administration) will be responsible for providing administrative and operational support to IT projects and daily IT services.  The postholder will assist in system administration tasks, including server monitoring, user account management, and routine maintenance.  The role also involves supporting IT asset inventory, tracking, and lifecycle management, as well as preparing and maintaining IT documentation, guidelines, records, and reports. The postholder will assist in procurement activities, such as handling quotations, purchase orders, and vendor coordination. In addition, the appointee will provide basic technical support to users, escalating issues where appropriate, and liaise with internal teams and external vendors to support IT operations.  The postholder will also assist in scheduling, meetings, and project coordination activities, and perform other IT administrative and support duties as assigned by the supervisors.

Requirements:

(a) A Higher Diploma or above in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Studies, Information Management, or related disciplines.

(b) Normally, at least one year of IT-related experience.

(c) Basic knowledge of information technology or strong interest in information technology operations and support.

(d) Solid working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, and MS Outlook.

(e) Experience or knowledge in system administration (i.e., Windows Server, Linux server maintenance) is an advantage.

(f) Knowledge or exposure to IT asset inventory, documentation, and procurement processes is preferred.

(g) Strong proficiency in both written and spoken English and Chinese, with good communication and interpersonal skills.

(h) Experience in the tertiary education sector or similar institutional environments is an advantage.

(i) Well‑organised, detail‑minded, and capable of handling multiple administrative and technical tasks.

(j) Fresh graduates with substantial internship or relevant hands‑on experience will also be considered.

TERMS OF APPOINTMENT

Appointment will be on a two-year renewable contract, subject to performance and mutual agreement.  A gratuity payment may be granted upon satisfactory completion of the full contract. Fringe benefits include leave, medical, and dental benefits. The starting salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

APPLICATIONS

To apply, please submit a completed Application Form (https://www.hkapa.edu/job-opportunity/project-officer-administration), together with a cover letter, curriculum vitae and copies of academic qualifications, to the Human Resources Office, The Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts, No.1 Gloucester Road, Wanchai, Hong Kong, or email (hr•@hkapa.edu) on or before 14 June 2026.  Please quote reference code 'PjO(Adm)' in the Application Form.  Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

HKAPA is an equal opportunity employer.

Personal data collected will be used for recruitment-related purposes only.

A unique aspect of this role is its collaborative structure: the accounts are currently anchored with our Food & Beverage (F&B) team. title: (Senior) Research Manager

full_jd:
(Senior) Research Manager

What We Do

Our Customer & Employee Experience team helps organizations create exceptional experiences by improving how customers engage with brands and how employees thrive at work. We focus on understanding what drives customer satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy, as well as how to build high-performing workplace environments.

Our work combines traditional research methods and technology-based platforms such as Qualtrics and Medallia. We collect and analyze data through surveys and dashboards, turning insights into clear, actionable recommendations.

We manage a mix of long-term tracker studies that monitor client performance over time and ad hoc projects that deliver quick, targeted insights to address key business challenges. Our goal is to help organizations make data-driven decisions that enhance both customer and employee experiences.

 

Team Culture

We are a team that fosters a client-centric, collaborative, supportive, and growth-focused environment. We care deeply about individual’s professional development and provide the tools, mentorship, and opportunities to set everyone up for success.

We also emphasize team spirit and well-being, creating a safe environment where everyone can be themselves, feel valued, and share ideas openly. We work hard, celebrate successes together, and continuously support one another.

 

Role Focus Areas

The Research Manager will play a key role in leading and delivering research programs — from commissioning to execution, analysis, and reporting. They will manage projects independently, act as the main contact for day-to-day client communication, and ensure the delivery of high-quality outputs that drive actionable business impact.

For reporting, presentations, and in-depth client engagement, the manager will act as a key contributor with guidance from senior team members. In addition, the manager will contribute to proposal writing, quotation preparation, and other business development initiatives to support the team’s growth. The manager will also mentor junior team members and contribute to building the team’s advisory capabilities, as well as fostering a client-centric and learning-oriented culture.

 

We are recruiting Research Managers with expertise in two key areas:

1. Technology-Based Research

We are looking for candidates who are tech-savvy and experienced in managing research programs using CXM platforms such as Qualtrics or Medallia. The ideal candidate combines technical capability with strategic thinking, translating data into insights that inform business decisions and strengthen client relationships. Experience in both client and agency environments is an advantage.

 

2. Traditional Market Research

We are seeking candidates with strong project management and analytical skills to lead complex, large-scale, and multi-market research programs. The ideal candidate is confident working with data, identifying trends, and delivering meaningful insights that drive client impact. Prior market research agency experience and a proven track record in end-to-end project delivery are preferred.

What It Takes to Succeed

We’re seeking passionate and motivated professionals who demonstrate the following:

·        Genuine interest in market research and a drive for continuous professional growth

·        Curiosity and eagerness to learn about clients’ industries and business challenges

·        Strong business acumen and ability to turn data into clear, actionable insights

·        Fast learner with a growth mindset and adaptability

·        Proactive, accountable, and reliable, even under pressure

·        Creative and resourceful, finding smarter ways to work (e.g., leveraging AI tools or process automation)

·        Excellent project management, organization, and time management skills

·        Tech-savvy, comfortable with research platforms and digital tools

·        Collaborative team player with excellent interpersonal skills

·        Skilled in managing relationships across all levels

·        Disciplined and inspiring, serving as a role model and mentor to junior team members

·        Strong communication and presentation abilities

·        Fluent in English, Cantonese, and Mandarin

·        Bachelor’s degree or above

 

We are committed to equality, treating people fairly, promoting a positive and inclusive working environment, and ensuring diversity of people and views. We recognize that this is important for our business success - a more diverse workforce will enable us to reflect better and understand the world we research and ultimately deliver better research and insight to our clients. We understand the importance of choice and offer a blended work environment - office and work from home.

Come to join us if you consider yourself agile, bold, collaborative, determined, and entrepreneurial!

Send us your application to us and we will reach back to you for a chat!

title: Upper House Hong Kong - (Assistant) E-Commerce Manager
snippet: Here at Upper House Hong Kong, we don't do ordinary things. We thrive on the different and the excitement.
label: 市场
full_jd:
Here at Upper House Hong Kong, we don't do ordinary things. We thrive on the different and the exciting, and yes perhaps a little quirky and without doubt, fun.

With a dynamic culture and an open door for your feedback, you're not just filling a role — you're owning it. We provide the training and the freedom for you to flourish, with leaders who support and encourage you. The difference is you. Everyday is a fresh page in our collective story.

Ready to join us at Upper House Hong Kong?

Upper House Hong Kong conjures a sense of tranquillity with the warmth of a private residence. Overlooking Hong Kong’s bright lights from above Admiralty’s Pacific Place, our House has 117 rooms. Bespoke service, well-crafted natural materials and a design aesthetic based around the ‘Upward Journey’ creates a timeless serenity that flows through the different rooms of our House.

Job Overview

This role manages all initiatives related to revenue generation and distribution channels to maximise profitability of our hotels. We strive to acquire business by achieving the hotel yield, directing sales activities and implementing marketing plan. Those who are thrive on challenges and are passionate about meeting new people will enjoy this role.

Key Responsibilities

Welcome to the core of what being an E-Commerce Manager is all about!

Here's the quick lowdown on what you'll do day-to-day:

Formulate and execute room sales strategies and promotional campaigns across direct channels (website and WeChat Mall) to drive revenue

Monitor and optimize performance of OTA partners and other distribution channels. Build and maintain strong partnerships to negotiate opportunities, manage relationships, and collaborate on promotional campaigns that align with our luxury brand positioning

Identify and create cross-promotional opportunities with strategic third-party sites, agents, and sister properties, ensuring brand consistency and revenue growth. Assist in developing new products

Oversee and maintain the property’s brand website, WeChat Mall, SEO/SEM, and other e-commerce touchpoints with Marketing Team

Ensure all content, pricing, and offers are aligned with commercial objectives and seasonal marketing plans

Analyze customer data, booking trends, and channel performance metrics. Provide actionable insights to the Revenue and Sales teams to adapt pricing, forecast and refine strategies that enhance conversions, improve customer retention, and identify expansion opportunities

Maintain a close, collaborative working relationship with the Marketing team to jointly develop and timely online advertising and marketing strategies based on targeted market segments and seasonal demand. Partner seamlessly with Operating teams to deeply understand hotel products and ensure smooth operations

Submit monthly sales activity reports, presentations and perform other assigned duties

Requirements

Here's exactly what you need to excel in this role:

The Non-Negotiables (Must-Haves):

A degree in Marketing, Communications, E-Commerce, or a related discipline, with at least 3 years of experience in luxury hotel marketing or e-commerce, and a strong understanding of the travel, hotel, and OTA landscape

Solid familiarity with AI-driven search trends and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), combined with sharp analytical thinking and the agility to develop deep expertise quickly

A proven track record of delivering projects and campaigns that generate measurable commercial impact, with the ability to translate brand positioning into compelling and effective online strategies in close partnership with Revenue and Marketing teams

The Cherries on Top (Nice-to-Haves):

Highly self-motivated, resilient under pressure, and an excellent team player with outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, able to build trusted relationships across Revenue, Marketing, Sales, and Operation teams

Octopus Holdings Limited

Born from Hong Kong's demand for fast, convenient, and reliable payment solutions, Octopus introduced the world's first contactless multi-modal transit payment system in 1997. Since then, this homegrown FinTech company has pioneered innovative payment solutions for urban living across four continents. Our Vision To become the most preferred payment and lifestyle companion that connects customers and business partners through our best-in-class products and services. Our Mission Making everyday life easier. Our Values Customer Centricity, Simplicity & Trustworthiness. Dedicated to addressing customer needs and adapting to evolving market trends, Octopus has broadened its services beyond transportation to encompass retail, e-commerce, cross-border transactions, and travel abroad. Today, we serve approximately 98% of Hong Kong’s population, processing around 15 million transactions at more than HK$300 million on average daily. At the heart of our success are our colleagues. We value mutual respect, foster collaboration, and encourage innovation and partnership. Join us and shape the future of payment solutions. Your impact starts here!

Assistant Manager, Marketing

Job Responsibilities:

Play a key role to design and deliver measurable and sustainable integrated marketing campaigns that drive retail business targets
Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, external partners, vendors, and retail merchants to deliver mutually beneficial marketing initiatives
Strengthen brand visibility and customer engagement in the retail market, ensuring brand consistency and compelling messaging across all campaigns
Develop marketing communication materials, including content and visuals planning, performance measurement, marketing automation, and social media operations. Ensure quality delivery of marketing executions in a clear and simple manner
Manage end‑to‑end marketing programme implementation, prepare business reports and performance tracking and analyses, evaluates effectiveness of digital programs and provide insights to optimise campaign results
Support ad‑hoc projects and tasks as assigned

Job Requirements:

Degree holder in Marketing, Business Administration or equivalent 
Minimum 5 years’ relevant working experience, with solid exposure to digital marketing/CRM 
Relevant experience in merchant partnerships or retail collaboration
Experience in using digital marketing automation tools, such as Adobe Campaigns
Hands-on experience with marketing applications and data analytics tools, including Google Analytics, Power BI, etc.
Proficient in MS Office, including Word, PowerPoint, and Excel, and leveraging AI tools to enhance daily work efficiency
Experience in video and photo editing will be considered an advantage
Proven experience in managing integrated campaign execution (including content creation and production, social media angle and insights)
High attention to detail and ability to work independently under tight timelines 
Passionate about digital marketing, e-commerce, and technology innovations

We offer successful candidate an attractive remuneration package and excellent career prospects. Interested parties please send your resume, present and expected salary, contact details and quoting the reference number by clicking "Apply"

Visit our web site: http://www.octopus.com.hk/

The personal data collected will be used for recruitment purposes only. If you are not contacted by us within six weeks, you may consider your application unsuccessful. Personal data with an unsuccessful applicant will be destroyed 12 months after rejection of the application. Vocational Training Council

VIBRANT AND VITAL VTC

VTC is a vocational and professional education and training provider established in Hong Kong in 1982. With some 200,000 students across our 14 member institutions, this not only makes us VIBRANT but VITAL to the Hong Kong educational landscape. We provide a spectrum of opportunities through multiple pathways for graduates to determine their own destination, whether it is employment or further studies. If you believe that the provision of a valued choice for learners to acquire the values, skills and knowledge for lifelong learning and enhanced employability is a worthy mission, then consider joining us.

Part-time (Daytime) Assistant Lecturer

Youth College
 
Department / Section : Language Centre
Ref. no : O/YC(KF,TSW)-LC/Temp Term AL(ENG)/06/26

Subject Areas: English and Communication
 
Major Duties:
(a)  To perform teaching duties, including supervision of students’ projects;
(b)  To carry out duties in relation to student and academic administration;
(c)  To assist in developing programme curriculum and teaching, learning and assessment materials;
(d)  To organise language enhancement activities; and
(e)  To participate in projects and functions of the Language Centre.

Requirements :
(a)  (i)  A recognised degree in English Language / English Language and Literature / Language Studies (English) / Linguistics / Education (English) / English Communication / Translation (English); OR
      (ii) A recognised degree in a non-relevant field; AND a relevant English teaching qualification, such as Postgraduate Certificate / Diploma in Education (major in English), Teaching English as a Second Language or Teaching English as a Foreign Language or Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages (CELTA / Trinity CertTESOL and English-teaching certification recognised by TESL Canada) or English for Specific Purposes (ESP).  A transcript with course details including the number of hours of instruction and practicum should be provided for consideration;
(b)  Good communication, presentation and digital skills; and
(c)  A good team player, able to work on own initiative and willing to meet challenges.

Notes:|
(1)  The post is at the rank of “Teaching Associate”.
(2)  Applicants with substantial experience and achievements in the relevant field but without the required academic / professional qualifications OR those with exceptional academic / professional qualifications but with less experience may also apply.
(3)  Preference will be given to candidates who have relevant teaching experience.
(4)  Shortlisted applicants will be required to take a written assessment.
(5)  The work location will be Kwai Fong or Tin Shui Wai.
(6)  In support of the Sexual Conviction Record Check (SCRC) Scheme launched by the Hong Kong Police Force, all prospective appointees will be requested to undergo the SCRC at the advanced stage of the employment process.

Application Procedures:
A completed application form [VTC-1 (Rev. 11/2024)], together with a full curriculum vitae, should be sent to the College Secretariat, Youth College (Tin Shui Wai), 11 Tin Ho Road, Tin Shui Wai, New Territories, or by fax to 3713 4411, or by e-mail to yctsw-hr@vtc.edu.hk.  Please specify on the envelope, or at the cover page of the fax, or in the subject of the e-mail, whichever is appropriate, the reference of the post being applied for.
 
Candidates should take note of the following:
(1)  Completed application form (VTC-1) and detailed curriculum vitae (CV) should be combined into one file in PDF format with a file size below 10MB.
(2)  The file should be saved with the applicant’s name as “surname and given name”, e.g. “CHAN Siu-lam.pdf”.
(3)  For the email subject, please cite “Application for Temporary / Term Assistant Lecturer (Ref. No.: O/YC(KF,TSW)-LC/Temp Term AL(ENG)/06/26)”.
(4)  Original and copy of other supporting documents are to be provided at a later stage upon request.
      
Closing date for application: 26 June 2026

The VTC Languages Discipline oversees the operation of 17 Language Centres (LCs) located on all IVE/HKDI/HKIIT/YC campuses and the Language Section of HTI/CCI/ICI.  If candidates apply to more than one LC for the post of Term Assistant Lecturer and are shortlisted, they may be invited to attend an interview conducted by one LC only.  Application forms received by one LC may be passed to another LC for appointment purposes.
 
Applicants not invited for interview within 10 weeks from the closing date may consider their applications unsuccessful.
 
The Council reserves the right not to fill the post(s).

Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute (ASTRI) is founded in 2000 by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. As Hong Kong’s largest government-funded research and development centre, ASTRI is a key force and super‑connector driving innovation and technology advancement in Hong Kong, the Greater Bay Area, and the global innovation ecosystem. This role is strengthened through its merger with Nano and Advanced Materials Institute (NAMI).
Committed to bringing high‑impact research from lab to market, ASTRI advances interdisciplinary, market‑driven R&D that delivers practical innovations for industry and meaningful benefits for society.
Its technological strengths and capabilities enable AI‑powered, cross‑disciplinary ICT and advanced materials solutions across Smart City, Financial Technologies, Digital Health and Life Sciences, New Industrialisation and Intelligent Manufacturing, Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (ASIC) and Advanced Electronics, New Energy and Energy Storage, and Green and ESG Technologies.
Over the years, ASTRI has cultivated a strong pool of I&T talent and earned numerous international awards for its pioneering innovations and contributions to industry and the community. Following the merger with NAMI, ASTRI’s cumulative global patent portfolio has grown to over 1,500, with more than 2,200 technologies successfully transferred to industry.
With enhanced scale and capabilities, ASTRI is uniquely positioned to elevate Hong Kong’s innovation capacity, accelerate technology commercialisation, and drive societal and economic progress through world‑class applied research.
To support our constant endeavour to position Hong Kong as a world-class smart city and an international hub of innovation and technology, we are seeking qualified professionals to fill the following position(s):

Ecosystem strategy & development

Channel & partner management
• Build and manage a portfolio of strategic partners to scale adoption of our technologies.

• Design channel programmes to enable partners to take our technologies to market.

Commercialisation & Go‑to‑Market (GTM)

We are looking for a hands-on Procurement Specialist to own vendor sourcing, negotiation, and purchasing for live events and PR campaigns.
You will be the bridge between creative vision and supply reality. Working alongside event producers and account teams, you will identify, vet, and manage vendors, secure best-in-class pricing, and ensure materials and services arrive on time and within scope.

• Conduct RFQs and competitive bidding for large-scale events

• Negotiate pricing, payment terms, cancellation policies, and liability terms

Purchasing & Logistics (30%):
• Process purchase orders (POs) and track order status

• Coordinate delivery schedules with venues and warehouse teams

• Flag budget risks and scope creep early

• Maintain procurement records for post-event reconciliation

• 2–4 years in procurement, supply chain, or vendor management (event, hospitality, or marketing agency experience strongly preferred)

• Strong negotiation skills and familiarity with vendor contracts (basic legal terms: indemnity, insurance requirements, cancellation)

• Excellent communication and follow-through

full_jd:
Occasions Asia Pacific 天機亞太集團
Founded in 1987, Occasions Asia Pacific is a leading comprehensive and integrated communications group with insightful knowledge of China’s fast-changing political & and consumer landscape. Our unrivaled exclusive relationships with government, brands, influencers, business & social communities in Hong Kong and Mainland China and abroad empower us to be a highly respected and trusting partner to global brands looking to gain presence in Asia. From brand consulting, creative, PR, social media, digital marketing to experiential events and lifestyle experiences curation, we offer 360-degree services across luxury lifestyle, arts & culture, tourism & hospitality, retail & property sectors. Driven by professionalism, integrity, and relentless pursuit to excellence, our culturally diverse team of experts integrate creativity, artistic sensibility and the power of data-insights to deliver innovative bespoke campaigns to our clients. Headquartered in Hong Kong, we have branch offices in Macau, Beijing, Shanghai and Singapore.

About the role
As we continue to scale, we are looking for a sharp, detail-driven Compliance and Legal Officer to join our team—someone who understands the fast-paced, high-liability nature of the PR and events world.
Role Overview
This is not a traditional corporate legal desk job. You will be embedded in live project execution, ensuring every pitch, contract, venue agreement, talent release, and vendor deal complies with legal standards and company policy. You will work side-by-side with producers, account leads, and operations managers.

Key Responsibilities
Legal (60% – due to high volume of event-related contracts):
• Draft, review, and negotiate:

• Venue agreements (including cancellation, force majeure, liability clauses)

• Talent/celebrity appearance releases

• Vendor contracts (catering, AV, staging, security)

• Sponsorship and brand partnership agreements

• NDAs with clients and third-party agencies

• Model/likeness release forms and photo/video usage rights

• Manage insurance requirements (COIs, liability waivers, event cancellation policies)

• Maintain a central contract repository for all events and campaigns

• Advise on intellectual property usage (logos, music, trademarks in event branding)

Compliance (40%):
• Ensure all events comply with:

• Local venue and municipal permits / fire safety codes

• Alcohol licensing and serving regulations (if applicable)

• Data privacy (GDPR/CCPA) for guest lists, RSVPs, and lead capture

• Health & safety protocols (especially for large gatherings)

• Anti-bribery and gifting policies (when dealing with press/influencers)

• Conduct pre-event legal audits and post-event compliance reviews

• Train event coordinators and PR account teams on basic legal do’s and don’ts

• Handle incident reporting (guest injury, property damage, legal threats on-site)

Qualifications
Essential:
• Bachelor’s degree in Law, Business Law, or related field.

• 2+ years of legal/compliance experience, ideally with exposure to events, media, marketing, or hospitality.

• Strong knowledge of contract law, liability waivers, and IP rights.

• Ability to simplify legal language for non-legal teams.

• Extremely organized under pressure.

Highly Preferred:
• Experience in PR agency, event production, or entertainment law.

• Familiarity with COI (certificate of insurance) requirements for venues.

• Knowledge of local municipal event permitting processes.

We offer excellent opportunities and package to successful candidate.
(includes 5 days work -week, medical plan and dental insurance after probation, etc.)
Interested party please provide a full resume, portfolio with CURRENT and EXPECTED salary and your earliest availability to Occasions Asia Pacific.
Please note: candidates without current and expected salary will NOT be considered.
All personal data collected will be kept strictly confidential and only be used for recruitment.

Company Introduction

As a bank consortium, JETCO currently has more than 30 member banks and connects around 3,000 ATMs in Hong Kong and Macau to provide convenient and reliable ATM services across both locations. JETCO ATM switching network also connects to multiple international ATM networks.

JETCO also offers a series of value-added services to member banks, such as payment gateway for e-Commerce and inter-bank cardless cash withdrawal service, to enable member banks to provide customers with innovative and high-quality services.

In 2018, The Hong Kong Monetary Authority designated the relevant payment systems operated by JETCO for the processing of Hong Kong retail payment transactions as a designated retail payment system (“designated RPS”) pursuant to the Payment Systems and Stored Value Facilities Ordinance (“PSSVFO”).

In 2019, JETCO launched JETCO APIX, the first open API exchange platform in Hong Kong.  By riding on JETCO APIX, banks and other institution customers can interconnect with their business partners in various industries via API to co-develop innovative products and services for improving service quality and customer experience.

In 2022, JETCO CDI Portal for data consumers launched for supporting banks to easily onboard to Commercial Data Interchange (“CDI”), and JETCO has been named as a solution provider of CDI.  In 2023, JETCO CDI Portal has extended to support data providers to onboard to CDI.  Moreover, JETCO CDI APIs & value-added features for data consumers were launched.  Coming will have more value-added features launching for both data consumers and data providers.

In July 2024, JETCO IADS Proxy Service launched for supporting banks to participate HKMA’s Interbank Account Data Sharing (“IADS”) programme as the data consuming bank to retrieve their customers’ bank account data from other banks subject to customer consents.

In October 2024, JETCO has joined as the participant in Project Ensemble and has connected to Ensemble Sandbox, as well as completed PoC by partnering with banks to testify Payment-versus-Payment (“PvP”) and Delivery-versus-Payment (“DvP”) scenarios. In November 2025, we became one of the participants of EnsembleTX and partnered with banks to test different use cases of interbank settlement using tokenised deposit (“TD”) by riding on our distributed ledger technology (“DLT”) TD platform.

title: Senior Manager, Communication & Public Relations
company: Delivery Hero Food Hong Kong Limited
snippet: Join us today!
label: 内容
full_jd:
"To be the most loved everyday food and groceries destination!" - that’s our mission at foodpanda (small ‘f’).

foodpanda is the largest food and grocery delivery platform in Asia, outside of China. Operating in more than 400 cities across 11 markets, we continue to expand and grow in our core food delivery business, as well as in new verticals like grocery deliveries, with a strong tech infrastructure at our core. From our restaurants-partners, cloud kitchens and cloud grocery stores — foodpanda is just one tap away, getting everything you need into your hands quickly and conveniently!

We are looking for enthusiastic problem solvers to join us in scaling our platform, to digitalise businesses in Asia, uplift rider livelihoods and build a hyper-convenient platform for our customers. If you love working with technology to create solutions and are not afraid to roll up your sleeves to get things done, you will find your tribe here at foodpanda. Our diverse and high-performing team comprises people from more than 60 nationalities, and we welcome all experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives.

Job Description

End-to-End PR Strategy & Execution
Translate the department’s long-term vision into concrete, actionable plans. You will actively develop brand key messages and ensure they are consistently integrated across all communication channels.

Proactive Risk Assessment & Crisis Mitigation
Actively monitor and analyse public sentiment to provide immediate advice to mitigate risks. As a core guardian of brand reputation, you will support the Team Head in managing media and stakeholders during issues and crises, while simultaneously architecting post-crisis recovery plans.

Executive Profiling & Content Development
Lead corporate communication initiatives from the ground up. This involves identifying strategic thought-leadership opportunities for executives and personally refining scripts, speeches, and presentations that aligned with business strategies and brand messaging.

Consumer Communications & Branding Event Management
Drive brand reputation and consumer loyalty by spearheading creative PR campaigns and event activations. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of branding events, ensuring every touchpoint aligns with our core values and effectively communicates our unique brand story to our wider consumer base.

Senior Media Engagement
Leverage deep-seated relationships with news editors and key opinion leaders to secure high-quality coverage across traditional and digital media. You will act as the lead for sensitive media inquiries, ensuring nuanced and professional responses.

Operational Bridge & Cross-Functional Support
Serve as the key project manager between the PR team and internal departments, including regional and central teams. You will ensure strategic alignment on PR initiatives and provide communications expertise to support and solve cross-departmental issues.

High-Stakes Copywriting & Quality Control
Maintain the standard for bilingual (English and Chinese) communications. As the final gatekeeper for external and corporate materials, you ensure every piece of content is punchy, accurate, and on-brand.

Agency Stewardship
Act as the primary strategic contact for PR agencies. You are responsible for ensuring agency output aligns with business goals by setting clear KPIs, managing budgets, and driving maximum ROI through high-quality execution.

Qualifications

A bachelor’s degree in marketing, PR / communications, journalism or related areas

At least 10 years of working experience in the PR-related field. Agency or in-house background are welcome

An independent and highly motivated fast learner

A team player, with sociable character and positive attitude towards new challenges

Establish and maintain relationships with internal departments 

Work closely with the team to support the management and recovery of crisis situations

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, fluency in both written and spoken English and Chinese

Adaptable in a fast-paced environment.  Things move very quickly around here, but you thrive in that.

Fun! We work hard, so we can play harder.

 What We Offer

A dynamic and challenging work environment.

A company committed to developing you personally and professionally.

A great working atmosphere with regular company and team events.

A vibrant and international team committed to diversity and inclusion.

Responsibility from day one in a fast growing and global company.

Other benefits include free food, health and dental insurance, and learning and development opportunities!

Our parent company, Delivery Hero, is a global leader in the food delivery industry processing over 3 million orders every day and operating in 40+ markets in the world, with 18,000 employees and approximately 500,000+ restaurant partners.

About Resolve 
Founded in 2017, Resolve Foundation is an award-winning Section 88 charity dedicated to empowering changemakers. Our vision is to create a Hong Kong where everyone belongs and upholds inclusion. Despite being a global city, 1 in 8 people in Hong Kong report experiencing discrimination (EOC, 2021). We believe we all can be empowered to actively change this, in big and small ways.

Our mission is to amplify marginalized voices, empower diverse changemakers and build intersectional communities to elevate our collective social impact. Learn more here. Our vision is for a Hong Kong where everyone is heard and can take action for their community. Our values stand for Resolve: Rights, Equality, Solidarity, Organization, Leadership, Voice and Empowerment. Our organizational culture emphasizes:  diversity, learning, responsibility, collaboration and gratitude. Learn more: resolvehk.org.

About the Role
Resolve is seeking an experienced Head of Program to lead the Community Changemaker Fellowship (CCF), our flagship initiative empowering diverse changemakers to drive more equitable and inclusive communities in Hong Kong. Reporting to the Senior Program Director, you will set and operationalize the fellowship’s strategic direction—ensuring CCF is delivered with strong quality, deep inclusion, and measurable outcomes across its three interconnected components: Talent Development, Participatory Grantmaking, and Community Building.

In this role, you will bring the evolved fellowship model to life: equipping diverse fellows with practical, intersectional leadership capacity; empowering fellows to ideate and implement impactful community projects through our Opportunity Fund; and strengthening belonging and sector connection through community-led learning, peer exchange, and network building. This is more than program management—it’s leadership with purpose.

You will also lead, coach, and develop the CCF program team (two direct reports), ensuring we stay nimble, learner-centred, and community-driven as CCF evolves. A key part of your mandate is to help refine CCF’s impact framework and partner ecosystem—strengthening relationships with stakeholders, collaborating with peer organizations, and supporting our funders as we build long-term program growth and sustainability aligned to Resolve’s mission.

If you’re a people-first leader who thrives at the intersection of inclusion, community empowerment, and measurable social impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Job Duties

Strategic leadership: Own CCF strategy and long-term direction aligned with Resolve’s mission and values.

Program delivery & evaluation: Oversee design, implementation, and evaluation across talent development, participatory grantmaking, and community building.

Impact & learning: Maintain the program impact framework and evaluation tools; ensure timely evaluations for learning. Lead on the development of our ten year learning journal to mark Resolve’s 10 year anniversary in 2027. 

Partnerships & funder relations: Build and manage relationships with funders and ecosystem partners with the Program Manager/Senior Program Director.

Budget & sustainability: Oversee budgeting with senior leadership and support resourcing/funder cultivation/grant proposals.

Risk & safeguarding: Maintain a risk registry covering delivery, safeguarding, and community engagement; escalate as needed.

Comms & representation: Develop and lead the CCF communications strategy ensuring consistent storytelling of impact, outcomes, and learning. Represent Resolve externally through relationship-building, sharing achievements across Hong Kong, and amplifying visibility via regional and international engagement.

Essential Skills & Requirements

Proven experience leading program strategy, delivery, and evaluation within social impact / nonprofit contexts—ideally with community-facing, fellowship, or participant-led models.

Strong ability to oversee multi-component programs, with particular strengths in community building and network development (e.g., creating spaces for belonging, peer learning, and sustained engagement among diverse stakeholders).

Demonstrated partnership and stakeholder management skills, including funder and ecosystem relationship building, and experience working in collaboration with community partners and community-led decision-makers.

Experience developing or managing impact frameworks, learning/evaluation processes, and program reporting.

Budget ownership and financial stewardship mindset.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to represent an organization with clarity, empathy, and credibility—able to facilitate discussions, translate complex ideas for different audiences, and communicate in a participant-centred way.

Experience leading teams—coaching, managing performance, and building an inclusive, values-aligned culture, including creating the right environment for collaboration, reflection, and community-oriented work.

Commitment to safeguarding, risk awareness, and ethical community engagement practices, ensuring participants feel safe, respected, and supported.

Strong interpersonal and engagement skills, including conflict-aware facilitation, consensus-building, and the ability to strengthen trust and solidarity within communities.

Proficiency in English is a must (spoken and written). Spoken and written proficiency in Chinese would be an asset.

Location
Currently Resolve’s office is located in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong. Resolve allows for flexible working, currently at a ratio of 40% (remote) / 60% (in office). Occasionally, Resolve events may fall on evenings or weekends, where we distribute the team load.

Salary & Benefits
