title: Senior Business Development Executive / Senior Sales Executive
snippet: Earn HK$30K–45K+ monthly. Competitive base + uncapped commission. Clear growth path for high performers. Sales ability matters most.
location: Sheung Wan ·  Central and Western District
label: 市场
full_jd:
Join Our Fast-Growing Sales Team at Spacious

Spacious.hk is Hong Kong’s leading independent internet property search platform, helping over one million monthly property seekers discover homes, neighbourhoods, serviced apartments, and property opportunities across Hong Kong.

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded sales professional to join our growing sales team as a Senior Sales Executive / Senior Business Development Executive.

This is a proactive B2B sales role for someone who wants more than a standard sales job: clear sales territory ownership, uncapped sales commission, direct access to senior leadership, visible impact on sales strategy, and significant career advancement opportunities for high performers.

You will sell Spacious.hk’s advertising, listing, visibility, and digital media solutions to property agents, property agencies, and other commercial clients. The role involves cold calling, cold messaging, outdoor sales prospecting, face-to-face client meetings, direct client outreach, sales follow-up, sales negotiation, and closing sales deals.

You will be representing a well-known and recognised property platform with over one million monthly users, giving you a strong foundation when opening sales conversations with agents, agencies, and property brands.

Why This Sales Role Is Different

At Spacious, you will not be one of hundreds of salespeople following a fixed corporate sales script.

You will have direct access to the CEO and senior leadership team, with exposure to sales strategy, pricing, product positioning, client negotiations, and commercial growth planning. Your feedback from the market will help shape how we approach clients, improve our sales process, and grow revenue.

This is not simply a role selling advertising space. You will help clients understand visibility, positioning, enquiry generation, digital media, and how to reach serious property seekers at the right moment in their decision journey.

You will work directly with Hong Kong’s property agency sector - one of the city’s largest and most active commercial markets. According to Hong Kong’s Estate Agents Authority, the city has more than 37,000 licensed estate agency professionals, nearly 4,000 licensed estate agency companies, and thousands of agency business locations across Hong Kong.

This is a large, competitive, and high-value B2B sales market. Your role is to help property agents and agency teams grow visibility, generate enquiries, win listings, and reach serious property seekers through Spacious.hk’s advertising, listing, and digital media solutions.

Good salespeople do their best work when account ownership is clear. That is why each salesperson is responsible for their own neighbourhoods and client coverage areas. This means clear sales ownership, less internal conflict, cleaner commission attribution, and no fighting over the same clients.

Our sales team is structured so that salespeople are encouraged to help each other. When more agents and clients join Spacious, the whole platform becomes stronger, which benefits the whole sales team.

This creates a friendly, supportive, and high-achieving sales culture - with clear ownership, less internal conflict, and more teamwork.

Why Join Us?
Competitive Compensation

Monthly earnings of HK$30K–45K+ (base salary + commission) are achievable for high-performing sales executives

Annual salary reviews and performance bonuses

Medical and dental insurance

MPF contributions

Work-Life Balance

18 days of annual leave

5-day work week with bank holidays off

Growth Opportunities

Significant career advancement opportunities for high performers

Opportunity to take on greater responsibility and ownership as you demonstrate results

Direct collaboration with senior leadership

Exposure to sales strategy, pricing, product positioning, and client negotiations

Sales training from senior operators on sales strategy, pricing, negotiation, client positioning, and long-term commercial relationship building

Ownership of your own sales territory, with clear neighbourhood and client coverage

Supportive sales team culture, with no internal fighting over the same clients

Budget for continuous learning and development

Unmatched Earning Potential

At Spacious, your earning potential is directly tied to your sales performance. Substantial sales commissions are available for executives who meet and exceed their targets.

With generous sales commissions linked to new business development, client renewals, and account growth, your performance directly impacts your income.

The more sales deals you close, the more you earn. If you’re motivated and driven, your hard work will be rewarded with strong sales upside.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Senior Sales Executive at Spacious, you will help drive sales revenue growth for Spacious.hk.

Developing New Sales Opportunities (60%)

Identify and engage with potential clients, including property agents, property agencies, agency branches, developers, and service providers.

Use a combination of cold calling, cold messaging, WeChat/WhatsApp outreach, LinkedIn outreach, email outreach, outdoor prospecting, referrals, and face-to-face client visits to generate new sales leads and drive sales growth for Spacious.hk.

You will also build and manage your own sales pipeline, prioritise sales leads, and follow up consistently to move prospects through the sales process.

Client Needs Analysis and Sales Solutions (20%)

Analyse clients’ business needs, marketing objectives, and pain points.

Provide tailored sales solutions that align with their goals, using your understanding of the real estate market and Spacious.hk’s advertising, listing, visibility, and digital media products.

Client Relationship Management (10%)

Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients to ensure ongoing satisfaction.

Provide excellent account servicing, support renewals, and identify new sales opportunities to grow eac

Mentorship: Guidance from experienced lawyers to help you gradually build your legal expertise.

Career flexibility: Suitable for those aiming to qualify as lawyers or explore related industries such as compliance, finance, or corporate advisory.

Professional growth: Opportunities to meet clients, attend meetings, and gain practical insights into the legal and business world.

International exposure: Potential to work on cross-border matters and travel overseas.

Good organizational skills and attention to detail.

Developing and implementing legal policies and guidelines to protect the group’s interests and ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations;

Assisting other senior lawyers with different tasks assigned from time to time and effective administration of the Legal & Compliance Team.

What you'll need

2-6 years’ post-qualification experience gained from reputable law firms or MNCs.

Qualified in Hong Kong or other common law jurisdictions or the U.S.

Experience in Hong Kong listing rules compliance, corporate governance and compliance and commercial transactions.

Experience in dealing with data protection issues and regulatory practice relating to international businesses

Exceptional attention to detail and excellent presentation and interpersonal skills with ability to work independently or in a team.

snippet: Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.

full_jd:
Overview

Come build community, explore your passions and do your best work at Microsoft with thousands of University interns from every corner of the world. This opportunity will allow you to bring your aspirations, talent, potential—and excitement for the journey ahead.  

As a Research Science Intern, you will conduct research and leads research collaborations that yield new insights, theories, analyses, data, algorithms, and/or prototypes that advance the state-of-the-art of computer science and engineering, as well as general scientific knowledge. You will formulate research problems in an area of study and initiates the design, development, execution and implementation of a research agenda to further academic knowledge and close identified gaps and provide expertise to product or business groups and may create long-term business opportunities through research outcomes, but not responsible for addressing immediate product needs or demonstrating a clear path to product.

We are seeking candidates excelling in deep thinking research aspects and fast-paced entrepreneurial execution. The ideal candidates should have the ability to work with researchers and product team colleagues at Microsoft to push forward research agendas, being a team player in a collaborative and supportive environment with outstanding programming skills. We are seeking candidates with research skills and technical backgrounds. Applicants should demonstrate depth of knowledge in Natural Language Understanding, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Data Mining or Machine Intelligence (Artificial Intelligence) as well as strong academia experience in data processing, experimentation, and modeling.

Microsoft works with the world’s best researchers, moving with the current of technology as it rapidly evolves. Together we share the motivation to seek innovative solutions to the world’s toughest challenges and improve the lives of people everywhere. Microsoft provides a nurturing environment to support passionate researchers and engineers in AI technology innovation.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Analyze and improve performance of advanced algorithms on large-scale datasets and cutting-edge research in machine intelligence and machine learning applications.

Implement prototypes of scalable systems in AI applications.

Collaborate closely with team members on developing systems from prototyping to production level.

Develop solutions for real world, large-scale problems.

Under instruction from others, research new tools, technologies, and methods being used in the research community and contribute your knowledge around a specialized tool/method to support planning for research projects.

Gain an understanding of their research as it relates to Microsoft products or business groups and assists in technology transfer attempts, participating on standards organizations, filing patents, authoring white papers, developing or maintaining tools/services for internal Microsoft use, or consulting for product or business groups.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

Currently pursuing a Bachelor/Master/PhD Degree in a relevant field

Must have at least one additional quarter/semester of school remaining following the completion of the internship

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages including: C/C++, Java, MATLAB or Python, ideally languages such as pyTorch, Tensorflow and other deep learning toolkits.

Experience (classroom or work related) in one or more areas of computer science, such as Natural Language Understanding, Neural Networks, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Data Science, Privacy or other relevant research focuses.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Shipping & Documentation Clerk
snippet: W're looking for a careful, organised clerk to handle the shipping paperwork and coordination that gets our lightings from our warehouse to clients
label: 统筹
full_jd:
We are looking for a careful, organised clerk to handle the shipping paperwork and coordination that gets our finished lightings from our Hong Kong warehouse to clients around the world.

Prior shipping or logistics experience is not required, but preferred. Our freight forwarders handle majority of the transport arrangements. What matters most is accuracy, attention to detail, and the discipline to follow each shipment through to completion. This role suits someone who is methodical, comfortable with paperwork and Excel, and dependable with deadlines.

What you'll do

·         Receive packing lists from our factory and check them carefully for accuracy — quantities, dimensions and measurements — before a shipment proceeds.

·         Prepare shipping documents for each order: delivery orders for local Hong Kong deliveries, and packing lists and commercial invoices for overseas shipments.

·         Gather any missing details needed to ship — delivery address, contact person, and shipping terms (air or sea; delivery included or excluded).

·         Confirm payment status with the Accounts department before instructing the warehouse to release goods.

·         Book shipments with our freight forwarder by providing the documents, package dimensions and volume; the forwarder arranges the transport and clearance.

·         Prepare air and sea freight cost estimates for the sales team or clients, using past shipment records and current rates from the forwarder.

·         Collect the air waybill or bill of lading from the forwarder once goods have departed.

·         Submit export declarations through the government system (Tradelink) within the required 14-day window.

·         Prepare country-specific documents where required (e.g. Certificates of Origin / Form E) and arrange cargo insurance.

·         Assist with customs clearance by supplying supporting documents (goods value, certificates, test reports) when requested.

·         Liaise with Accounts Department on freight bills and monthly forwarder statements for payment.

Keep shipping records and tracking spreadsheets accurate and up to date.

What we're looking for

Essential

·         Meticulous attention to detail and a methodical, organised way of working.

·         Reliability with deadlines and the diligence to see each shipment through to the end.

·         Comfortable with Microsoft Excel and general office/computer work.

·         Good written and spoken English and Chinese (Cantonese; Mandarin an advantage) — to communicate with our China factory, overseas clients and forwarders.

Willingness to learn shipping documents and systems on the job.

An advantage (but not required)

·         Any exposure to export/import documentation, Certificates of Origin, Tradelink, or ERP systems such as Odoo.

·         Previous experience in an administrative, clerical, order-processing or customer-service role.

full_jd:
Currie & Brown is currently looking for a people and administrative assistant for our Hong Kong office. The successful candidate will provide daily support for both administration and people management functions and duties.

What is it we would like you to do?

Performing general administration duties and providing full admin support to the teams and departments

Handling office equipment maintenance, office supplies order, document filing, etc

Assisting in the coordination of company activities, staff engagement events and CSR

Maintaining attendance and leave records

Updating and preparing monthly analysis/reports

Supporting employee relations and communications

Undertaking ad-hoc duties as assigned

What skills and attributes are we looking for from you?

A minimum of one year’s related experience preferable; graduates also considered

Experience working in the construction industry an advantage

Well-organised, self-initiative, diligent, proactive, assertive, well-disciplined and commercially astute

Good interpersonal skills and systematic working manner

A team player with a 'can-do' attitude, outgoing, polite, patient, diplomatic, personable, respectful and flexible

High level of integrity with a strong sense of responsibility

Ability to work under pressure and capable of meeting deadlines

Proficient in MS Office and Chinese word processing

Good command of both written and spoken English and Chinese

The nature of the role will require strict confidentiality and diplomacy at all times

Why choose Currie & Brown?

Unlike some businesses, we prioritise for the long term and honour our commitments. We are compassionate and inclusive in the way we approach our work, and always look to invest in our people’s futures. Be it a desire to work internationally, a drive to progress, or even a curiosity to operate in a new sector, we are there for our people at every stage – providing advice, support and the structure to achieve. That is why so many of us have established and built successful careers here for so long. The Position

Built with the vision to enable interaction, co-creation and knowledge sharing, the Experience Center in Hong Kong Science Park showcases the latest collection of I&T breakthroughs. The Centre fosters cross‑industry collaboration, encourages young talents to explore their potential, and brings together compelling innovation stories that guide visitors through an immersive and inspiring journey. We are now looking for a seasoned, high-caliber leader to oversee the Centre and elevate the visitor experience. Beyond leading the Experience Centre, the successful candidate will also drive a wide spectrum of strategic initiatives—ideating, planning and delivering high‑level flagship events, conferences, exhibitions, community engagement programmes and new initiatives to support the continuous growth of the Corporation and to elevate the vibrancy and diversity of the HKSTP community.

Experience Centre

Curate and deliver a professional and engaging visitor journey for VIPs, guests and visitors of the Experience Centre, including government officials, Chinese mainland and overseas delegations, policymakers, business leaders, academia, R&D experts, young generations and more.
Oversee and ensure smooth daily operations of the Centre, including budget management, visit scheduling and coordination, stakeholder and contractor liaison, timely enquiry handling, visitor behaviour analysis and preparing monthly reports.
Plan and drive periodic content revamp, showcase updates and the introduction of new tech innovations and experiences, driving continuous improvement to elevate the overall visitor experience.

Event Marketing

Lead and drive the overall strategy, design and execution of high‑quality, impactful B2B and B2C events, including flagship event EPIC, conferences, exhibitions and community engagement programmes etc, spanning ideation, content curation, brand positioning, budgeting, planning, execution and promotion.
Develop impactful marketing and promotional assets.
Research and analyse latest global marketing trends and insights.

Others

Perform any other duties as assigned by supervisors.

The Candidate

Bachelor's degree preferably in Communications, Hospitality and Tourism, Marketing, Business Management or related disciplines
At least 8 years of experience preferably in hospitality, customer and community service, event marketing or related fields and gained in sizable or multinational companies
Higher education or professional qualifications with less experience will also be considered
Minimum 3 years of managerial experience with proven leadership skills
Proven track record in leading high‑level flagship events, curating content, managing visitor experience, and delivering professional stakeholder engagement
Strong business acumen with solid understanding of global marketing trends, content marketing and digital engagement
Excellent interpersonal, communication, problem‑solving and analytical skills
A strong storyteller who is customer‑centric, innovative, and passionate about I&T and ecosystem building
Energetic, collaborative, detail‑oriented and able to work under tight schedules with a strong ownership mindset
Excellent command of written and spoken English and Chinese (including Cantonese and Putonghua)

What We offer

Unique Work.Live.Play.Learn culture in Hong Kong's largest Innovation & Technology ecosystem
5-day work week, attractive annual leave and additional special leave
Medical benefits including dental and annual check-up from Day-1, with extended coverage to dependent(s)
Professional training and career advancement opportunities
Accessible to various bus service with network across different locations in HK

Interested parties please submit your application by clicking "Apply Now". Direct applicants who do not apply via the "Apply Now" will not be progressed further. Commencing position will be commensurate with qualifications, relevant experience, and competencies.

The application will remain open until the position is filled. HKSTP reserves the right not to fill the position.

Personal data provided will be treated in strict confidence and used for recruitment purpose only. All personal data collected will be used strictly in accordance with employer's personal data policies, you can refer to the Corporation's Privacy Policy Statement at https://www.hkstp.org/privacy-policy/

Applicants not invited for interview within 6 weeks may consider their applications unsuccessful. Personal data of unsuccessful applicants will be retained for a maximum of two years counting from the date the vacancy has been filled.

About Hong Kong Science & Technology Parks Corporation

Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation (HKSTP) was established in 2001 to foster a thriving innovation and technology (I&T) ecosystem that nurtures emerging companies, supports numerous research professionals and technology firms from various countries. This ecosystem focuses on developing sectors such as life and health tech, AI & robotics, fintech, and smart city technologies, etc.

HKSTP provides comprehensive support to attract and nurture talent, accelerating the commercialization of innovations for technology ventures. The Corporation continues to contribute in establishing I&T as a pillar of growth for Hong Kong.

More information about HKSTP is available at www.hkstp.org.

我們是一家擁有自家研發及生產線的科技美學品牌。我們以「科學美學」為核心，致力將頂尖的美容儀器技術（如 RF 射頻、紅光等）結合面部美學分析，為大眾提供專業的變美方案。現正處於高速發展期，誠邀具備創業精神、靈活多變的你加入我們的香港團隊！

社交媒體及數碼營銷 (Social Media & Digital Marketing)
負責管理香港及海外社交平台（Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok）的日常營運及內容發佈。
協助制定及執行 Meta Ads 等網上廣告投放策略，追蹤成效並優化 ROI。
將內地團隊提供的視覺素材，轉化為貼合香港本地市場品味及用語的貼文 (Copywriting)。

品牌獨立站及電商營運 (Shopify & E-commerce Operations)
負責 Shopify 官方網站的日常營運及更新。
協助處理網站的基礎技術設置，包括 GA4 (Google Analytics 4) 數據追蹤、Meta Domain Verification 等。
協助管理及對接第三方支付網關 (Third-party Payment Gateways，如 Stripe, PayMe 等)。
協助跟進本地大型電商平台（如 HKTVmall, 豐澤, YOHO 等）的日常營運，並與物流團隊協調出貨及庫存安排。

KOL 拓展及合作夥伴關係 (KOL & PR Management)
主動發掘及聯絡與品牌形象相符的本地美妝、生活風格 KOL / 網紅，處理產品贊助及合作洽談。
與本地代理商、直播間及合作夥伴保持良好溝通，協助推動銷售活動。

營運支援與跨部門協作 (Operations & Cross-border Collaboration)
協助處理本地售後服務、解答客戶查詢，維持高質素的客戶體驗。
協助處理產品說明書翻譯、校對（繁/簡/英）及其他突發的行政支援工作。
定期與深圳總部（光明區）及各後勤部門保持緊密溝通，確保中港兩地團隊在品牌視覺、內容產出及物流安排上的步伐一致。

【入職要求】
大學學位畢業，主修市場營銷、電子商務、傳理或相關學科優先。
具備 1-3 年 Digital Marketing 或 E-commerce 相關工作經驗（歡迎有潛質的應屆畢業生）。
語文能力良好，能流暢閱讀及書寫繁體中文、簡體中文及英文，能準確理解英文影片內容及產品說明書。
熟悉 Shopify 系統操作及數碼廣告（Meta Ads, GA4）後台者優先考慮。
對美容科技、美學分析有濃厚興趣，具備良好的互聯網觸覺（網感），熟悉本地及海外社交平台運作。
具備良好溝通能力及團隊精神，願意按工作需要偶爾往返深圳總部進行會議及深度交流。
具備「創業公司心態 (Startup Mindset)」，處事靈活、主動解決問題，願意在節奏快速的環境下處理多元化工作。

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Manager of Clinical Research to lead and execute our clinical study programs. This role is pivotal in designing, managing, and delivering high-quality clinical evidence to achieve regulatory approvals (PMDA,CE,FDA), support product commercialization, and contribute to scientific publications. Clinical Strategy & Study Design

Study Execution & Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for clinical investigators and site staff.

Collaborate with biostatistics to analyze and interpret clinical data.

Author, review, and finalize clinical study reports (CSRs).

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders including Corporate Affairs, Investor Relations, R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Medical Affairs.

Manage the clinical study budget and resources effectively.

Present clinical strategy and study updates to senior management.

 

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in a Life Science, Nursing, Engineering, or related field. Advanced degree (MS, PhD, MD) highly preferred.

Minimum of 5+ years of direct experience in clinical research within the medical device industry (experience with Class II/III devices is essential).

Proven experience leading and managing all phases of clinical studies (feasibility, start-up, execution, close-out).

Demonstrated success in contributing to regulatory submissions (PMA, 510(k), IDE, EU MDR) and interacting with regulatory agencies (FDA, notified bodies).

Deep knowledge of ICH-GCP, ISO 14155, FDA 21 CFR Parts 812, 50, 54, 56, and EU MDR regulations.

Strong experience in vendor and CRO management.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience authoring protocols, reports

Valid GCP certificate

full_jd:
Hong Kong Applied Science and Technology Research Institute (ASTRI) is founded in 2000 by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. As Hong Kong’s largest government-funded research and development centre, ASTRI is a key force and super‑connector driving innovation and technology advancement in Hong Kong, the Greater Bay Area, and the global innovation ecosystem. This role is strengthened through its merger with Nano and Advanced Materials Institute (NAMI).
Committed to bringing high‑impact research from lab to market, ASTRI advances interdisciplinary, market‑driven R&D that delivers practical innovations for industry and meaningful benefits for society.
Its technological strengths and capabilities enable AI‑powered, cross‑disciplinary ICT and advanced materials solutions across Smart City, Financial Technologies, Digital Health and Life Sciences, New Industrialisation and Intelligent Manufacturing, Application-Specific Integrated Circuits (ASIC) and Advanced Electronics, New Energy and Energy Storage, and Green and ESG Technologies.
Over the years, ASTRI has cultivated a strong pool of I&T talent and earned numerous international awards for its pioneering innovations and contributions to industry and the community. Following the merger with NAMI, ASTRI’s cumulative global patent portfolio has grown to over 1,500, with more than 2,200 technologies successfully transferred to industry.
With enhanced scale and capabilities, ASTRI is uniquely positioned to elevate Hong Kong’s innovation capacity, accelerate technology commercialisation, and drive societal and economic progress through world‑class applied research.
To support our constant endeavour to position Hong Kong as a world-class smart city and an international hub of innovation and technology, we are seeking qualified professionals to fill the following position(s):
Job Responsibilities:
We are seeking a highly qualified senior counsel to join our legal team. This role will provide strategic and pragmatic legal advice across a broad range of areas, including general commercial, intellectual property, technology licensing, data privacy, and employment matters. The successful candidate will support business operations, manage risk, and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations. Key responsibilities include:
• Drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial agreements (including technology licensing agreements, service agreements, leases and licences of premises, assignment and novation agreements), non-disclosure agreements and memorandum of understanding.

• Manage pre-dispute and dispute matters, including claims, litigation strategy, evidence coordination, case assessment, settlement support, and oversight of external counsel.

• Support employment-related legal matters, including employee documentation, workplace issues, investigations, disciplinary matters, exits, and coordination with HR and external counsel where required.

• Providing counsel relating to the operations of ASTRI, including export controls, data privacy, and anti-discrimination.

• Providing clear, robust, and pragmatic legal advice to senior stakeholders.

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver business-oriented solutions.

• Administering and conducting internal training to ASTRI’s staff on company’s policies and standards.

Job Requirements:
• Holder of LLB or LLM degree from Hong Kong or another common law jurisdiction.

• Admission to practise law in Hong Kong or a recognized common law jurisdiction.

• At least 8 years of post-qualification experience (PQE). Candidate with less experience may be considered for the post of Senior Legal Counsel.

• Prior in-house experience, or a combination of private practice and in-house roles.

• Experience in the technology sector is an advantage.

• Proven ability to handle employment disputes is an advantage.

• Detail-oriented, high level of professionalism and integrity.

• Proactive, self-driven, good time management and able to manage priorities and complex issues independently.

• Strong business sense and capable of delivering robust and pragmatic advice, with effective communication and stakeholder management skills, including engagement with senior management as well as peers.

• Proficiency in written and oral English and Chinese (including Cantonese and Mandarin).

• Live the ASTRI values.

The appointment will be on renewable contract terms with a competitive salary and performance-linked variable pay. Fringe benefits include paid leave, medical, insurance coverage and contribution to MPF. The incumbent will normally work a five-day week.
For interested parties, please submit your application with detailed CV within two weeks of the post date. Applicants are encouraged to submit their applications as soon as possible. The review of applications will continue until the post is filled.
The resume should not include any sensitive personal information such as ID card no. or travel document number, etc.
Position offer is subject to the applicant’s experience and academic qualification. Only short-listed candidates will be notified. ASTRI reserves the right not to fill the position.
ASTRI is an Equal Opportunities Employer. Personal data provided by job applicants will be used exclusively for recruitment only. For details, please refer to ASTRI Privacy Policy Statement.

title: Social Media & Office Assistant

label: 内容
full_jd:
Novel Collection is looking for a reliable and motivated Social Media & Office Assistant to support the company’s day-to-day marketing and administrative activities.

The role is suitable for someone with basic computer skills, familiarity with social media, and a willingness to learn AI tools for content creation.

No advanced marketing experience is required.

Position Type: Full-Time

Reports To: Office Manager

 

Main Responsibilities

Social Media Support

Create simple images and posts using AI tools and Canva.

Upload content to the company’s social media accounts.

Share company updates and promotions through WhatsApp groups and other communication channels.

Assist with maintaining the company’s online presence.

Lead Research

Search for potential clients online based on guidelines provided by the sales team.

Collect contact information and maintain lead lists.

Update customer databases and CRM systems.

Appointment Coordination

Contact clients and prospects to schedule meetings for sales representatives.

Follow up with existing clients when required.

Assist with basic customer communication.

Administrative Support

Provide general office and administrative support.

Assist with organizing documents, presentations, and marketing materials.

Support the Office Manager with daily tasks as required.

Work closely on a daily basis with the Company’s Sales Managers in the Shanghai and Dubai offices for all professional and sales-related activities.

Receive daily task assignments and operational guidance from the Hong Kong Office Manager.

Maintain regular communication and coordination between the Shanghai, Dubai, and Hong Kong offices as required.

 

Requirements

Basic computer skills.

Familiarity with social media platforms.

Basic knowledge of Canva, CapCut, ChatGPT, or similar tools is an advantage.

Good communication and interpersonal skills.

Organized, responsible, and detail-oriented.

Ability to work independently and follow instructions.

Languages

English – Good working level.

Mandarin Chinese – Advantage.

Additional languages – Advantage.

Experience

Previous office, customer service, administration, or appointment-setting experience is an advantage but not required.

 

Additional Notes

The primary focus of this role is supporting the Company’s marketing, lead generation, social media, and sales support activities.

What We Offer

Full training provided.

Opportunity to learn AI tools and digital marketing.

Friendly and dynamic work environment.

Growth opportunities within an international company.

Interested parties, please send your CV to hk•@novel-collection.com

Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited

Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited (hereinafter referred to as “the Company”) is a private organization jointly owned by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) and The Hong Kong Association of Banks. The Company’s key objective is to develop and operate a safe and efficient multi-currency and multi-dimensional financial infrastructure in Hong Kong for:

large-value interbank fund transfers denominated in HKD, USD, Euro and RMB;

interbank money settlement of equity and debt securities transactions in Hong Kong via the linkages with the Hong Kong Securities Clearing Company Limited and the HKMA’s Central Moneymarkets Unit (CMU) system;

small-value interbank fund transfers denominated in HKD and RMB via the HKD and RMB Faster Payment System; and

interbank clearing and/or money settlement of paper cheques and various types of electronic payments in Hong Kong.

The Company is also the operator of the HKMA’s CMU system.

snippet: Join us to craft Traditional Chinese content, master hands-on SEO skills, and drive real search traffic for local Hong Kong businesses.

full_jd:
Job Highlights

1-3 years of SEO, content, copywriting, or digital marketing experience

Strong Traditional Chinese writing skills required

SEO training and hands-on project exposure provided

15 days annual leave, 5-day work week, medical coverage

Job Description

Advance Focus helps local Hong Kong businesses improve their online visibility through practical SEO strategies, better website content, and measurable performance growth.

We are looking for a junior talent who enjoys writing, researching, and learning how SEO works. You do not need to be an SEO expert yet, but you should have strong Traditional Chinese writing ability, good attention to detail, and a genuine interest in search marketing and website content.

What You’ll Do

Write and edit Traditional Chinese website content, blog articles, landing pages, service pages, and FAQs

Support keyword research, topic research, competitor research, and search intent analysis

Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, H1/H2 headings, internal links, and image alt text

Improve existing website content for clarity, readability, relevance, conversion, and SEO performance

Assist with basic SEO tasks such as content mapping, metadata updates, URL checks, and performance tracking

Work with SEO, technical operations, and client servicing teams on real client projects

What We’re Looking For

1-3 years of experience in SEO, content writing, copywriting, digital marketing, journalism, communications, or related fields

Strong Traditional Chinese writing ability, especially for Hong Kong readers

Basic understanding of SEO concepts such as keywords, search intent, headings, meta descriptions, and internal links

Able to research unfamiliar topics and turn information into clear, useful, and engaging content

Detail-minded, organised, responsible, and open to feedback

Interested in building a long-term career in SEO, content strategy, or digital marketing

Fresh graduates with strong writing samples will also be considered

Great to Have

Experience writing website content, blog articles, social media captions, ad copy, or product / service pages

Familiarity with WordPress or other CMS platforms

Basic knowledge of Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Ahrefs, Semrush, or similar tools

Interest in AI-assisted content workflows, AI Overview, GEO, and changing search behaviour

Previous agency, freelance, or client-facing experience is a plus

What We Offer

5-day work week, Monday to Friday

Office hours: 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM

15 days of annual leave

Outpatient medical coverage

Hands-on SEO and content training

Energetic, and Supportive team culture

Office in San Po Kong, within walking distance from Diamond Hill MTR Station

Application Notes

When submitting your CV / resume, please include:

a) Your expected salary in HKD
b) Your self-rating in Traditional Chinese writing, SEO, and content strategy from 1-10
c) Writing samples, portfolio links, or examples of previous content work, if available
d) Other relevant skills, for example: Copywriting - 8, WordPress - 6, SEO - 5, Canva - 6

full_jd:
The Role

The position works with the global communications offices, representative offices in Asia, Hong Kong-based and global specialist departments on a full range of communications activities, focusing on press relations, internal communications and other aspects of communications, including corporate social responsibility (csr), crisis communication and public affairs. Liaison and coordination with Christie’s Asia and Corporate Communications channels where they include English language and Chinese language content is particularly important.

This role plans and implements on-going communications projects and tasks, including press events, editorial, advertorial, website coordination and translations of corporate/press/editorial/advertorial materials.

The successful candidate must show an ability to handle multiple projects and priorities at one time, and deal with urgent issues in a responsive, professional and thorough manner. Strong critical thinking, research, and organisational skills are mandatory. Demonstrated understanding of the global art market and timely issues within the news cycle necessary; auction world experience a plus.

Specific duties & responsibilities will include but are not limited to

• Contribute to curating communication strategies as well as developing content for Christie’s Asia.

• Drive media pitching as well as press awareness and coverage (e.g., print, online, TV, etc.) as part of integrated marketing campaigns for Christie’s events, including Hong Kong auctions, Asia tours, previews of global sales, and other special events.

• Lead and liaise with key media outlets for editorial coverage of sales, as well as arrange interviews for senior executives and specialists.

• Develop bilingual (English and Chinese) press releases and other communication materials

• Manage and coordinate press events and interviews as appropriate to auctions and projects, from development to execution, including content curation, logistical arrangement, administrative work and follow-ups.

• Manage and coordinate with Specialist Departments to deliver press campaigns from development to execution

• Assist media with a range of inquiries, coordinating with relevant internal teams, including Specialist Departments, Legal and Compliance, and/or senior management.

• Supervise agencies/freelancers to support the Communications team, e.g., coverage reports, press clippings, media tours, etc.

The Candidate

• Bachelor’s degree with minimum of 4-6 years’ of experience in Public Relations, in-house Corporate Communications in auction field (preferred) or luxury retail brand media and communication

• Solid HK and Regional media relationship, particularly with Art, Finance and Lifestyle press

• Familiarity with intranet/internet content creation and management. Strong social media skills a plus

• Exceptional written/verbal communication skills in both English and Chinese

• Strong team player, able to work with diverse internal/external parties and comfortable to work with cross-function workmates

• Solid relationship building and people skills, able to work with ambiguity and complicated situations.

• Able to multi-task, plan and prioritize on assigned projects and tasks.

• Excellent organisational and interpersonal skills, sound judgment on corporate issues and good business acumen.

• Fluent in written and spoken English and Chinese, additional language an advantage but not compulsory.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally and with all levels of staff through Senior Management and across cultures

• Adaptable and excellent in creative writing and translation

title: Marketing Officer (Maternity Cover | Aug - Dec 2026)
snippet: Support marketing campaigns, content and events, ensuring consistent branding, clear communication, and engagement with families.
location: Ho Man Tin ·  Kowloon City District
label: 市场
full_jd:
Stamford American School Hong Kong

Stamford American School Hong Kong is a private school that offers a world-class international education with a rigorous standards-based curriculum for children aged 5 to 18. As an accredited school of the Council of International Schools (CIS) and authorized as an IB World School, we instill an enthusiasm for lifelong learning, a sense of global awareness in every student, and the necessary skills to prepare them for the challenges and changes after graduation.

The school now has an exciting opportunity for an experienced Marketing Officer (Maternity Cover) to join our fantastic team.

About Cognita

Cognita is a global leader in independent education.  Founded in 2004, we are a growing community of 90 schools in 21 countries - in Europe, North America, Latin America, Asia and the Middle East - serving more than 100,000 students.  Each of our schools are proudly unique, however our collective purpose is to create an environment where everyone can, "Thrive in a rapidly evolving world".

At Cognita, we know every student is unique.  We nurture their distinct personalities and strengths. We support them academically, socially, and emotionally, wherever they are in the world, wherever they’re starting from.  And each and every one of our schools is unique too.

We protect what’s special about them, while offering them rich knowledge, opportunities, and best practices. And they get to be part of something bigger.  We open their classrooms to the collective wisdom of over 100 schools in 21 countries, ensuring every child gets an education that’s, quite literally, world class.

It is an individual approach that empowers every school, teacher and student to focus on what they do best and thrive.

About the Role

The Marketing Officer (Maternity Cover) is responsible for maintaining the continuity, quality, and effectiveness of the school’s marketing and communications during the maternity leave period (17th Aug to 14th Dec 2026). The role ensures consistent brand representation, timely delivery of marketing initiatives, and clear communication with prospective and current families.

Working closely with the marketing, admissions and communication teams, the postholder will support student recruitment, community engagement, and school events through strategic content creation, digital marketing, publications, and campaign execution. The role requires strong organisational skills, creativity, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while upholding the school’s ethos and values.

What you will be doing

Marketing and Communications:

Develop and implement marketing activities to support enrolment goals - Promote open houses, tours, fairs, and other admissions events.

Taking photos and short reel videos for school events for website, social media and newsletter purposes.

Coordinate creation of brochures and promotional materials.

Who we are looking for

Position Requirements

Self-motivated with an eye for detail and quality of work; pro-active attitude and passion for achieving results

Excellent command of English, Cantonese and Putonghua, both written and verbal

Proven ability to multi-task and set priorities

Experience with Photoshop and InDesign preferred

Qualifications

1 to 2 years work experiences in Marketing, PR or Communications

Contacts

Admissions and Marketing Communications Team

Faculty

External vendors

Working Conditions

Duties performed within a school environment or hot desk / office in different locations

Will be required to work independently and as part of a collaborative team effort.

Extended working hours to complete some projects may be required.

Occasional evening and weekend work.

Terms of Employment

Working Hours 9:00 am – 6:00 pm, Monday to Friday

Referee request: Required

Background Check: Required

Benefits at Cognita:

Competitive salary depending upon qualifications and experience

School holidays and public holidays

How to Apply

Please submit your application by clicking on "Apply Now" and creating a profile at Cognita Career portal before the closing date 28th June 2026 (HK Time) and ensure a Letter of Application is provided.

Cognita Schools are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed.

We believe having a diverse workforce makes us better, smarter and happier and so welcome applicants from all backgrounds, genders, and races.  We have an unwavering commitment to being fair and equitable in our recruitment process.

Early applications are encouraged, we reserve the right to interview and appoint prior to closing date for the right applicant.

Applicants who have not heard from us by the closing date must assume that, on this occasion, their application has been unsuccessful.

label: 编辑
full_jd:
工作範圍 (Job Responsibilities)

前線拍攝執行： 負責現場拍攝。靈活運用手機、相機或穩定器，在探房、活動等場景中捕捉高品質畫面。

後期剪輯與包裝： 獨立完成影片後期製作，包括流暢剪輯、節奏卡點、精準調色、BGM配樂，以及添加小紅書特有的網感字幕、特效與封面設計。

視覺風格打造： 針對不同帳號定位，策劃並執行符合小紅書主流審美（氛圍感、高級感）的視覺效果。

團隊創意協作： 與銷售人員及運營團隊緊密配合，參與拍攝構思及討論，確保拍攝內容能精準觸達目標受眾。

熱點即時追蹤： 監測小紅書熱點與熱門音樂，快速反應並應用於影片創作中。

職位要求 (Requirements)

小紅書資深玩家： 熟悉平台演算法、審美趨勢及爆紅邏輯，對「封面圖」與「標題吸引力」有研究。

技術硬核： 熟練使用 剪映 (CapCut) 及Adobe Premiere；具備優秀的運鏡與構圖能力。

Department of Curriculum and Instruction

Project Title: From Analytics to Actions: Enhancing Feedback Practices in Inquiry-based Discussion through Prescriptive Network Analysis

[Appointment Period: 12 months]

Applications are invited for the position of Research Assistant I to support an Early Career Scheme (ECS) project entitled “From Analytics to Actions: Enhancing Feedback Practices in Inquiry-based Discussion through Prescriptive Network Analysis”. The project explores how learning analytics and AI-supported approaches can be used to understand and enhance feedback practices in inquiry-based discussions. The appointment will be for 12 months, with the possibility of renewal subject to satisfactory performance and project needs.

The appointee will assist with project-related research and development activities, including developing research tools or demo systems, processing and analysing learning data, supporting classroom or online studies, preparing research reports and manuscripts, assisting with project administration, coordinating with student helpers and participants, and performing other duties assigned by the project leader.

Applicants with a Bachelor’s degree or above in education, technology, data science, or related disciplines are welcome to apply. Relevant experience or interest in learning analytics, AI in education, collaborative learning, or educational research would be an advantage.

We particularly welcome candidates who are self-motivated, responsible, willing to learn, and able to work both independently and collaboratively. Good communication and organisational skills would be helpful. Familiarity with data analysis, programming, or research software would be beneficial but not essential.  Training and guidance will be provided where appropriate.

Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

Initial appointment will be made on a fixed-term contract.  Fringe benefits include contract-end gratuity, leave, medical and dental benefits.

The University only accepts and considers applications submitted online for this post.  Applicants should complete the online application form and upload a full CV on or before 5 June 2026.  Applications which are incomplete or without the required documents may not be considered. Personal data provided by applicants will be used for recruitment and other employment-related purposes.  For details of the Personal Information Collection Statement, please refer to http://www.eduhk.hk/jobsopp/index.php?glang=en.

All applications will be treated in strict confidence.  Only those who are shortlisted will be contacted.  The University reserves the right not to fill the position(s) advertised. 

Further information about the University is available at https://www.eduhk.hk.

Part-time Technical Assistant (R6833) (S&T) (Ref: 260015L)

 

Major Duties and Responsibilities

Conducting literature review;
Conducting related experiments and analyzing the results;
Working with the Principal Investigator to prepare journal publications and research proposals; and
Performing any other duties assigned by the Principal Investigator(s) or Supervisor(s).

 

Candidates
Candidates should possess the following qualifications, experience and competence:

At least 5 subjects with Level 2 in HKDSE or equivalent, including English & Chinese languages and Mathematics / Diploma;
Preference will be given to Year 2 or Year 3 students majoring in Electronic and Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or Data Science;
Experience in digital signal processing and image processing is preferred; and
Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and able to meet deadlines and work independently.

Successful candidate will be appointed on a temporary part-time contract.  Benefits will be provided in accordance with the statutory provisions.

title: Office Administrator & Personal Assistant
snippet: Support our Senior Pastor and team at a vibrant international church, coordinating diaries, events and communications with your strong admin skills.
label: 助理
full_jd:
Vision

Methodist International Church Hong Kong (MICHK) is a richly diverse Christian family seeking to be open to the leading of Jesus in the power of the Holy Spirit. Everyone is invited to join us on the journey of faith through key strategic pillars: learning together, caring for each other, serving the city, stewarding resources, and celebrating God’s love.

More information about our church can be found at https://www.michk.com/ and https://www.facebook.com/methodistinternationalchurchhongkong

Reporting Line

Reports to the Senior Pastor. Works closely with the pastoral team and Chief Operating Officer (COO).

Role Purpose

The Office Administrator & Personal Assistant provides administrative, organizational and communication support to the Senior Pastor, pastoral team and COO, helping to ensure the smooth coordination of calendars, meetings, room bookings and event registrations in support of the ministry of MICHK.

Key Responsibilities

1. Personal Assistant Support

- Screen and direct incoming calls, emails and appointment requests for the Senior Pastor, ensuring they are handled promptly and redirected with care so people are helped in a friendly, Christ-centered way.

- Provide PA and administrative support to the Senior Pastor, pastors and COO, including diary coordination, appointment scheduling and meeting arrangements.

- Prepare agendas, papers, handouts, presentations and minutes for leadership, ministry and governance meetings.

- Draft, proof-read and send confidential correspondence and documents on behalf of the Senior Pastor.

- Support travel planning and itineraries for ministry and other work-related engagements.

2. Communication and Liaison

- Act as an administrative link between staff, volunteers and congregation members, communicating plans, schedules, appointments, meetings and event details in a timely way, in partnership with ministry leaders.

- Prepare and distribute clear internal and external communications, including notices, reminders, registration information and follow-up messages.

3. Annual Church Diary and Scheduling

- Lead the planning, maintenance and communication of the annual church diary.

- Gather dates from pastors, leaders and committees, facilitating discussions to resolve clashes and agree priorities.

- Circulate updated versions of the diary to staff and the congregation.

4. Room Bookings and Events Coordination

- Manage room bookings for church activities, ensuring requests are accurately logged and communicated.

- Administer registrations for church events, including maintaining attendance lists, sending confirmations and monitoring responses.

5. Office Administration and Records

- Maintain organized digital and physical filing systems for leadership, ministry and governance documents, ensuring information is accurate, secure and easy to retrieve.

6. Design and Administrative Support Materials

- Undertake small design and formatting tasks (e.g., simple posters, slides, service materials, registration forms or handouts) using tools such as Canva and PowerPoint.

- Coordinate with staff, volunteers or external providers when more advanced design support is needed.

7. Teamwork and Conduct

- Work collaboratively with all staff and volunteers to support the effective ministry of the church, demonstrating professionalism, discretion, hospitality, initiative and a service-oriented attitude.

- Undertake other duties reasonably related to the purpose and level of the role as assigned by the Senior Pastor or COO.

Working hours: 9:00 a.m. - 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, with occasional Sunday early-afternoon work (approximately 1-2 times per quarter) to support governance meetings, for which compensation leave will be provided.

The role has no direct reports but is expected to exercise appropriate autonomy in routine administrative decisions (for example, room allocation within guidelines and confirming bookings and event registrations).

Person Specification

Essential

- Committed Christian who supports the mission, values and ministries of the church.

- Relevant experience in personal assistant, office administration, executive support or ministry coordination work.

- Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage multiple calendars, deadlines and competing priorities.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact well with pastors, staff, volunteers and congregation members.

- High level of discretion and ability to handle confidential matters appropriately.

- Good working knowledge of common office software, email, calendars, shared documents and online registration tools, and willingness to learn church-management systems.

- Able to work accurately, take initiative, exercise sound judgement and follow through on tasks.

- Ability to communicate in English and spoken Cantonese

- Proficient in using Microsoft Word and Excel

Desirable

- Experience working in a church, NGO, school or other community-based organization.

- Experience supporting meetings, events or volunteer coordination.

- Basic design skills using tools such as Canva and PowerPoint.

Core Competencies

- Organisation and planning

- Communication and relationship management

- Discretion and confidentiality

- Coordination across multiple stakeholders

- Attention to detail

- Initiative and problem solving

- Service orientation and teamwork

 

If you feel called to explore this opportunity, please send your detailed CV and any additional information to hr•@michk.com

All information collected will be for recruitment purposes only.

More information about our church can be found at https://www.michk.com/ and https://www.facebook.com/methodistinternationalchurchhongkong

 

Methodist International Church, Hong Kong                                                        

Wesleyan House

Our Client:

Our Client is seeking a passionate and experienced Senior Grading & Shop Operations Specialist to play a key role in their new retail store for the daily retail and grading operations. This position is responsible for managing the end-to-end grading submission pipeline while also supporting front-line shop activities, including buying, selling, and trading cards with customers.

This role is ideal for someone who is deeply immersed in the collectibles hobby, has strong knowledge of trading cards and grading standards, and can turn that expertise into a high-quality customer experience. The successful candidate will combine operational discipline, technical grading knowledge, and customer-facing confidence to support both business performance and community growth.

Key Responsibilities:

Manage the full grading submission process, including pre-grading customer and shop submissions across PSA, BGS, and CGC, while advising on submission tiers and likely outcomes.

Oversee the end-to-end submission journey, including item assessment, order creation, packaging, shipping, tracking, receiving, and customer updates.

Partner with the Head of Retail Operations to improve and maintain SOPs for grading submissions and customer service processes.

Assess comic books and other collectibles for grading suitability beyond standard trading cards.

Identify altered, trimmed, counterfeit, or otherwise ineligible items before submission.

Maintain accurate submission records and ensure customers are kept informed of turnaround times and status updates.

Train and support junior team members on grading procedures, submission workflows, and best practices.

Evaluate walk-in collections and individual cards for trade-in opportunities, providing fair and informed valuations.

Support customers in buying, selling, and trading cards across both TCG and sports card categories.

Monitor secondary market pricing and category trends to help maintain competitive buy and sell pricing.

Build strong relationships with customers and contribute to the growth of the collector community around the business.

Requirements:

Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in trading card grading, submission handling, or card shop operations.

Solid knowledge of PSA, BGS, and CGC grading systems, including submission processes, grading standards, service tiers, and fee structures.

Strong familiarity with TCG categories such as Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh, and One Piece, as well as sports cards including NBA and MLB, with understanding of print variations, error cards, and population reports.

Ability to assess card condition accurately and provide realistic advice on grading expectations.

Proven ability to identify altered, trimmed, or counterfeit cards and collectibles.

Strong interpersonal, communication, and customer service skills.

Cantonese fluency is required; English and/or Putonghua or Japanese would be an advantage

At Sha Tin Junior School our vision is to enable all in the learning community to flourish. We are a vibrant and inclusive learning community where effort is valued, learning is engaging and creativity is fostered. We celebrate our cultural diversity, appreciate our place in Hong Kong and believe in the importance of the Chinese language and culture in the holistic education of our students. 

Sha Tin Junior School is looking for a school administrator to serve as the primary operational face of the school, executing daily front-desk, accounting, and student registration functions, while providing targeted, high-level corporate governance support for the School Council

Key Responsibilities

1. Front Desk & Daily School Operations (40%)

Reception Desk Management: Operate the reception desk with high professionalism, efficiently handling all walk-in visitors, telephone inquiries, and general school email correspondence.

Visitor & Site Safety Support: Prepare appropriate paperwork for visitors, manage student late registrations, monitor lunch-time supervisor logs, and manage the supply teacher/EA log-in system.

Administrative Liaison: Support the Principal, HR & Finance Manager, and Office Manager in preparing essential school materials, including but not limited to student labels, and information packs.

Logistics & Inventory: Maintain organized filing systems, track stock levels of school stationery, snacks, and cleaning consumables, and liaise with the school bus service to communicate effectively with parents.

Annual Declaration: Manage annual declaration for all staff members, including school council members and supply staff.

2. HR, Finance & Procurement Support (50%)

Procurement Operations: Assist staff with the school's procurement processes, examining purchasing orders number in place, checking purchase requisition forms accuracy, and ensuring all transactions are pre-approved by leadership before accounting entries.

Accounting Entries: Prepare routine accounting entries via the school's finance system (Epico) to optimize the payment process cycle. Maintain record of fixed asset registers and disposal entries.

HR Tracking & Payroll Assistance: Support the month-end closing, track teaching staff attendance, and input timesheets for Educational Assistants and lunch times supervisors, casual staff, and site staff overtime.

Admissions Assistance: Coordinate daily student registration databases alongside the Office Manager and assist with routine HR inquiries.

Petty Cash: Act as the Petty Cash custodian, keep the funds and supporting documents in a safe location. Issue the purchase requisition form and ensure all the petty cash purchases and staff reimbursement are pre-approved by the Principal and the Manager – HR and Finance.

3. School Council Governance & Executive Minutes (10%)

Boardvantage Platform Management: Serve as the technical administrator for Boardvantage, securely uploading and distributing highly confidential School Council agendas, briefings, policy documents, and institutional reports.

Strategic Minute-Taking: Attend and take minutes for the School Council and specific committee meetings. Formally transcribe discussions, regulatory votes, and action items.

Council Administration: Oversee school council onboarding and compliance responsibilities, including issuing formal letters of appointment, managing annual declarations, and organizing election documents.

Perform any other duties as and when assigned by the Principal, Manager – HR and Finance or Office Manager.

Requirements

Relevant experience in an administrative / reception roles

LCCI level 2 or higher in accounting or equivalent bookkeeping qualifications

Competent PC skills, with proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, and Google docs/sheets/forms/slides

Excellent interpersonal, communication and organizational skills

Ability to be flexible, prioritise workload, work independently and use initiative

A friendly manner in relation to staff and students is essential

To adapt to changing situations and keen to learn new skills

Fluent English, Cantonese and Mandarin would be an advantage

Previous experience in a school would be an advantage

Being the first University of Applied Sciences (UAS) in Hong Kong, we pledge to play a pioneering role in enhancing recognition of vocational and professional education and training, and nurturing talents with both applied skills and knowledge.

As a faculty-driven, student-centred university in support of innovative teaching and learning, strategic research, and stakeholder outreach to provide maximum benefit to our communities, we conduct research that advances knowledge and enhances teaching, focusing on strategic areas, including digital humanities and literature, international business, gerontechnology, personalised care, smart city, open and innovative education, and bilingual learning and teaching.

HKMU is becoming an ever more vital link in addressing and helping Hong Kong to solve many difficult challenges – as part of our involvement in, and commitment to, the ‘metropolis’ of Hong Kong. full_jd:
Our client, is a reputable bank, is seeking for an Assistant Design Research Manager to support their team.

Responsibilities:

Explore and validate the needs of customers’ needs, painpoints and requirement by applying the appropriate research methodology to help inform UX direction and solve key issues in hand

Collaborate with different product managers and project teams in understanding their needs, make suitable recommendation and design research plans to align with overall product strategy

Conduct different types of research, workshops, interviews and usability testing for different products during all phases of design

Manage all research preparations including recruitment, screening of participants and scheduling of sessions; manage external research vendors for larger scale projects

Conduct user interviews, workshops and usability testing, interpret and synthesize data

Analyse data and key learning to develop actionable recommendations to key stakeholders

Present and communicate research analysis clearly and be able to present to key stakeholders effectively

Able to sell, support, explain, and simply present usability approach and research to various audience types from sophisticated design experts to non-designers

Collaborate closely with other teams to ensure relevant data/insights are incorporated

Advocate the benefit of user-centered design approach to the wider organisation

Support UX designer in creating design concepts, wireframes and clickable prototype for usability testing and / or design concept testing  

 

 

Qualifications:

At least 3 years of experience working in research and UX related industries

Ability to solve complex design research challenges

Have working knowledge on different types of research methodologies, both quantitative and qualitative

Hands on experience in all aspects of design research, including recruitment, scheduling and logistics; understanding protocol; moderation skills; analysis; research deliverables and presentation of deliverables 

Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues, stakeholders and vendors, previous experience in research vendor management is a plus

Ability to deliver results on time and within budget

Open to explore different types of research methodologies; flexible in approaches to see opportunities for design research

Ability to work with multiple parties both internal and external to the bank

Be able to advocate customer-centric approaches within the bank

Comfortable with ambiguity yet be able to work through uncertainty

Strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving skills

Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence the design team, stakeholders, product managers and others. 

Proven collaborative and teamwork skills

Strong project management skills and be able to work under pressure

Passionate about UX design and putting user first

Understand UX basics such as personas, user journeys and flows, wireframing and conducting usability studies

Working Knowledge in using design and prototyping tools, such as Figma

Have the drive the change the status quo

Last but not least, curious about people

snippet: We seek to attract high-calibre talent by offering a dynamic working environment, career development opportunities & competitive compensation packages

full_jd:
A Career with Hang Seng Bank

Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join Hang Seng and discover how valued you’ll be. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, Hang Seng offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

Hang Seng Investment Management Limited

Established in 1993, Hang Seng Investment Management Limited ("Hang Seng Investment") is a wholly owned subsidiary of Hang Seng Bank Limited, and is Hong Kong No.1 exchange-traded fund ("ETF") manager in terms of assets under management. As a Hong Kong based asset management company specialising in managing funds related to the mainland China and Hong Kong markets, Hang Seng Investment is committed to providing investors with comprehensive investment management services, through investment managers with extensive experience in managing funds (including a series of ETFs and retail funds) and investment portfolios, for institutional and private clients. As a leading home-grown asset manager in Hong Kong, Hang Seng Investment has 30 years of asset management experience. 

We are currently seeking a high caliber professional to join our department as Head of Equities and Multi-Assets.

Principal Responsibilities

Lead the Equities team and provide strategic oversight for implementing fundamental equities and multi-asset investment strategies, ensuring integrated investment management across equities, fixed income, and other asset classes to deliver competitive risk-adjusted performance against relevant benchmarks and peer groups.

Conduct top-down macroeconomic analysis and bottom-up fundamental research to identify investment opportunities in global prospective, with emphasis in Greater China/Asian equities; generate actionable investment recommendations and stock-picking ideas (including factor analysis and screening).  

Oversee and proactively contribute to the full investment process, ensuring smooth & cohesive execution, high-quality research coverage, idea generation/sharing, team meetings collaboration, top-down asset allocation, and multi-asset inputs across strategies.  

Drive overall business and AUM growth through close collaboration with Sales, Product Specialist, and other relevant teams; provide proactive engagement, regular investment strategy updates, market specific and multi-asset strategy insights to support distribution and client servicing efforts.  

Coach, mentor, and motivate team members; foster strong teamwork, efficiency, proactivity, responsibility, and excellent communication/presentation skills, including in a multi-asset context.  

Adhere to stringent monitoring procedures, highest standards of compliance, risk management, and regulatory requirements.  

Requirements

University degree in Finance, Economics, or a related discipline; CFA designation preferable.  

Extensive senior-level experience (preferably >15 years) in investment management, with proven track record in leading equities/multi-assets teams, managing HK/China/Asian equity strategies, and overseeing or managing multi-asset strategies with competitive performance.  

Above-median/benchmark-beating performance in actively managed retail and/or institutional equity strategies, as well as multi-asset/funds-of-funds/asset allocation strategies.  

Strong leadership experience in mentoring junior team members, building high-performing teams, and integrating equities with broader multi-asset frameworks.  

Deep expertise in top-down macro analysis, bottom-up fundamental research, multi-asset allocation, quantitative approaches, alpha/beta & factor investing, and Greater China/Asian markets across asset classes.  

Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills; ability to engage effectively with internal stakeholders (Sales/Product) and external stakeholders on equity and multi-asset topics.  

Good understanding of investment compliance, risk management (including portfolio-level and cross-asset risks), and regulatory standards.  

Strong team working attitude with great sense of ownership and servicing mindset

Proficiency in spoken and written English, Cantonese, and Mandarin; self-motivated, able to work under pressure with strong sense of ownership and team-oriented mindset.

label: 助理
full_jd:
Job Title:                       Assistant Creative Engagement Curator (20-month contract)
Department:                Flora Conservation Department
Work Location:           KFBG
 
The Organisation
Kadoorie Farm and Botanic Garden (KFBG) is a nature conservation and education centre that spreads over 148 hectares of land on the northern slopes of Tai Mo Shan, Hong Kong's highest mountain. It lies in a valley, with a stream running down through the diverse (sub)tropical forest. You can find theme gardens, greenhouses, vegetable, and fruit terraces, walking trails, and public education displays of plants and animals, whilst the largest part of the estate is managed as a nature reserve. 
Our team consists of educators, ecologists, botanists, zoologists, conservation officers, spatial analysts, veterinarians, geneticists, arborists, horticulturists, gardeners, animal keepers, farmers, communicators and marketeers. Lessons learnt from hundreds of projects and initiatives are used to raise awareness, educate the public and catalyse behaviour change to protect nature and the environment.
With more than half of the century serving Hong Kong dedicatedly, KFBG has been evolving focuses and now striving to harmonize humanity’s relationship with nature through 3 core aspects: Nature Conservation, Holistic Education, and Sustainable Living.
We are looking for a “Assistant Creative Engagement Curator” who aligns with our vision and value and to be passionate to join the organisation to help making a difference.
For more information, please see www.kfbg.org  
Job summary
We are seeking an enthusiastic Assistant Creative Engagement Curator to bridge Hong Kong’s vibrant botanical world with the local community. This role is ideal for a dynamic plant and nature lover who possesses imaginative design and communication skills to translate scientific wonder into compelling visual and educational narratives.
The primary purpose of this role is to help KFBG’s Flora Conservation Department foster deeper public appreciation for the unique flora of Hong Kong, especially Lantau Island, by supporting a project team in orchestrating a range of print and digital publications, and public engagement activities, including workshops and an exhibition. You will have the opportunity to develop your voice for our plant-focused environmental education mission, splitting your time between creative design, ecological research and field work in nature.
Major responsibilities
Creative Design:
-            Design and compilation of digital and print publications that highlight the ecology, horticulture and beauty of Hong Kong’s plant life.
Content Curation:
-            Lead the development of content and display materials for educational workshops and a botanical exhibition, as well as the preparation of high-impact social media posts.
Public Education:
-            Deliver school talks, tours and workshops, inspiring the younger generation to admire and protect plants and nature in Hong Kong.
Field Engagement:
-            Act as a field engagement assistant, supporting learning in the classroom through hands-on activities for schools and the general public.
Research & Coordination
-            Conduct and support desk-based research on native plant species, their ecology and horticulture, while maintaining seamless coordination among project team members.
 
Job Requirements
-            With a degree either in Environmental Science or a related discipline (such as Botany or Horticulture) or a background in Education, especially Environmental Education.
-            Fresh graduates with relevant internship or project experience will also be considered.
-            A fundamental understanding of, and interest in, plants and the natural world.
-            Proficiency in print and digital design, being familiar with standard design software packages such as Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign.
-            The ability to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences, including students and the general public.
-            Possessing a systematic and organised work ethic, being able to help plan and execute exhibitions, workshops and public engagements in a timely manner.
-            Strong command of spoken and written Chinese and English.
-            Outgoing and dynamic, comfortable leading group activities.
-            Physically fit for outdoor work.
-            Responsible, self-motivated, good team player and well organized.
-            Able to work on occasional Sundays or public holidays if necessary.
 
Application Method
Interested parties, please send your cover letter, CV and portfolio to the People & Culture Department, Kadoorie Farm & Botanic Garden Corporation, Lam Kam Road, Tai Po, New Territories, Hong Kong or via email at pn•@kfbg.org

label: 市场
full_jd:
【公司簡介】
我們是一家擁有自家研發及生產線的科技美學品牌。我們以「科學美學」為核心，致力將頂尖的美容儀器技術（如 RF 射頻、紅光等）結合面部美學分析，為大眾提供專業的變美方案。現正處於高速發展期，誠邀具備創業精神、靈活多變的你加入我們的香港團隊！

【主要職責】
• 社交媒體及數碼營銷 (Social Media & Digital Marketing)
負責管理香港及海外社交平台（Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok）的日常營運及內容發佈。
協助制定及執行 Meta Ads 等網上廣告投放策略，追蹤成效並優化 ROI。
將內地團隊提供的視覺素材，轉化為貼合香港本地市場品味及用語的貼文 (Copywriting)。

• 品牌獨立站及電商營運 (Shopify & E-commerce Operations)
負責 Shopify 官方網站的日常營運及更新。
協助處理網站的基礎技術設置，包括 GA4 (Google Analytics 4) 數據追蹤、Meta Domain Verification 等。
協助管理及對接第三方支付網關 (Third-party Payment Gateways，如 Stripe, PayMe 等)。
協助跟進本地大型電商平台（如 HKTVmall, 豐澤, YOHO 等）的日常營運，並與物流團隊協調出貨及庫存安排。

• KOL 拓展及合作夥伴關係 (KOL & PR Management)
主動發掘及聯絡與品牌形象相符的本地美妝、生活風格 KOL / 網紅，處理產品贊助及合作洽談。
與本地代理商、直播間及合作夥伴保持良好溝通，協助推動銷售活動。

• 營運支援與跨部門協作 (Operations & Cross-border Collaboration)
協助處理本地售後服務、解答客戶查詢，維持高質素的客戶體驗。
協助處理產品說明書翻譯、校對（繁/簡/英）及其他突發的行政支援工作。
定期與深圳總部（光明區）及各後勤部門保持緊密溝通，確保中港兩地團隊在品牌視覺、內容產出及物流安排上的步伐一致。

【入職要求】
大學學位畢業，主修市場營銷、電子商務、傳理或相關學科優先。
具備 1-3 年 Digital Marketing 或 E-commerce 相關工作經驗（歡迎有潛質的應屆畢業生）。
語文能力良好，能流暢閱讀及書寫繁體中文、簡體中文及英文，能準確理解英文影片內容及產品說明書。
熟悉 Shopify 系統操作及數碼廣告（Meta Ads, GA4）後台者優先考慮。
對美容科技、美學分析有濃厚興趣，具備良好的互聯網觸覺（網感），熟悉本地及海外社交平台運作。
具備良好溝通能力及團隊精神，願意按工作需要偶爾往返深圳總部進行會議及深度交流。
具備「創業公司心態 (Startup Mindset)」，處事靈活、主動解決問題，願意在節奏快速的環境下處理多元化工作。
